title: Esguicho Mangueira Ducha 6 Formas Jato Bico Alta Pressão Com A — Real Review (Brazil · Automotive & Motorcycle)
creator: @user615554108246
hook_line: Guys, I don't know who set this price, but it's incredibly cheap
pain_point: Car wash tools are expensive and have single function
prompt_en:
[Style]: Brazilian local lifestyle short video sales style, with authentic, down-to-earth footage that highlights the product's exceptional cost-effectiveness and robust practical performance. The visuals are rich in fine details and highly persuasive for product recommendations
[Environment]: The opening scene is set in a spacious, bright big warehouse supermarket, with neatly arranged industrial fluorescent ceiling lights, various promotional display stacks, passing customers and orange price tags all around. The scene then shifts to a garage car wash setting with smooth tiled floors, where a household electric meter box and automatic garage door are visible in the background. The final scene takes place in a lush private residential courtyard, surrounded by dense tropical palm plants and bright blooming flowers, with abundant natural light
[Tone & Pacing]: The overall rhythm is fast and lively. The narrative progresses gradually from exciting product discovery to detailed demonstration of the product's robust features, then to the satisfying payoff of real performance testing, and finally builds up the urgency to prompt immediate orders, flowing seamlessly without any lag
[Camera]: The entire video uses a first-person handheld shooting perspective, with the camera moving naturally following the influencer's path. A large number of close-up shots are used to focus on product details. During the performance testing segment, the footage shakes slightly and naturally along with the spraying action, authentically recreating the real, casual feel of daily personal sharing
[Lighting]: The opening supermarket scene uses even, bright top light from the indoor industrial lighting to clearly show product appearances and price tag details. The garage scene uses a mix of ambient natural light and indoor fill light to fully present the car washing process. The final outdoor scene uses bright, soft daytime natural light to clearly and vividly enhance the cozy courtyard atmosphere
[Character]: A 25-30 year old Latina woman with a healthy light tanned smooth complexion, distinct and bright facial features, neat and relaxed eyebrows, sheer everyday no-makeup makeup look, and a toned, well-proportioned figure. She wears a light khaki fitted V-neck short-sleeve T-shirt and black casual trousers, with a warm, outgoing and energetic temperament. She holds the car wash spray gun with relaxed, natural movements, maintains a surprised and excited expression throughout, and has a highly infectious smile

The yellow shopping cart icon on the left side of the screen continuously pops up a '+1' number animation as the demonstration proceeds. Finally, the influencer gives a thumbs-up gesture towards the fully cleaned car body

A prominent cartoon shopping cart graphic pops up at the bottom of the frame, guiding viewers to place their orders immediately

[Background Sound]:
- A very upbeat, high-tempo TikTok-style background music with light electronic beats and a rising melodic line, at a moderately high volume, creating an atmosphere of 'surprise + urgency + product recommendation', ideal for promotional and daily good product recommendation sales videos. The musical style resembles popular viral electronic short video BGM, perfectly matching the high-emotion content of flash sales and exciting product finds
[Transition / Editing]:
- Uses natural, smooth sequential scene editing, seamlessly connecting the supermarket shopping scene to the accessory display and performance testing segments, then transitioning to the real-person recommendation shot. Cartoon yellow shopping cart pop-up animations are added throughout to reinforce product recommendation information, keeping the rhythm coherent and fluid

title: Central Multimídia MP5 2 DIN 7 Polegadas USB/AUX/TF Com Mirror — Promo Pitch (Brazil · Automotive & Motorcycle)
creator: @luana.santos.only
hook_line: Who bought yesterday will cry, this multimedia central used to cost over 250 reais but I got it
pain_point: Car multimedia central is expensive and hard to fit car models
prompt_en:
[Style]: Realistic, relatable lifestyle recommendation aesthetic, with bright, clear visuals and moderately high color saturation, overall creating a strong authentic sharing atmosphere that matches the visual tone of cross-border e-commerce short videos.
[Environment]: The opening scene is set in a modern open-style light luxury kitchen, with a marble-patterned countertop paired with hanging vintage glass chandeliers. An embedded large-capacity stainless steel refrigerator and integrated cabinets are visible in the background, with lighting provided by a combination of downlights and natural daylight. The subsequent scene switches to the interior of a private car, with a quiet, gentle urban residential street visible outside the car window, the entire environment is clean and tidy.
[Tone & Pacing]: The influencer recommends the product with an enthusiastic, sharing tone, the overall pace is brisk and smooth, scene transitions are natural, the core selling points of the multimedia car stereo are highlighted, the rhythm is appropriately balanced to capture the user's attention.
[Camera]: Primarily uses a first-person vertical selfie perspective, interspersed with close-up shots of product details and close-up shots of the phone screen casting display. The camera has natural slight movement, restoring the texture of real daily shooting.
[Lighting]: The opening kitchen scene uses soft light from indoor warm-white chandeliers and ceiling downlights, combined with natural daylight, the light on the character's face is even and bright with no shadows. The in-car scene uses daytime natural light pouring in through the car windows, the light is soft and comfortable, clearly showing the display effect of the car stereo screen.
[Character]: 22-28 year old Caucasian woman, with delicate, translucent skin that has a natural glow, three-dimensional and exquisite facial features, fluffy light golden curly hair, bright big eyes, full lip shape, natural sheer daily nude makeup, well-proportioned and slender figure. She wears a burgundy short-sleeve T-shirt with black trim paired with light purple tight athletic pants, sunny, cheerful and very approachable. She holds the car multimedia device with both hands to gesture and demonstrate, wearing a bright smile throughout the process.

[Shots]
Shot 1:
  - Duration: 0.0sec - 8.0sec
  - Scene Type: Handheld product demonstration
  - Scene: In a bright open-style light luxury kitchen, the influencer stands next to the marble countertop, on which an open kraft paper packaging box is placed. She holds the black car multimedia device wrapped in white foam with both hands, smiling and showing the product to the camera, gently adjusting the device angle with her fingers so that the camera can clearly capture the details of the device screen and side buttons, naturally explaining the product's advantages to the camera throughout the process.
  - Subject: quem comprou ontem vai chorar essa central multimídia custava mais de 250 reais, mas consegui pegar
Shot 2:
  - Duration: 8.0sec - 11.5sec
  - Scene Type: Product material demonstration
  - Scene: The scene switches to the interior of a private car cab in daytime, the influencer sits in the main driver's seat, holding the car multimedia device and showing it to the camera. Then the camera cuts to a close-up of the device, clearly showing the details of the physical buttons, knobs and ports on the left side of the screen, the figure of the person filming is faintly reflected on the device screen.
  - Subject: Ela muda completamente a sua vida. o estilo do carro. É universal e já vem
Shot 3:
  - Duration: 11.5sec - 15.0sec
  - Scene Type: Ease of use demonstration
  - Scene: One of the influencer's hands holds a lit smartphone, the screen displays a Bluetooth pairing pop-up and app icons, shown in front of the original car stereo screen. Then the camera moves, the influencer taps the original car stereo screen with her finger to perform an operation demonstration, completing the display of the screen casting image.
  - Subject: com Bluetooth e pareamento de tela pelo celular.
Shot 4:
  - Duration: 15.0sec - 17.5sec
  - Scene Type: Product usage scenario
  - Scene: The influencer sits in different positions inside the car, holding the multimedia device, gesturing with an open palm towards the camera to emphasize the effect the installation will have on the interior style, with a confident recommending expression on her face.
  - Subject: Tchau, tchau.
Shot 5:
  - Duration: 17.5sec - 23.3sec
  - Scene Type: Limited-time offer
  - Scene: The influencer's hand gently taps the navigation screen of the fully installed car multimedia device, the screen displays a clear map navigation route and prompt text, a red arrow appears on the image pointing to the position below the screen. Finally the camera cuts back to the influencer's face, she makes a guiding gesture towards the camera, enthusiastically sharing the final purchase reminder.
  - Subject: É uma oferta relâmpago, tem que correr. laranja ainda estiver aqui embaixo, é porque ainda tem. Aproveita!
[Background Sound]:
- Upbeat, cheerful TikTok-style background music with a lively, brisk rhythm, medium-high volume, electronic drum beats and playful synthesizer melodies, perfectly suited for promotional product sales videos. It creates a sense of urgency and excitement of 'limited-time flash sale, last one gone if you hesitate', with a musical style similar to the BGM of 'e-commerce flash pop' or 'seckill carnival', effectively stimulating the audience's impulse to click and place orders.
[Transition / Editing]:
- Uses natural scene transition editing, smoothly switching from the kitchen unboxing scene to the in-car scene. Intercut with product close-ups and function demonstrations during the process, finally adds dynamic annotations with red arrows overlaid on the screen to draw the audience's attention to the order entry, matching the efficient editing rhythm of e-commerce short videos.

title: Saida Maternidade Menina Pompom 05 Peças Roupas Para Bebê 100% — Handheld Demo (Brazil · Baby & Maternity)
creator: @dayanecreatorugc
hook_line: A full set of pink baby girl discharge clothes is neatly placed on the white quilted mat
prompt_en:
[Style]: Warm, healing realistic mother and baby aesthetic, with a color palette dominated by soft cherry blossom pink and off-white. Highlights are bright and gentle, the overall look delivers a delicate, warm parent-child atmosphere.
[Environment]: A well-lit indoor mother and baby storage display area, warmly decorated with a white drawer cabinet with gold handles, a white quilted mat, a light brown plush teddy bear, a vase with pink flowers, a white decorative photo frame, and pink lace curtains. The floor is covered with an off-white short-pile carpet, the entire space is clean and full of soft, gentle girlish charm.
[Tone & Pacing]: The overall rhythm is slow and unhurried, all movements are soft and gentle, with no rapid camera motion. The entire sequence conveys an exquisite, gentle, healing showcase tone, focusing on presenting the fine details of the mother and baby clothing set.

prompt_en:
[Style]: Humorous and realistic e-commerce style, combining playful prank creativity with authentic product demonstrations. The picture quality is bright and natural, with skin details and product cleaning effects displayed with extreme clarity, carrying the inherent approachability of viral TikTok UGC content
[Environment]: A sunlit private pool backyard with beige walls and palm trees. A shark-shaped inflatable swimming toy floats in the blue swimming pool, the ground is paved with light-colored non-slip tiles, and white lounge chairs, orange wash bottles, a green hose reel, a gray bucket and white slippers are placed around the area. A wooden pergola with hooks sits in the corner, forming a relaxed home outdoor leisure scene
[Tone & Pacing]: The first half uses exaggerated prank segments to create comedic contrast, while the second half maintains a steady, tight pace to clearly demonstrate the practical full-body cleaning functions of the product, naturally transitioning from eye-catching fun to compelling product recommendations. The entire flow is smooth and memorable
[Camera]: Shot entirely from a third-person fixed camera position, using medium full shots to fully display the playful prank interactions between the male and female leads, then switching to close-up shots focused on the back, arms, feet, and abdomen to precisely highlight the product's cleaning effects. The camera barely shakes, delivering stable and clear footage
[Lighting]: Ample natural diffused daylight in the backyard, with even, soft light and no harsh shadows. It clearly reveals the fine details of the back tattoo, the sloughed dead skin and grime, and the texture of the product's blue silicone material, resulting in bright, transparent visuals
[Character]: White male and white female, both with Southern European facial features and temperament. The male is around 30 years old, the female around 28, both young adults. The male has defined muscle lines, a large intricate tattoo across his back, healthy and firm skin, neat short hair with a short beard, and sharp facial features. The female has smooth, delicate skin, dark hair pulled back, distinct and relaxed facial features, light natural no-makeup makeup, and a well-proportioned figure. The male wears blue beach shorts printed all over with cartoon patterns and white slippers, later changing into black casual shorts. The female wears a leopard print camisole top paired with tight black bottoms and white slippers, in a casual vacation outfit. The two interact naturally and affectionately with playful grins, creating a lighthearted and joyful atmosphere

The fixed camera maintains a medium full shot to fully capture the interaction between the two characters.

White foam slowly spreads down the man's back, completely covering the exposed Jesus tattoo pattern. The camera pushes in slightly to focus on the scrubbing area on the man's back.

Eu só tô tentando te ajudar.
Obrigado.
Obrigado.

The man grips both ends of the blue back scrubber himself and rubs it back and forth across his back, with large amounts of grayish-white dead skin and grime sloughed off the skin surface. The camera shows a close-up of the grime covering the man's back to intuitively demonstrate the cleaning effect. The shot slowly pushes in from a medium shot of the man's back to a tight close-up of the dead-skin-covered area.

Shot 5:

Large amounts of grayish-white dead skin and grime immediately appear on the arm's surface, then a stream of water quickly rinses all the dirt off the arm. A close-up shot focuses on the arm scrubbing area to show the arm cleaning effect.

Next, he moves his foot to a black plastic stool, presses his bare foot onto the blue back scrubber placed on the stool surface, and moves his foot back and forth to clean the sole. Thick layers of grayish-white dead skin and grime gradually appear on the calf's surface. A medium close-up shot is aimed at the calf scrubbing area.

- No background music, this short video uses only human voiceover plus product demonstration sound effects such as rubbing sounds and running water sounds. The overall rhythm is driven by the narrator's speaking pace and the action sound effects of product use, with focus on highlighting product functions and usage scenarios
[Transition / Editing]:
- Using playful jump cuts and seamless scene transitions, the footage flows naturally from the opening prank segment to the full-body cleaning demonstrations of the product, with smooth connections between each body part showcase. The video ends with a shot of the product hung up for storage, maintaining a well-balanced rhythm that balances comedic appeal and practical product recommendation value

title: 365 Hábitos Simples e Poderosos — Handheld Demo (Brazil · Books, Magazines & Audio)
creator: @avl_shopp
hook_line: Get out of debt, build your emergency reserve
pain_point: Stuck in debt, lack emergency reserve
prompt_en:
[Style]: Cozy, satisfying unboxing style for daily life essentials, with delicate and clear image quality, soft and warm lighting, focusing on a genuine and natural product sharing feel, highlighting the exquisite binding texture and content value of the book.
[Environment]: A bright home scene by the window, with a smooth log-colored desktop as the shooting base. Bright windows and soft white sheer curtains are visible in the background, and warm golden afternoon natural light fills the space, creating a quiet, comfortable and fully lived-in atmosphere.
[Tone & Pacing]: First-person immersive unboxing sharing rhythm, with slow and natural movements, smooth and steady camera movement, and an overall unrushed pace. It fully presents the entire process of the book from unboxing to detail demonstration, conveying the sense of surprise of discovering a hidden gem product.
[Camera]: Adopt a first-person close-up perspective throughout the whole process, with the camera always focused on the hands and the main body of the book. Camera movements are mainly slow panning and slight focus adjustments, to maximally restore the real viewing perspective during unboxing.
[Lighting]: Warm golden natural light spilling in from the afternoon window serves as the main light source. The light covers the desktop and the book surface softly and evenly, creating a natural dappled light effect on the book cover without harsh shadows, for an overall warm and healing atmosphere.
[Character]: Only a pair of hands appears on screen, belonging to an average adult aged 20-30, with clean, smooth skin and even natural skin tone. The movements are gentle and meticulous, carefully unwrapping, holding and flipping through the book, conveying the sincere feeling of carefully sharing a great product.

[Shots]
Shot 1:
  - Duration: 0.0sec - 2.0sec
  - Scene Type: Unboxing
  - Scene: A pair of hands on a log-colored desktop carefully pinches the edge of the clear plastic seal wrapping the book, slowly tearing the seal to fully reveal a corner of the book's white cover, with gentle and ritualistic movements. Corresponding theme subtitles appear synchronously at the top of the frame. The camera stays in a fixed close-up, focused on the hands' unwrapping action with no obvious movement.
  - Subject: Sai das dívidas. Monta sua reserva de emergência.
Shot 2:
  - Duration: 2.0sec - 5.5sec
  - Scene Type: Product Material Display
  - Scene: Two hands hold the newly unboxed book '365 HÁBITOS PODEROSOS', turning the cover fully towards the camera for display. The camera slowly pushes in, for a close-up of the large gold-foil title text on the cover, the gold stamp logo in the upper right corner, and the printed Portuguese theme text on the cover. Corresponding guiding subtitles pop up synchronously on the frame. The camera slowly zooms in from the full view of the book to a macro close-up of the cover text.
  - Subject: para de ficar comprando coisa
Shot 3:
  - Duration: 5.5sec - 10.0sec
  - Scene Type: Product Usage Scene
  - Scene: Two hands open the book, holding it up to the window light to show the inner page layout. A finger gently taps the Portuguese title text at the top of the page, then slowly and continuously flips through the pages to show the rich content layout of the inner pages. A fixed red downward arrow guide icon is located at the lower left corner of each page, and another identical standing book is visible in the background as a visual echo. Subtitles introducing the fields covered by the book appear synchronously at the bottom of the frame. The camera maintains a close-up perspective parallel to the pages, moving slightly and gently following the page-flipping action to fully present the content details of each page.
  - Subject: Para de ficar comprando coisa. Saiu das dívidas.
Shot 4:
  - Duration: 10.0sec - 14.5sec
  - Scene Type: Product Design Highlight
  - Scene: The camera cuts back to the book cover, first showing a close-up of the gold stamp detail in the upper right corner. Then the two hands adjust their grip on the book, sequentially displaying the full view of the cover and the gold-foil text on the spine, finally holding the book steadily in the palms of both hands so that the cover faces the camera completely, to showcase the overall exquisite binding effect of the book. The camera slowly pulls back from the close-up of the stamp, following the hands' movement of adjusting the book's angle to fully present the details of different sides of the book.
  - Subject: Tá bem, tá com a reservinha, tá começando a investir, aí você... Você começa a curtir mais Só que
Shot 5:
  - Duration: 14.5sec - 15.5sec
  - Scene Type: Suspense Building
  - Scene: Two hands hold the book cover steadily, positioning the book fully facing the camera. Inspirational summary theme subtitles pop up at the top of the frame, warm golden light casts soft light and shadow on the cover, and the shot finally freezes on the complete and beautiful cover of the book. The camera maintains a fixed front full-view perspective, with a stable and still frame.
  - Subject: Vai ter que...
[Background Sound]:
- Upbeat pop-style background music with drum beats and electronic synthesizer elements, at a moderately high volume, with a positive, energetic and motivating melody that fits the atmosphere of inspirational content. Paired with Portuguese voiceover, the whole piece creates a positive vibe of 'take action and transform your life', matching the tone of lifestyle improvement short videos.
[Transition / Editing]:
- Use natural and smooth camera transitions, smoothly cutting from the close-up of the unwrapping action to the book cover display, then naturally switching to the page-flipping scene. The whole editing pace is slow, matching the healing atmosphere of unboxing sharing, with on-screen guiding subtitles and arrow elements popping up synchronously to enhance information delivery.
prompt_zh:
[Style]: 生活好物治愈开箱风，画面质感细腻通透，光影柔和温暖，主打真实自然的好物分享感，突出书籍精致的装帧质感与内容价值。
[Environment]: 光线充足的居家窗边场景，原木色的平整桌面作为拍摄基底，背景可见明亮的窗户与柔和的白纱窗帘，午后暖金色的自然光铺满空间，整体氛围静谧舒适充满生活气息。
[Tone & Pacing]: 第一人称沉浸式开箱的分享节奏，动作舒缓自然，镜头移动流畅平稳，整体节奏不急不缓，完整呈现书籍从拆封到细节展示的过程，传递出发现宝藏好物的惊喜感。
[Camera]: 全程采用第一人称近距离特写视角，镜头始终聚焦于双手与书籍主体，运镜以缓慢移动和轻微调整对焦为主，最大程度还原开箱时的真实观察视角。
[Lighting]: 午后窗边洒落的暖金色自然光作为主光源，光线柔和均匀地覆盖桌面与书籍表面，在书的封面上形成自然的光影斑驳效果，没有生硬的阴影，整体氛围感温暖治愈。
[Character]: 仅出镜一双手，为20-30岁的普通成年人手部，皮肤干净细腻、肤色均匀自然，动作轻柔细致，小心拆封、托书、翻页，传递出认真分享好物的真诚感。

[Shots]

  - 口播: Sai das dívidas. Monta sua reserva de emergência.
Shot 2:

[Environment]: 布置成梦幻粉色调的少女卧室，整体光线柔和温馨。背景可见带环形补光灯的梳妆桌，桌上摆放着化妆刷、香水瓶与香薰，搭配粉色软包梳妆椅；一侧是铺着柔软床品的大床，点缀粉色毛绒靠垫，墙面有暖粉色氛围灯带，地面铺浅粉色毛绒地毯。
[Tone & Pacing]: 热情亲切的好物分享风格，节奏舒缓清晰，每一处发饰细节都得到充足的展示时长，配合语音介绍慢慢推进，让观众能够充分看清套装丰富的配件品类。
[Camera]: 采用第一人称俯视视角拍摄，镜头全程聚焦在双腿上的发饰收纳盒上，搭配轻微的镜头移动来调整取景范围，近距离完整展示收纳盒的分层结构与所有发饰细节。
[Lighting]: 以梳妆镜上的环形补光灯作为主光源，搭配墙面的暖粉色氛围灯带进行补光，光线均匀柔和，没有生硬的阴影，精准衬托出彩色发饰鲜亮活泼的色彩质感，让整个画面都洋溢着温暖甜美的氛围。
[Character]: 20-25岁年轻亚裔女性，手部皮肤细腻白皙，指甲涂淡粉色指甲油，状态精致干净；身着粉色宽松休闲家居服，胸前白色针织抽绳细节清晰，风格居家舒适；体态匀称放松，正坐于床上展示商品，动作轻柔细致，传递出分享好物的热情。

[Shots]
Shot 1:
  - 时长: 0.0sec - 4.5sec
  - 镜头类型: 设置使用场景
  - 画面: 年轻女性坐在粉色卧室的床上，将多层透明收纳盒放在腿上，双手稳稳托住收纳盒两侧，缓慢将收纳盒向前抬起展示，镜头从平视带背景的角度慢慢拉近，完整呈现收纳盒三层分区里满满当当、色彩缤纷的发饰配件，背景的粉色梳妆区与卧室场景清晰可见。
  - 口播: Isso aqui é pra mãe de menina vaidosa, tá?  É um kit com 8x4.
Shot 2:
  - 时长: 4.5sec - 9.5sec
  - 镜头类型: 产品多功能性
  - 画面: 女性的右手依次伸进收纳盒的中层格子与底层格子，分别取出造型为星星的彩色发夹与马卡龙色的小发圈，指尖捏着配件轻轻晃动展示细节，随即又将配件放回对应格子里，过程中镜头始终聚焦在收纳盒内的丰富配件上，清晰展示不同类型发饰的样式与色彩。
  - 口播: 184 peças de acessórios de cabresilha, chuchinhas e elásticos.  São várias opções só  e essa variedade precisa
Shot 3:
  - 时长: 9.5sec - 13.0sec
  - 镜头类型: 展示多款式选择（时尚品类）
  - 画面: 女性再次双手托住收纳盒两侧，轻轻调整收纳盒的倾斜角度，将不同分层里的发饰分区完整地呈现在镜头前，让观众能够清晰分辨每一层格子里盛放的不同品类发饰，动作舒缓流畅。
  - 口播: para arrumar nossas meninas.  No site, esse kit está por mais de 200...
Shot 4:
  - 时长: 13.0sec - 15.5sec
  - 镜头类型: 超值价格
  - 画面: 镜头进一步拉近，切换为微距特写视角，聚焦在收纳盒底层堆叠的彩色小发圈上，女性的右手在发圈堆里轻轻翻拨，将不同马卡龙色系的发圈逐个展示给镜头，突出发圈柔软的质感与丰富的色彩选择。画面弹出红色的卡通点击图标与铃铛图标，模拟购物车点击提示效果。
  - 口播: Mas aqui no TikTok, clicando no carrinho laranja...
Shot 5:
  - 时长: 15.5sec - 20.0sec
  - 镜头类型: 下单流程指引
  - 画面: 镜头拉远回到完整的第一人称视角，女性的左手指向收纳盒上的区域，模拟点击平台购物车的引导动作，随后双手再次轻轻托住收纳盒展示其整体全貌，最后镜头定格在满满一整盒色彩缤纷的发饰套装上，完成整套商品的细节展示。
  - 口播: você consegue comprar ele por menos de 50 reais. Então, clica e compra hoje.
[Background Sound]:
- 非常欢快的TikTok背景音乐，节奏轻快活泼、音量适中偏高、带有流行电子节拍和俏皮的合成器旋律，属于平台热门商用带货BGM，整体氛围充满活力、吸引眼球，强化超值优惠、限时抢购的紧迫感和愉悦感，完美匹配妈妈为爱女选购发饰套装的带货内容。
[Transition / Editing]:
- 全程采用流畅的无转场自然衔接，依靠手部动作的移动引导观众视线，搭配卡通购物车图标与铃铛图标动态弹出效果，强化带货引导的视觉提示，剪辑节奏舒缓，让观众可以充分观察每一处商品细节。

title: Sandália Infantil Babuche Menina Slide Moranguinho Baby Rosa C — Handheld Demo (Brazil · Kids' Fashion)
creator: @castelli110
hook_line: Don't miss it, there's a surprise inside
prompt_en:
[Style]: Sweet girly aesthetic, with high-saturation pink as the main color palette across the entire frame, paired with abundant strawberry-themed elements. The image texture is bright and clear, perfectly recreating the dreamy vibe of retro Strawberry Shortcake animation merchandise.
[Environment]: A pink children's bedroom fully decorated with strawberry-themed soft furnishings, with ample and gentle indoor daylight. In the background, there is a large pink bed with an upholstered headboard, all bedding and throw pillows printed with strawberry patterns. A white shelf next to the bed holds strawberry-shaped ornaments and plush dolls, the floor is covered with a round strawberry-patterned plush carpet, and the walls are decorated with string lights and strawberry-themed art prints.
[Tone & Pacing]: The rhythm is slow and smooth, with gentle camera movements, creating a soft, healing, and energetic sharing atmosphere throughout. Every action that showcases product details is clear and well-paced.
[Camera]: Adopts a first-person handheld display perspective. First, a full shot shows the overall appearance of the handbag, then the camera slowly pushes in to focus on the cartoon slippers inside the bag. The entire camera movement is steady and smooth with no abrupt shaking.
[Lighting]: Uses 360-degree surrounding soft lighting, with light evenly filling the entire scene, no harsh shadows, perfectly highlighting the transparency of the pink-toned space and the vivid colors of the strawberry handbag and slippers.
[Character]: A 20-30 year old young woman, only her forearm and hand are visible. Her hand has fair, delicate skin, with red nail art decorated with black polka dot strawberry patterns. She wears a light pink knit sweater, her style matches the sweet strawberry-themed scene, she has a lively, cute, girly temperament, and gently rotates the handbag with soft movements to show its details.

[Shots]
Shot 1:
  - Duration: 0.0sec - 2.5sec
  - Scene Type: Handheld product display
  - Scene: A hand holds the green top handle of a strawberry-shaped handbag. The handbag has a rose-red base color, decorated with white polka dots and green strawberry calorn-shaped accents, and a transparent visible window on the front. Inside the window, a pair of pink children's slippers printed with a cartoon strawberry girl pattern are neatly placed. The hand gently rotates the handbag half a turn to reveal the gold metal clasp on the side of the bag, with soft and steady movements. The background is the full view of the pastel pink strawberry-themed bedroom. The camera stays still, showing the complete overall appearance of the handbag in a full shot perspective.
  - Subject: Lá no campo bem cedinho
Shot 2:
  - Duration: 2.5sec - 7.5sec
  - Scene Type: Handheld product display
  - Scene: The hand rotates the handbag back to the front and holds it steadily, slowly adjusting the display angle of the bag so that the cartoon slipper pattern inside the transparent window faces the camera clearly. The pink bedroom soft furnishings in the background remain a softly blurred backdrop, and the entire shape of the handbag is fully presented in the frame. The camera slowly pushes forward, with the shot transitioning from a medium shot to a close-up.
  - Subject: Nasceu um moranguinho Vem
Shot 3:
  - Duration: 7.5sec - 10.0sec
  - Scene Type: Product close-up shot
  - Scene: The hand no longer blocks the top of the frame, the camera focuses entirely on the transparent window area of the handbag. The details of the pair of pink children's slippers inside the window are clearly enlarged: the cartoon strawberry girl pattern on the upper has bright colors and a delicate design, and the pink dot texture on the sole is also fully visible. The light spreads into tiny cute sparkles on the transparent window. The camera stays still, freezing the slipper details in a close-up shot.
  - Subject: Vermelhinho, redondinho, vermelhinho
Fim!
[Background Sound]:
- Upbeat children's song style background music with a lively, brisk rhythm, bright and full volume, distinct nursery rhyme melody and children's vocals, featuring the Brazilian Portuguese strawberry-themed nursery rhyme 'Moranguinho'. The overall atmosphere is cute, heartwarming, and full of childlike fun.
[Transition / Editing]:
- Uses natural and smooth camera motion transitions throughout, no abrupt jump cuts. The entire frame maintains a bright, unified sweet pink tone, accented with scattered starlight effects to enhance the cute and dreamy atmosphere.
prompt_zh:
[Style]: 甜系少女风，整体画面以高饱和粉色作为主色调，搭配大量草莓主题元素，画面质感明亮通透，完全复刻复古草莓甜心动画周边的梦幻氛围。
[Environment]: 布置满草莓主题软装的粉色儿童卧室，白天室内光线充足柔和。背景可见带软包床头的粉色大床，床品抱枕均印草莓图案，旁侧白色置物架摆草莓造型摆件与玩偶，地面铺圆形草莓图案毛绒地毯，墙面点缀串灯与草莓装饰画。
[Tone & Pacing]: 节奏舒缓流畅，镜头动作轻柔，全程营造出软萌治愈、元气满满的分享氛围，每一个展示细节的动作都清晰且富有节奏感。
[Camera]: 采用第一人称手持展示视角，先以全景展示手提包整体外观，随后缓慢推进镜头聚焦包内的卡通拖鞋细节，全程镜头移动平稳顺滑，没有突兀晃动。
[Lighting]: 采用360度环绕式柔和打光，光线均匀铺满整个场景，无生硬阴影，把粉色系场景的通透感与草莓包包、拖鞋的鲜亮色彩完美烘托出来。
[Character]: 20-30岁年轻女性，仅露出小臂与手部，手部皮肤细腻白皙，指甲做了红色美甲点缀黑色波点草莓图案，身着淡粉色针织毛衣，风格与甜系草莓主题场景契合，气质活泼可爱充满少女心，肢体动作轻柔转动包身展示细节。

[Shots]
Shot 1:
  - 时长: 0.0sec - 2.5sec
  - 镜头类型: 手持商品展示
  - 画面: 一只手握着草莓造型手提包的顶部绿色提手，手提包为玫红色底色，搭配白色波点与绿色草莓蒂造型装饰，正面是透明可视窗口，窗口内整齐摆放着一双印着草莓女孩卡通图案的粉色儿童拖鞋。手轻轻将包身转动半圈，露出包身侧面的金色金属挂扣，动作轻柔平稳，背景是粉嫩的草莓主题卧室全景。镜头保持静止，以全景视角完整展示手提包整体外观。
  - 口播: Lá no campo bem cedinho
Shot 2:
  - 时长: 2.5sec - 7.5sec
  - 镜头类型: 手持商品展示
  - 画面: 手将包身转回正面并保持稳定握持，缓缓调整包的展示角度，让透明窗口内的卡通拖鞋图案清晰正对镜头，背景里的粉色卧室软装始终作为柔和虚化的衬托，包身整体造型完整呈现在画面中。镜头缓缓向前推近，景别从中景过渡到近景。
  - 口播: Nasceu um moranguinho Vem
Shot 3:
  - 时长: 7.5sec - 10.0sec
  - 镜头类型: 产品镜头特写
  - 画面: 手不再遮挡画面顶部空间，镜头完全聚焦在手提包的透明窗口区域，窗口内的一双粉色儿童拖鞋细节被清晰放大：鞋面上的草莓女孩卡通图案色彩鲜亮、造型精致，鞋底的粉色圆点纹理也完整呈现，光线在透明窗口上晕开细碎的可爱闪光。镜头保持静止，以近景特写画面定格拖鞋细节。
  - 口播: Vermelhinho, redondinho, vermelhinho
Fim!
[Background Sound]:
- 非常欢快的儿童歌曲风格背景音乐，节奏轻快活泼、音量明亮饱满、带有明显儿歌旋律和童声演唱，是巴西葡萄牙语草莓主题童谣《Moranguinho》，整体氛围可爱、治愈、充满童趣。
[Transition / Editing]:
- 全程采用自然流畅的镜头运动过渡，无生硬跳转剪辑，画面全程保持明亮统一的甜系粉色调，搭配零星星光特效点缀，强化可爱梦幻的氛围。

title: Kit Com  Até 10 petisqueira barquinha Plastica canoa petiscos — Handheld Demo (Brazil · Kitchenware)

prompt_en:

[Environment]: A well-lit modern residential space. The opening shows a combined living and dining area with a glass dining table and light beige fabric dining chairs, then switches to a neat and bright kitchen countertop area, and finally returns to the exquisitely arranged dining table, fully presenting a warm home atmosphere.
[Tone & Pacing]: The overall rhythm is lively and smooth, progressing step by step from unboxing demonstration to real-scene application, with coherent and natural movements. It balances the excitement of unboxing a great product and the relaxed vibe of a home sharing session, accurately conveying the product's usage value.
[Camera]: First-person handheld close-up perspective, paired with close-up shots of product details. The camera moves naturally following the hand movements, stays smooth and stable throughout the process, and accurately focuses on the appearance details and usage scenarios of the tableware.
[Lighting]: Ample soft indoor natural light mixed with even indoor fill light, no harsh shadows. The overall light is bright and clear, accurately restoring the clean texture of the white tableware and the vivid color of the sushi ingredients.
[Character]: A 25-30 year old Latina woman with a light wheat-toned natural healthy complexion. Her hand skin is delicate and clean, with neatly trimmed nails painted in nude nail polish. She wears a simple off-white casual top with loose cuffs, has a gentle and approachable temperament, and makes soft yet neat hand movements. Only her hands and part of her forearms are visible.

[Shots]

[Background Sound]:
- No background music, the entire video features a fast-paced, high-energy live Portuguese sales pitch delivered entirely by a human voice, with high information density and tight rhythm, quickly guiding viewers' attention and prompting them to complete the purchase.
[Transition / Editing]:

prompt_zh:

[Environment]: Bright and airy indoor home setting, with soft off-white walls. The blurred background corners show light wood-colored furniture and small green decorations. Later, during the product close-up segment, the background switches to a solid avocado green of the same color family, keeping the style consistent and refreshing.
[Tone & Pacing]: Relaxed, healing pace for sharing cute pet products. The opening quickly grabs the audience's attention with cat interactions, then smoothly moves on to show product details. The overall rhythm is gentle and fluid, with no unnecessary messy actions, focusing on highlighting the core selling points of the product.
[Camera]: Close-up shots are used throughout, with stable footage and no unnecessary shaking. The focus is precisely locked on the interaction details between the cat and the toy, then switches to product detail close-ups, fully presenting the toy's appearance, internal structure and installation design.
[Lighting]: Soft, even diffused indoor natural light is used, with no harsh shadows. The light spreads evenly across the frame from the front side, accurately restoring the soft texture of the cat's fur and the fresh green-yellow color scheme of the avocado-shaped toy. The entire frame is bright, clear and clean.
[Character]: No people appear in the video

[Shots]
Shot 1:
  - Duration: 0.0sec - 3.0sec
  - Scene Type: Product usage scenario
  - Scene: In a home scene with light-colored walls, a sleek silver-gray tabby cat is sitting upright, repeatedly sticking out its tongue to lick the catnip ball at the center of the avocado-shaped toy mounted on the wall. The cat looks relaxed and content, half-closing its eyes to enjoy the play process, with product promotional subtitles overlaid at the bottom of the frame.
Shot 2:
  - Duration: 3.0sec - 6.5sec
  - Scene Type: Show core ingredients (health category)
  - Scene: The camera cuts to a close-up of the avocado-shaped toy, the cat fades out of the frame. Two circular display boxes pop up sequentially on the right side of the frame, each showing real-life detailed shots of catnip leaves and another complementary herb, directly illustrating the soothing herbal ingredients built into the toy.
Shot 3:
  - Duration: 6.5sec - 10.0sec
  - Scene Type: Show ease of use
  - Scene: The background switches to a pure solid avocado green background. A pair of hands appears in the frame, first removing the top lid of the toy to reveal the embedded catnip ball inside, then flipping the toy over to show the traceless adhesive fixing structure on its back, clearly demonstrating the toy's assembly and wall-mount installation design.
  - Subject: Gracias.
[Background Sound]:
- Light, playful jazz-style instrumental background music, with clarinet as the main melody, paired with light drum beats and double bass rhythm. The overall tempo is bright and rhythmic, with a moderately low volume, creating a relaxed, cheerful and slightly retro atmosphere. It belongs to the Lo-fi Jazz or Chill Jazz style, with no lyrics throughout.
[Transition / Editing]:
- Natural fade-in and fade-out transition effects are used, smoothly moving from the real-life cat interaction scene to the product close-up shot. When connecting to the product disassembly demonstration segment later, the scene switch is completed by fading out the main subject of the frame. The overall editing rhythm is gentle and fluid, matching the healing cute style atmosphere of the video.
prompt_zh:
[Style]: 萌系治愈电商写实风，画面色彩清新自然，高光柔和透亮，整体呈现出干净舒适的宠物好物种草视觉质感。
[Environment]: 明亮通透的居家室内场景，墙面为柔和的浅白色，背景角落虚化可见浅原木色家居与绿色小装饰，后续产品特写环节切换为同色系牛油果绿色纯色背景，风格统一清爽。
[Tone & Pacing]: 轻松治愈的萌宠好物分享节奏，开篇通过猫咪互动快速抓住观众注意力，后续平稳推进产品细节展示，整体节奏舒缓流畅，全程无多余杂乱动作，专注突出产品核心卖点。
[Camera]: 全程使用近景特写镜头，画面保持稳定无多余晃动，精准对焦猫咪与玩具的互动细节，后续切换至产品细节特写，完整呈现玩具的外观、内部构造与安装设计。
[Lighting]: 采用柔和均匀的室内散射自然光，无硬阴影，光线从侧前方均匀洒向画面，精准还原猫咪毛发的柔和质感与牛油果造型玩具清新的绿黄配色，整体画面明亮通透干净。
[Character]: 无人物出镜

[Shots]
Shot 1:
  - 时长: 0.0sec - 3.0sec
  - 镜头类型: 产品使用场景
  - 画面: 居家浅色墙面场景中，一只毛色柔顺的银灰色虎斑猫正端坐站立，不断伸出舌头反复舔舐墙面牛油果造型玩具中心的猫薄荷球，猫咪神态放松惬意，半眯着眼享受玩耍过程，画面底部同步叠加产品宣传字幕。
Shot 2:
  - 时长: 3.0sec - 6.5sec
  - 镜头类型: 展示核心成分（健康品类）
  - 画面: 镜头切换至牛油果造型玩具的特写画面，猫咪从画面中淡出，画面右侧依次弹出两个圆形展示框，分别框选展示猫薄荷叶片与另一款辅助草本植物的实拍细节，直观点明玩具内置的舒缓草本成分。
Shot 3:
  - 时长: 6.5sec - 10.0sec
  - 镜头类型: 展示易用性

[Background Sound]:

[Transition / Editing]:
- 采用自然的淡入淡出转场效果，从猫咪互动的实拍场景平滑过渡到产品特写画面，后续衔接产品拆解展示环节时通过画面主体淡出的方式完成场景切换，整体剪辑节奏舒缓流畅，贴合治愈萌系的视频氛围。

title: Caixa de Areia Sanitária com Peneira para Gatos — Handheld Demo (Brazil · Pet Supplies)
creator: @museudodisco
hook_line: You love your cat but hate sifting and cleaning the litter box every day
pain_point: Cleaning litter box daily is time-consuming and troublesome
prompt_en:
[Style]: Realistic short video for home goods recommendation, with clean, bright frames, soft natural colors, highlighting the practical attributes of the product and the warm home atmosphere.
[Environment]: A bright and tidy modern home bathroom scene, with light gray matte tile flooring. The background features a shower area with a clear glass partition and a white toilet. Green plants and a woven storage basket are placed on the bathroom cabinet to the right. The entire space is clean, refreshing, and full of a cozy home vibe.
[Tone & Pacing]: A relaxed and friendly recommendation sharing style, with a smooth, brisk rhythm. The explanation and demonstration segments are well-paced, intuitively showcasing the product's advantages, and fitting the natural rhythm of daily home goods sharing.
[Camera]: Opens with a medium shot following the character's interaction, then switches to close-up shots of the product to show details. The camera moves steadily throughout, remaining completely stable without unnecessary shaking, clearly presenting the entire product operation process.
[Lighting]: Uses even, soft indoor diffused white light with no obvious harsh shadows, fully illuminating product details and the character's facial expressions to create a clean, bright home visual effect.
[Character]: A 25-30 year old Caucasian woman with smooth, delicate skin that has a natural healthy glow. Her dark brown hair is tied in a low ponytail, she has distinct, relaxed facial features, a light natural no-makeup makeup look, and a well-proportioned figure. She wears an off-white V-neck knit sweater, slim-fit blue jeans, and white casual sneakers. Her temperament is kind and gentle, full of a sharing vibe, with brisk, neat movements and a natural smile the whole time, conveying a sense of satisfaction with the product.

[Shots]
Shot 1:
  - Duration: 0.0sec - 3.0sec
  - Scene Type: Scene-based lifestyle showcase
  - Scene: In a bright, warm bathroom, the Caucasian woman with a low ponytail squats on the light gray floor. A gray and white pet cat stands in front of her, stepping around and looking around inside a black-and-white cat litter box. The woman looks at the cat with a smile, then turns her gaze to the camera. Fun Portuguese text and a cute cat meme appear at the top of the frame.
  - Subject: O segredo para uma casa sem cheiro. Bandeja espada.
Shot 2:
  - Duration: 3.0sec - 5.0sec
  - Scene Type: Product design highlights
  - Scene: The camera switches to a close-up of the cat litter box, fully showing the overall appearance of the upper sifting tray with diamond-shaped hollow grids and the lower base. Several colorful dot decorations are embellished in the upper right corner of the frame, with text at the top labeling the product name.
  - Subject: — Peneire e pronto! —
Shot 3:
  - Duration: 5.0sec - 7.0sec
  - Scene Type: Demonstrate ease of use
  - Scene: The woman steadily lifts the upper hollow sifting tray, which contains cat litter and clumped cat litter pieces. When she shakes the tray, the fine, clean cat litter leaks back through the grid gaps into the lower base, leaving only the clumped cat litter pieces in the tray. Text at the top of the frame labels the usage instructions.
  - Subject: Sem paz. Veja a parte 2.
Shot 4:
  - Duration: 7.0sec - 9.0sec
  - Scene Type: Demonstrate ease of use
  - Scene: The woman holds the sifting tray with the clumped cat litter, moves it over a beige trash bin lined with a garbage bag, and gently tilts the tray to pour all the clumped cat litter pieces completely into the trash bin. A fun arrow animation in the frame marks the trash bin area targeted by the operation.
Shot 5:
  - Duration: 9.0sec - 10.0sec
  - Scene Type: Product versatility
  - Scene: A semi-transparent pop-up window introducing product advantages appears on the frame, decorated with cute cartoon icons of a sieve, a banknote, and a black cat, intuitively showing the core advantages of this cat litter box: no shovel needed, easy operation, and complete supporting accessories.
Shot 6:
  - Duration: 10.0sec - 13.0sec
  - Scene Type: Great value price
  - Scene: The woman stands up, holding the stacked upper and lower bases of the cat litter box with both hands to show them to the camera. The gray and white cat behind her sits quietly on the bathroom floor looking at the camera. Then the camera cuts to a close-up of the full cat litter box set, and fun text pops up to mark the core advantage of saving cat litter.
  - Subject: Viu como é simples? O kit vem comprando. com duas bandejas e a peneira. Assim você economiza muito
Shot 7:
  - Duration: 13.0sec - 16.0sec
  - Scene Type: Scene-based lifestyle showcase
  - Scene: The woman stands in the middle of the bathroom. The gray and white cat voluntarily walks over to the cat litter box filled with cat litter, lifts its paw to step into the litter box to use it. The woman watches the cat gently with a smile, and text at the bottom of the frame creates a warm atmosphere of harmonious human-pet interaction.
  - Subject: muita areia no dia a dia.
Shot 8:
  - Duration: 16.0sec - 17.0sec
  - Scene Type: Product design highlights
  - Scene: The frame switches to a product information display page with a light blue background, clearly marking the specific length, width and height dimension parameters of the cat litter box, with a simple small carton icon next to it to indicate the product size.
[Background Sound]:
- Very upbeat TikTok-style background music with a brisk, lively rhythm, moderately high volume, electronic drum beats and playful synthesizer melodies. It is ideal for lifestyle/home goods marketing videos, creating a relaxed, practical, everyday atmosphere with a touch of small joyful moments, perfectly matching the product selling points of 'simple and hassle-free' and 'cost-effective and worry-free'. The music style is similar to the BGM commonly used in 'life hack' short videos, with a strong sense of rhythm that quickly grabs the audience's attention and reinforces the intuitive 'anyone can do it' operational feel.
[Transition / Editing]:
- Uses smooth scene-switching editing, naturally transitioning from human-pet interaction to product close-ups, operation demonstrations, and advantage introductions. The entire editing rhythm is brisk and smooth, with fun graphic animations interspersed to embellish the frames, matching the visual rhythm of e-commerce short video product recommendations.

title: Capinha capa de Com nome personalizado Salmos bíblicos Tema re — Handheld Demo (Brazil · Phones & Electronics)
creator: @eclin20
hook_line: Everyone is asking where I bought this phone case
prompt_en:
[Style]: E-commerce product realistic style, using soft pink tones to highlight the elegant texture of the phone case, paired with AI-generated exquisite visual details to create a warm, devout faith-focused atmosphere.
[Environment]: The opening scene is a cozy, well-furnished home living room with a light fabric sofa and a soft, hazy background blur effect; the scene then switches to a bright and tidy phone accessories store, where various phone cases are neatly displayed on shelves, with ample warm lighting and a clean, bright environment.
[Tone & Pacing]: Short video UGC product promotion style, with a smooth, gentle pace, delicate and steady camera movement, the entire video focuses on showcasing the details of the custom phone case, conveying a warm atmosphere full of the power of faith.
[Camera]: The entire video uses close-up shots, with a first-person handheld perspective to display the product, paired with slight natural camera movement to accurately capture the text and pattern details on the phone case, and finally uses a fixed camera position to shoot the full view of the phone case standing on the display stand.
[Lighting]: Soft and even indoor warm lighting, the light forms a fine diffuse reflection on the surface of the phone case, with no harsh shadows, fully presenting the soft texture of the pink case body and the clear effect of the printed text.
[Character]: Caucasian woman, only her hands are visible, aged 20-30, with delicate fair hand skin and a simple, elegant solid light beige manicure; her movements are gentle and graceful, she steadily holds the phone case with both hands to show its details, then gently places the phone case into the packaging box and slowly closes the lid.

[Shots]
Shot 1:
  - Duration: 0.0sec - 4.5sec
  - Scene Type: Handheld product display
  - Scene: Against the warm, blurred home living room background, a pair of hands holds up a light pink custom phone case, clearly showing the Portuguese Bible text, the handwritten name 'Maria', the cross pattern and the black floral line decorations on the case surface, then the hands gently and steadily place the phone case into the open pink packaging box, white Portuguese text 'POV: Sua fé tá on' appears at the top of the frame, and the label 'Feito por IA' is displayed at the bottom left of the frame.
  - Subject: Todo mundo perguntando onde comprei essa capinha de sapato.
Shot 2:
  - Duration: 4.5sec - 7.5sec
  - Scene Type: Unboxing
  - Scene: A close-up shot focuses on the pink packaging box on the table, as both hands slowly close the lid of the box and fit it smoothly onto the box body, the background remains the blurred warm living room scene.
  - Subject: celular personalizada e com versículos bíblicos Bíblicos eu amei.
Shot 3:
  - Duration: 7.5sec - 12.5sec
  - Scene Type: Handheld product display
  - Scene: The scene switches to a bright phone accessories store, one hand holds up the same pink phone case, turns the case slightly towards the camera slowly to fully display the outer outline, camera cutout details and surface printed content of the phone case, various phone accessories are displayed on the shelves in the background, the white Portuguese text 'POV: Sua fé tá on' also appears at the top of the frame.
  - Subject: Porque mil cairão ao teu lado, e deis mil à tua direita, mas não chegará a ti, somente com os teus olhos contemplarás.
Shot 4:
  - Duration: 12.5sec - 15.5sec
  - Scene Type: Product close-up shot
  - Scene: The camera switches to a wooden display stand, the pink custom phone case stands steadily on the surface of the stand, the camera shoots from a fixed position, various phone cases of different colors and styles are neatly arranged on the display rack in the background, the light evenly falls on the surface of the pink phone case, clearly showing the full appearance of the product.
  - Subject: e verás a recompensa.
[Background Sound]:
- No background music, the entire audio is a soft, devout pure vocal recording of a Portuguese Christian Bible recitation with no other background noise, at a calm and solemn rhythm.
[Transition / Editing]:
- Natural fade-in and fade-out transition effects are used between scenes, smoothly transitioning from the home unboxing scene to the store display scene, the overall editing rhythm is gentle and smooth, matching the devout and warm tone of the content.
prompt_zh:

title: Motos serra Elétrica Brushless 6 Polegadas 72V Portátil para P — Real Review (Brazil · Tools & Hardware)
creator: @sixzshop
hook_line: Never cut branches by hand again
pain_point: Cutting branches by hand is tiring and troublesome
prompt_en:
[Style]: Authentic, down-to-earth UGC-style home goods review aesthetic, with natural, unpolished visuals full of the warm, everyday charm of a community backyard, directly demonstrating the practical performance of the tool.
[Environment]: Shared courtyard area of a suburban townhome neighborhood. The first half takes place in a yard under apple trees at early morning, with neatly trimmed lawn scattered with red apples, separated by a black metal fence, with apple trees, green foliage and neighboring homes in the background. The second half shifts to a private backyard at midday, enclosed by wooden fences, with a paved path, lawn, a woodpile and unprocessed raw logs, under bright, pleasant lighting.
[Tone & Pacing]: Overall brisk and tight rhythm, opening with a playful hook to grab attention, then quickly showcasing multiple use cases for the mini chainsaw across consecutive scenes, before wrapping up with a detailed introduction to the tool, balancing pace perfectly to fit the smooth flow of short-form e-commerce video.
[Camera]: Opens with a high-angle overhead full panoramic shot that captures the entire courtyard scene and the interaction between a deer and a German Shepherd. Then cuts to a medium tracking shot that follows the woman holding the tool as she moves to demonstrate trimming vines and fruit tree branches. Finally uses a macro close-up shot that focuses on the fine details of wood chips flying as the chainsaw cuts through logs, with occasional natural, subtle camera shake.
[Lighting]: The opening scene uses soft, diffused natural morning light, with a warm, non-glaring tone that creates a calm, cozy backyard atmosphere. Subsequent scenes use ample direct natural daylight, bright and even, clearly highlighting the fine textures of the lawn, wood and the tool, with no harsh, sharp shadows.
[Character]: A middle-aged white woman around 40-45 years old, with light brown shoulder-length curly hair, a well-proportioned, relaxed build, wearing a white short-sleeve shirt with tiny polka dots, dark blue slim-fit jeans, and casual flat shoes. She has a friendly, energetic expression, smooth, efficient movements, a constant smile, and an open, approachable demeanor, like a warm next-door housewife who loves sharing practical daily items.

[Shots]
Shot 1:
  - Duration: 0.0sec - 2.5sec
  - Scene Type: Hook to build curiosity
  - Scene: High-angle overhead panoramic view of the backyard, a deer lowers its head to feed on the lawn scattered with red apples. Suddenly a German Shepherd dashes into the frame from the right, startling the deer which immediately turns and runs far across the lawn, while the shepherd stands still watching the deer flee. White Portuguese text appears at the top of the frame: 'Nunca mais vou cortar galho na mão depois disso'
  - Subject: Let's go again.
Shot 2:
  - Duration: 2.5sec - 8.5sec
  - Scene Type: Interactive story demonstration
  - Scene: The hostess walks into the backyard from the right side of the frame holding a yellow and black mini chainsaw, and easily saws through an apple-laden branch of the apple tree with one hand, the branch falls to the ground. The male host on the other side of the adjacent fence immediately steps forward, excitedly gesturing and talking to the hostess. Then the hostess bends down to pick up the freshly cut branch, and hands the branch with its apples over the fence to the male host, who reaches out to catch it. The German Shepherd stays by the hostess's side the whole time, alertly watching the surroundings. The Portuguese text at the top of the frame remains displayed
  - Subject: Why are you cutting my tree?  My property.
Shot 3:
  - Duration: 8.5sec - 11.5sec

title: Taylor Swoden Cafetera de Goteo — Talking Head (Spain · Household Appliances)

hook_line: Your coffee is ready exactly when you need it
pain_point: Waiting for coffee in the morning is time-consuming

[Environment]: A sunlit Nordic-style open-plan kitchen, with light wood cabinets paired with open wall-mounted shelves holding sealed storage jars and decorative green plants. [Tone & Pacing]: The host speaks in a friendly, natural tone, like sharing a favorite daily item with a close friend. The overall pace is slow and smooth, camera movement is steady, the character's movements are gentle, conveying a relaxed, cozy home lifestyle feeling.
[Camera]: Starts with a fixed full wide shot that fully shows the person, the coffee machine, and all furnishings on the kitchen counter. Then the camera moves forward at a constant speed, focusing into a medium close-up shot of the person and the coffee machine, keeping the center of the frame consistently on the person and product area with no unnecessary shaking.
[Lighting]: Uses soft natural light paired with indoor fill lighting. Natural light pours in through the window filtered by the blinds, evenly covering the entire kitchen space. The light is soft and not harsh, making the person's face and the metallic sheen of the coffee machine look warm and natural, creating a warm, comforting home lighting atmosphere.
[Character]: A 28-32 year old Caucasian woman with light brown slightly wavy medium-length hair, natural-looking everyday no-makeup makeup, a well-proportioned relaxed figure, wearing a light oat-colored basic crewneck knit sweater. She has a gentle, approachable temperament, soft slow movements, and wears a soft, sincere smile the entire time.

[Transition / Editing]:
- The entire transition from wide shot to close-up is completed with smooth camera pushing, no abrupt jump cuts, keeping the frame pace slow and unified. Synchronously popping up bright colored subtitles reinforce the key information of the product introduction, matching the warm home product recommendation atmosphere.

title: Davaco Collar Ojo Turco en Cristal Templado con Cadena de Plat — Handheld Demo (Spain · Jewelry Accessories & Derivatives)

Later, it cuts to a cozy indoor handmade display scene decorated with lavender herbs, natural crystals, vintage scented candles, and starry sky element backdrop fabric. [Camera]: Adopts a progressive shooting logic from wide shot to macro shot. It first uses a medium close-up to show the overall effect of the character wearing the necklace, then switches to a macro lens to focus on the pendant details, followed by a flat-lay shot to present a multi-scene jewelry catalog, and finally a handheld display shot to clearly show the product specifications. The camera movement is steady and smooth with no unnecessary shaking
[Lighting]: Uses warm golden sunset natural light during golden hour as the main light source, which softly outlines the translucent luster of the pendant crystal and the fine texture of the silver chain. The indoor scene uses softened fairy light warm light as the auxiliary light source. The overall light and shadow are even and warm, with almost no harsh shadows
[Character]: A 25-30 year old Caucasian woman and a 28-35 year old Caucasian man. The woman has clear, firm skin with a natural warm golden glow, a no-makeup makeup look, and wears a white sleeveless V-neck linen dress. The man has sharp facial features with no heavy makeup, and wears an off-white loose linen long-sleeve shirt. Both have a relaxed, calm temperament, slow movements, and a gentle, serene expression

[Shots]

  - Duration: 0.0sec - 6.5sec
  - Scene Type: Product material showcase

  - Duration: 6.5sec - 12.0sec

The visible subjects are the upper half side profile of the male model and a woman's hand holding up the pendant

Shot 3:
  - Duration: 12.0sec - 21.0sec

She slowly turns her body, the evil eye pendant on her neck sways gently with her movement, and the sunlight falls exactly on the pendant surface, revealing a warm translucent luster. She slowly looks up towards the camera, showing a serene and gentle smile
  - Subject: veinticinco cómodo para llevar cada día Amén. o para hacer un regalo muy especial.

Spanish subtitles about the gift box configuration and guidance to click the link to purchase pop up sequentially at the bottom of the frame, with no people appearing in the shot

[Environment]: 明亮温馨的现代化咖啡馆室内场景，浅木色家具搭配柔和的线条轨道射灯，背景点缀繁茂绿植与整齐陈列的酒瓶木架，窗边透入自然柔光，桌面摆放一杯拉花精致的热拿铁，整体氛围舒适日常。
[Tone & Pacing]: 种草分享风格，节奏流畅明快，镜头在人物使用场景与产品特写之间自然切换，叙事节奏松紧有度，清晰传递产品防窥、易安装的核心卖点。
[Camera]: 全景场景交代 + 第一人称特写手持视角 + 产品3D展示跟拍 + 微距细节镜头，镜头切换自然顺滑，精准聚焦手机屏幕与保护膜的核心细节。
[Lighting]: 以咖啡馆顶部柔和的轨道射灯作为主照明，搭配窗边透入的自然漫射光，光线均匀柔和，无生硬阴影，清晰呈现手机屏幕的防窥黑屏效果与保护膜的顺滑质感。
[Character]: 白人女性，25-30岁，皮肤细腻白皙有自然健康光泽，深棕色及肩短发，五官立体，清新日常淡妆，身着米白色宽松针织毛衣，身形匀称，气质温婉知性，握持手机动作轻柔自然，神情专注放松，面带淡笑。

[Shots]
Shot 1:
  - 时长: 0.0sec - 1.5sec
  - 镜头类型: 点明痛点问题
  - 画面: 明亮温馨的咖啡馆内，女生坐在木质圆桌前低头专注地用双手握持白色手机查看内容，身旁的男士坐在她身侧，视线方向朝向女生手中的手机。桌面上摆放着一杯冒着淡淡热气的白色拿铁咖啡杯与陶瓷杯碟，画面顶部显示蓝色文字“Protector de pantalla antiespía”，画面左下角有一个红色箭头指向女生握持手机的手部位置。
  - 口播: ¿Cansado de que miren tu celular en el transporte o la oficina?
Shot 2:
  - 时长: 1.5sec - 3.5sec
  - 镜头类型: 产品有效性
  - 画面: 镜头切换为手部特写，女生的双手握持着贴有防窥保护膜的手机，手机屏幕从旁人侧视角度看呈现完全黑屏状态，屏幕表面清晰倒映出女生的脸部轮廓，女生的一根手指轻点在黑屏的保护膜表面。黄色文字依次出现在画面中，红色箭头持续指向女生手部位置，背景是虚化的咖啡杯与咖啡馆绿植场景。
  - 口播: ¿Cansado de que miren tu celular en el transporte o la oficina?
Shot 3:
  - 时长: 3.5sec - 7.5sec
  - 镜头类型: 展示易用性
  - 画面: 首先展示点亮的手机彩色壁纸界面，随后镜头切换为产品3D演示画面，透明防窥保护膜从屏幕前方缓缓贴近悬浮的手机机身，精准对齐手机屏幕边框完成贴合动作。随后画面切换到微距特写视角，展示手机平稳放置在浅灰色键盘按键上，屏幕上的保护膜紧密贴合手机边缘，做工细腻精致。顶部黄色文字依次展示，红色箭头指向手机底部位置，背景为虚化的咖啡馆室内环境。
  - 口播: Con este protector anti-espía, solo tú verás tu pantalón. y muy fácil de instalar
Shot 4:
  - 时长: 7.5sec - 11.0sec
  - 镜头类型: 产品使用场景
  - 画面: 镜头切回咖啡馆全景场景，女生双手重新握持手机低头查看屏幕，身侧男士依旧坐在一旁。随后再次切换到手部特写画面，女生双手握持手机，屏幕从旁人视角呈现黑屏状态，手指轻点保护膜表面，随后手机屏幕自动点亮，清晰显示出彩色的手机壁纸界面与底部的手电筒、相机快捷图标。黄色文字同步展示，红色箭头指向女生手部位置，背景为虚化的咖啡馆桌面咖啡杯场景。
  - 口播: y muy fácil de instalar Gracias.
Shot 5:
  - 时长: 11.0sec - 15.0sec
  - 镜头类型: 下单流程指引
  - 画面: 再次进入产品3D演示环节，透明防窥保护膜从屏幕前方缓缓贴近手机机身完成贴合，随后微距镜头再次展示放置在浅灰色键盘按键上的手机，保护膜紧密贴合手机边缘，光线照射在保护膜表面形成细腻的光泽感。画面中显示蓝色推广文字“¡Lleva el tuyo ahora entrando en el carrito!”，红色箭头指向手机底部位置。
  - 口播: Gracias.
[Background Sound]:
- 非常欢快的TikTok风格背景音乐，节奏轻快活泼、音量适中偏高、带有电子合成器和鼓点驱动的流行节奏，风格类似viral TikTok dance pop，适配现代科技产品带货场景，营造轻松时尚、高性价比的购物氛围，有效增强用户注意力与购买冲动。
[Transition / Editing]:
- 采用流畅的场景跳转剪辑，在日常使用实景与产品3D演示画面之间自然切换，每处转场衔接顺滑，全程保持短视频明快的种草节奏，突出产品核心卖点。

title: Zapatos Crocs Crocs Classic Clog unisex — Handheld Demo (Spain · Shoes)
creator: @bysimplytam
hook_line: Summer is slipping away, but don't stop wearing your Crocs
visuals: Hand with Pink Polka Dot Nails
prompt_en:
[Style]: Bright summery realistic style, the frame is full of sunlit clarity, using a fresh first-person perspective to capture shoe details up close, paired with playful handwritten-style text, brimming with casual lifestyle atmosphere, overall visual is bright and lively.
[Environment]: Outdoors by a summer swimming pool, bright and intense lighting, the ground is covered with a light-colored non-slip mat with textured bumps, next to it is a light brown non-slip stone pool deck, clear sharp shadows cast by sunlight on the ground, full of summer vacation leisure vibe.
[Tone & Pacing]: Lighthearted and lively summer good-item sharing atmosphere, snappy smooth camera rhythm, overall tight pacing, every shot focuses on showcasing the footwear details, camera movement keeps the frame dynamic.
[Camera]: Entirely shot from a first-person overhead close-up perspective, the lens is aimed at the clogs at close range, slowly panning to sequentially display upper decorations and buckle details, with slight natural shake to replicate the authentic handheld shooting feel.
[Lighting]: Bright abundant direct summer natural sunlight, strong and clear light that creates distinct highlights and shadows on the clog upper, making the rhinestone details of the decorative charms sparkle even more, the whole frame presents a warm-toned bright texture.
[Character]: 20-30 year old young Caucasian woman, with smooth natural foot skin, and delicate light pink polka dot manicure on her hands. Only part of her calves, feet and hands are visible, no full face appears, wearing casual relaxed summer style outfits, with the laid-back vibe of a summer lifestyle product sharing content creator.

[Shots]
Shot 1:
  - Duration: 0.0sec - 2.5sec
  - Scene Type: Product design highlights
  - Scene: First-person overhead shot looking down at the black Crocs clogs worn on the wearer's own feet, the upper is decorated with rhinestone charms shaped like a bear, four-leaf clover, pink heart, and small flower. The person's feet stay relaxed, the camera slowly pans to the right, handwritten-style Spanish text 'El verano se nos escapa, pero no es motivo para dejar de usar tus crocs' is overlaid at the top of the frame.
Shot 2:
  - Duration: 2.5sec - 5.0sec
  - Scene Type: Product detail showcase
  - Scene: The shot cuts to a close-up of the other clog placed on the non-slip mat, this shoe's upper is fitted with charms shaped like a puppy, heart, small flower, and faux rhinestone. The camera slowly zooms in and orbits around the shoe, clearly showing every decorative detail on the upper, the same handwritten-style Spanish text remains at the top of the frame.
Shot 3:
  - Duration: 5.0sec - 7.5sec
  - Scene Type: Product material showcase
  - Scene: A hand with light pink polka dot manicure enters the frame, gently lifts the heel strap of the clog to show the engraved brand text on the strap, then the fingers glide softly along the strap, flip the clog over to display the breathable granular texture details on the shoe interior, the handwritten-style Spanish text still stays at the top of the frame.
  - Subject: Bye.
Shot 4:
  - Duration: 7.5sec - 11.0sec
  - Scene Type: Usage scenario setup
  - Scene: The shot switches to the perspective of two feet wearing the clogs stepping on a pebble-textured ground, 6 small reference thumbnails of clogs paired with white socks are overlaid in the middle of the frame, bold prominent black Spanish text 'Puedes usarlas todo el año, te las dejo en el carrito' is overlaid at the top of the frame, the camera slowly pans to the left to fully show all the decorative charm details on both shoes.
  - Subject: Daddy's, yeah. Bye.
[Background Sound]:
- Very upbeat TikTok EDM-style background music, fast tempo around 128 BPM, loud volume with strong drum beats and synthesizer melodies, likely the viral short video hit 'Stop Drop and Roll'. The track includes 'da-da-da' vocal samples and 'Uh-uh-uh' shout segments, with a highly catchy distinct rhythm perfectly suited for fast-paced trendy footwear showcase footage.
[Transition / Editing]:
- Uses natural same-color scene gradient transitions, smoothly shifting from the light brown stone poolside ground to the white non-slip mat footage, seamless and natural, maintaining consistent bright summery visual tone throughout.
prompt_zh:
[Style]: 夏日明亮写实风，画面充满阳光通透感，以清新第一视角近距离拍摄鞋履细节，搭配俏皮手写风格文字，充满生活氛围感，整体视觉明亮活泼。
[Environment]: 夏日户外泳池边，光线充足强烈，地面铺有凹凸纹理浅色防滑地垫，旁侧是浅棕色防滑石材池岸，地面留有阳光投射的清晰影子，充满夏日休闲度假氛围。
[Tone & Pacing]: 轻松活泼的夏日好物分享氛围，镜头节奏明快流畅，整体节奏紧凑，每一个镜头都聚焦于鞋履细节展示，通过运镜移动让画面充满动感。
[Camera]: 全程采用第一人称俯视特写视角，镜头近距离对准洞洞鞋，随镜头缓慢移动依次展示鞋面装饰、鞋扣细节，带有轻微自然晃动，还原手持拍摄的真实质感。
[Lighting]: 明亮充足的夏日直射自然光，光线强烈通透，在洞洞鞋鞋面上形成清晰的光泽与阴影，让装饰配件的闪钻细节更加亮眼，整体画面呈现暖调的明亮质感。
[Character]: 20-30岁年轻白人女性，脚部皮肤细腻自然，手部做了精致的淡粉色波点美甲，仅露出部分小腿、脚部与手部，无正脸出镜，身着夏日休闲随性风格穿搭，气质是随性休闲的夏日好物分享博主。

[Shots]
Shot 1:
  - 时长: 0.0sec - 2.5sec
  - 镜头类型: 产品设计亮点
  - 画面: 第一视角俯视拍摄自己脚上穿着的黑色Crocs洞洞鞋，鞋面上装饰着小熊、四叶草、粉色爱心、小花造型的闪钻装饰扣，人物脚部保持放松状态，镜头缓慢向右移动，画面顶部叠加手写风格西语文字“El verano se nos escapa, pero no es motivo para dejar de usar tus crocs”。
Shot 2:
  - 时长: 2.5sec - 5.0sec
  - 镜头类型: 产品细节展示
  - 画面: 镜头切换到放在防滑地垫上的另一只洞洞鞋特写，这只鞋子的鞋面上搭配着小狗造型、爱心、小花、仿钻造型的装饰扣，镜头缓慢拉近环绕鞋子移动，清晰展示鞋面的所有装饰细节，画面顶部同样保留手写风格西语文字。
Shot 3:
  - 时长: 5.0sec - 7.5sec
  - 镜头类型: 产品材质展示
  - 画面: 一只带着淡粉色波点美甲的手伸入画面，轻轻抬起洞洞鞋的后跟绑带，展示绑带上刻印的品牌字样，随后手指顺着绑带轻轻滑动，翻转洞洞鞋展示鞋内部的透气颗粒纹理细节，画面顶部仍保留手写风格西语文字。
  - 口播: Bye.
Shot 4:
  - 时长: 7.5sec - 11.0sec
  - 镜头类型: 设置使用场景
  - 画面: 画面切换到双脚穿着洞洞鞋踩在鹅卵石纹理地面的视角，画面中间叠加6小张洞洞鞋搭配白袜的穿搭参考小图，画面上方叠加黑色醒目西语文字“Puedes usarlas todo el año, te las dejo en el carrito”，镜头缓慢向左移动，完整展示两只鞋子上的所有装饰配件细节。
  - 口播: Daddy's, yeah. Bye.
[Background Sound]:
- 非常欢快的TikTok电子舞曲风格背景音乐，快节奏约128BPM，音量较大，带有强烈鼓点和合成器旋律，疑似为短视频热曲《Stop Drop and Roll》，音乐中夹杂有“哒哒哒”人声采样和“Uh-uh-uh”呼喊段落，节奏感洗脑鲜明，适配潮流鞋品展示的快节奏画面。
[Transition / Editing]:
- 采用自然的同色系场景渐变转场，从泳池边浅棕色石材地面平滑过渡到白色防滑地垫画面，衔接流畅自然，全程保持夏日明亮的视觉统一感。

title: Women's Lace-Up Casual Sneakers — Handheld Demo (Spain · Shoes)
creator: @magiazucar
hook_line: This sneaker combines comfort and style
prompt_en:
[Style]: Fashion e-commerce realistic style, with fresh and bright colors, transparent and delicate light and shadow texture, focusing on highlighting the trendy appearance and versatile daily attributes of women's casual sports shoes.
[Environment]: Two shooting scenarios: the indoor area is a simple display zone with a light gray faux brick textured background wall and a dark gray matte countertop, accented with green areca palm foliage in the corner; the outdoor area is a sunny daytime urban residential neighborhood walkway with lush green plants on both sides and modern low-rise buildings visible in the distance, creating a casual and comfortable atmosphere.
[Tone & Pacing]: The overall pace is brisk and compact, with smooth and crisp scene transitions, paired with guiding dynamic arrows and eye-catching promotional text to convey a relaxed and lively product recommendation vibe, balancing clear product detail display and the natural dynamic feel of the outdoor walking scene.
[Camera]: Centered on close-up shots of product details, paired with low-angle follow shots to restore the walking state. Camera movements include small-range rotational follow shots and partial detail focus panning, keeping the shoe product as the full-frame focus to ensure every design detail is clearly presented.
[Lighting]: Indoors, even and soft overhead softbox lighting is used, with no harsh shadows, to restore the true blue and white color scheme of the shoe body; outdoors, natural daylight from the golden hour is used, with a soft sun angle that casts clear, natural shadows of pedestrians and footwear on the ground, enhancing the vivid atmosphere of the frame.
[Character]: Only the legs, feet and hands of a 20-35 year old young woman are shown on camera. Her foot skin is smooth and delicate with a natural healthy wheat tone, and her leg lines are well-proportioned and slender. She wears slim-fit blue cropped jeans with frayed hems, blue and white color-block casual sports shoes, and a thin blue-beaded ankle bracelet, with a relaxed, casual, energetic temperament and smooth, natural movements.

[Shots]
Shot 1:
  - Duration: 0.0sec - 2.5sec
  - Scene Type: Product Material Display
  - Scene: In a simple indoor scene, the character stands wearing the blue and white casual sports shoes, then gently lifts one foot to point the sole toward the camera for display. The frame simultaneously shows the white stripe design on the side of the shoe and the brown granular non-slip outsole. Yellow title text pops up at the top of the frame, with a downward-pointing dynamic arrow in the center. Close-up shot of the foot wearing the sports shoe, focusing on the non-slip tread of the outsole and the overall silhouette of the shoe, with a light gray faux brick wall and dark gray countertop in the background.
  - Subject: Cubre la comodidad y el estilo de estas zapatillas.
Shot 2:
  - Duration: 2.5sec - 4.5sec
  - Scene Type: Product Design Highlights
  - Scene: The shot cuts to a view of both hands holding up a pair of the same style blue and white sports shoes. The hands gently rotate the shoe to fully display the text label on the tongue, the spliced materials of the shoe body and the overall color scheme, while the character's feet wearing the same pair of shoes are visible in the background for coordination and contrast. Close-up shot of the details of the sports shoes held up by both hands, the downward-pointing dynamic arrow remains on the frame, clearly presenting the materials and design details of the shoe.
Shot 3:
  - Duration: 4.5sec - 5.5sec
  - Scene Type: Set Usage Scenario
  - Scene: The scene switches to an outdoor urban walkway, a low-angle shot follows the character's footsteps moving forward as the character walks naturally wearing the sports shoes, with sunlight casting clear shadows on the ground. Follow shot showing the dynamic view of wearing the sports shoes while walking on the walkway, highlighting the comfort of the footwear that fits daily travel scenarios, the downward-pointing dynamic arrow remains on the frame.
  - Subject: ligeras y perfectas para todas las estaciones.
Shot 4:
  - Duration: 5.5sec - 7.0sec
  - Scene Type: Product Usage Scenario
  - Scene: The scene returns to the indoor display area, a pair of blue and white casual sports shoes are placed steadily on the dark gray countertop. The camera uses a fixed full-view angle to shoot the complete appearance and placement effect of the shoes, with a light gray faux brick wall and green plant accents in the background. Full-view static display of the pair of sports shoes placed on the countertop, the downward-pointing dynamic arrow remains on the frame, clearly presenting the overall styling effect of the shoe model.
  - Subject: con confianza
Shot 5:
  - Duration: 7.0sec - 9.0sec
  - Scene Type: Product Material Display
  - Scene: In the simple indoor scene, the character gently lifts one foot again, slowly rotating the sole toward the camera to focus on showing the granular non-slip tread details of the outsole. Close-up shot of the outsole and side splicing design of the sports shoe, the downward-pointing dynamic arrow remains on the frame, allowing viewers to clearly see the non-slip structure of the outsole.
Shot 6:
  - Duration: 9.0sec - 11.0sec
  - Scene Type: Product Design Highlights
  - Scene: The shot cuts back to the view of both hands holding up the sports shoe, the hands slightly adjust the angle of the shoe to secondarily show the tongue label, the white stripe decoration on the shoe body and the toe cap design, with the shot of the same shoe worn on the foot in the background as a contrast. Close-up secondary display of the multi-dimensional details of the sports shoe, the downward-pointing dynamic arrow remains on the frame, reinforcing viewers' memory of the shoe's design.
  - Subject: ¡Gracias!
Shot 7:
  - Duration: 11.0sec - 13.0sec
  - Scene Type: Situational Lifestyle Showcase
  - Scene: The scene switches again to the outdoor urban walkway, a low-angle follow shot captures the character walking forward wearing the sports shoes, eye-catching yellow promotional text pops up at the top of the frame, and sunlight falls on the green plants and building background of the walkway. Dynamic display of the natural state of wearing the sports shoes while walking outdoors, highlighting the daily wearability of the product, the downward-pointing dynamic arrow remains on the frame.
  - Subject: Gracias.
Shot 8:
  - Duration: 13.0sec - 14.5sec
  - Scene Type: Product Close-up Shot
  - Scene: Return to the indoor display area, a pair of blue and white casual sports shoes are placed on the dark gray countertop, the camera uses a fixed full-view angle for the closing shot, and the promotional text at the top of the frame remains displayed. Full-view static closing shot showing the complete shoe model on the countertop, the downward-pointing dynamic arrow remains on the frame, completing the final visual presentation of the product.
[Background Sound]:
- Upbeat, lively TikTok-style background music with a brisk, energetic rhythm, moderately high volume, and electronic pop elements. The melody has a strong sense of rhythm and a repetitive chorus, perfect for fashion casual product promotion videos that effectively boost viewers' mood and purchase desire. The style is similar to the popular 'Upbeat Pop Dance' or 'Viral TikTok Beat' of the moment, tailored to showcase comfortable, fashionable, all-season casual sports shoes.
[Transition / Editing]:
- Adopt a fast alternating scene jump editing method, seamlessly switching between indoor product detail displays and outdoor walking scenes, paired with consistent guiding arrows and text elements to maintain a unified overall visual style. The editing rhythm matches the dynamic beat of the background music to create a smooth and lively visual experience.
prompt_zh:
[Style]: 时尚电商写实风，画面色彩清新明快，光影质感通透细腻，重点突出女款休闲运动鞋的潮流外观与日常百搭属性。
[Environment]: 分为两个拍摄场景，室内是带浅灰仿砖纹理背景墙、深灰色哑光台面的简洁展示区，角落点缀绿色散尾葵；户外是晴朗白日的城市居民街区步道，两侧有茂密绿植，远处可见现代低层建筑，氛围日常舒适。
[Tone & Pacing]: 整体节奏明快紧凑，画面切换流畅利落，搭配引导性动态箭头与醒目促销文字，传递轻松活泼的好物推荐氛围，兼顾产品细节展示清晰度与户外行走场景的自然动感。

hook_line: Wow, look, this popular twist mop is being produced, the offer looks super attractive now, curious check it out

prompt_en:
[Style]: Factory-realistic e-commerce product promotion style, with bright and vivid images, clear display of product details, and a down-to-earth promotional atmosphere.
[Environment]: The opening scene is a bright mop production workshop with green floor paint, piles of unassembled mops next to the assembly line, and workers busy packing; then it switches to a home living room with light beige marble tiles, a blue sofa, large French windows and light-colored furniture; finally it returns to a finished product warehouse full of express cartons, with conveyor belts and shelves filled with goods to be shipped, the overall space is open and bright.
[Tone & Pacing]: Enthusiastic local Indonesian product promotion style, with a fast and compact pace, every action is closely linked to the product selling points, no dragging or redundant footage, maintaining a high-attention sales rhythm throughout.
[Camera]: Starts with a standing medium close-up, paired with product close-up shots to show the details of squeezing water and mopping the floor, uses a moving follow shot to track the character walking in the warehouse, the camera perspective fits the natural feel of daily short video shooting.
[Lighting]: The workshop and warehouse use sufficient industrial ceiling lighting, with uniform brightness and no obvious shadows, fully showing the real texture of the production and logistics scenes; the home scene uses soft indoor natural light pouring in through the French windows, creating a clean and warm home atmosphere.
[Character]: 25-30 year old East Asian woman, with natural, clear and healthy skin, smooth facial skin, shoulder-length short hair, soft round face, bright and energetic eyes, and a very approachable smile; wears light daily makeup, has a well-proportioned figure, wears a blue denim jacket over a white T-shirt paired with black trousers, looks casual and neat, is enthusiastic, cheerful and energetic, keeps smiling throughout, has rich body movements, full of strong emotional appeal.

[Shots]

  - Duration: 0.0sec - 8.0sec
  - Scene Type: Set up the usage scenario
  - Scene: Inside a bright mop production workshop with green floor paint, piles of unassembled green-handle spin mops are stacked next to the assembly line, workers are busy packing mop heads into cartons, and packaging materials are neatly stacked on the background shelves. The female lead stands next to the mountain of green-handle spin mops, holding a complete mop in her left hand, pointing at the neatly arranged mop heads on the ground with her right hand, smiling and enthusiastically explaining to the camera.
  - Subject: Waduh, lihat sendiri nih, pel putar semut bersih lagi ramai diproses Dan penawarannya sekarang kelihatan menarik banget, penasaran. Cek sendiri.

  - Scene Type: Demonstrate ease of use
  - Scene: In a home scene with light beige marble-textured tiles, a man holds the green mop handle, presses the water-soaked mop head down hard into a transparent bucket, the water in the mop head is squeezed into the bucket, then the man raises his hand to show that his hands never touch the wet mop head during the whole process.
  - Subject: Tinggal dorong aja, airnya sudah terperas, otomatis nggak perlu kita menyentuh kain pelnya pakai tangan.

  - Scene Type: Demonstrate product effectiveness
  - Scene: Yellow stains are pre-spilled on the ground, the character holds the wrung-out mop head and quickly swipes across the stained area, completely cleaning up the ground stains in just two strokes, leaving a clean tile surface.

  - Scene Type: Situational lifestyle showcase
  - Scene: In a bright home living room with a blue sofa, large French windows and light-colored minimalist furniture in the background, the female sales host holds the mop rod with both hands, stands on the clean tile floor to demonstrate the easy mopping action, stops from time to time to share and explain to the camera, looking relaxed and happy.

  - Subject: Jangan cuma lihat, cek produknya di keranjang belanja.

  - Subject: Mumpung penawarannya masih terakhir. Tersedia.
[Background Sound]:
- Very upbeat TikTok-style background music, with a brisk and lively rhythm, moderately high volume, featuring electronic drum beats and playful synthesizer melodies. It is suitable for daily necessities/home cleaning product sales videos, creating a shopping atmosphere of 'surprise + practicality + high cost-effectiveness', with an overall positive mood and strong sense of urgency, reinforcing the audience's desire to act by highlighting selling points such as 'limited-time offer' and 'no need to touch dirty cloths by hand'.
[Transition / Editing]:
- Uses sharp direct scene cuts to quickly transition from the factory production scene to the home use demonstration, then back to the warehouse shipping scene, the editing rhythm is compact, and the visual focus is always locked on the product selling points.
