[Environment]: The opening scene features a minimalist, light luxury home display nook: a white stepped display stand paired with an off-white background wall trimmed with gold, and a glass vase filled with dried pampas grass placed in the corner. The latter part seamlessly transitions to the interior of a high-end brand shoe store, where various leather shoes and apparel are neatly arranged in warm-lit display cabinets, with soft, bright lighting throughout the store.
[Tone & Pacing]: The overall tone of product recommendation is friendly and natural, with a well-balanced rhythm: gradually moving from a full panoramic view of the product to close-up detail shots, interspersed with wearing and touching demonstration actions. The rhythm remains smooth and steady when switching to the store scene later, guiding the audience to gradually perceive the texture and advantages of the product throughout the entire video.
[Camera]: Primarily uses product close-ups and macro detail shots, paired with smooth push-pull zoom shots: the opening panoramic shot freezes on the full view of the slippers, then the camera slowly pushes forward to focus on the leather grain, then follows the foot entering the frame to capture the on-foot wearing shot, later rotates 360 degrees around the slippers to shoot multi-angle details, and finally pans and pulls back to switch to the full panoramic view of the shoe store.
[Lighting]: Uses soft, even professional lighting, with a warm white main light source illuminating the leather surface from the side, clearly highlighting the natural grain and delicate luster of the leather, forming soft highlights at the stitching and brand nameplate, with natural shadow transitions and no harsh dark corners, maximizing the display of the luxurious high-end texture of the leather slippers throughout the process.
[Character]: No on-screen full-body characters, only the feet and hands of a 25-45 year old white adult man are visible. The foot skin is clean and smooth, the knuckle lines of the hand are sharp, and the limb lines are well-proportioned and slender. The movements are gentle and precise: the foot naturally slides into the slipper to complete the snug wearing action, and the fingers gently press the leather strap on the surface of the slipper to demonstrate the softness of the leather.

[Shots]
Shot 1:
  - Duration: 0.0sec - 3.0sec
  - Scene Type: Build suspense
  - Scene: A pair of dark brown ARKAPOLO men's leather slippers are neatly placed on a white stepped display stand, with an off-white wall trimmed with gold and a vase holding pampas grass in the background. The camera slowly pushes forward from a panoramic view, focusing on the overall silhouette and delicate leather grain of the slippers. The brand logo is clearly displayed at the top of the frame, fully presenting the classic retro outline of the slippers, the even stitching, and the brand name embossed on the insole, with natural soft luster emanating from the leather surface.
  - Subject: Jangan beli sandal kulit Arcapolo ini kalau nggak mau.
Shot 2:
  - Duration: 3.0sec - 5.0sec
  - Scene Type: Creator personal testing experience
  - Scene: A man's foot slowly enters the frame from the top, naturally stepping into the leather slipper in the foreground. The top of the foot fits perfectly with the leather footbed of the slipper, easily completing the wearing action, clearly demonstrating the on-foot adaptability of the slipper. The foot slowly slides into the slipper and adjusts to a comfortable state, fully showing the slipper's tolerance for different foot shapes, intuitively conveying the on-foot comfort of the product.
  - Subject: Serius? Awalnya aku kira serius.
Shot 3:
  - Duration: 5.0sec - 9.5sec
  - Scene Type: Product material demonstration
  - Scene: The foot moves out of the frame, the camera returns to the full panoramic view of the slippers on the white display stand. The camera slowly orbits around the slippers, sequentially showing multiple details including the outer stitching of the slippers, the metal brand nameplate, and the inner edge binding. The concave-convex texture of the leather grain is clearly outlined by the light. The camera captures every craftsmanship detail of the slippers at close range: even exposed stitching, polished luster of the metal nameplate, and natural texture of the embossed leather, comprehensively highlighting the exquisite craftsmanship of the product.
  - Subject: Tandal ini harganya mahal karena tampilannya premium. banget.
Shot 4:
  - Duration: 9.5sec - 17.5sec
  - Scene Type: Great value price
  - Scene: The camera pulls back again to return to the full panoramic view of the slippers, then continues with smooth push-pull zoom movements, sequentially aiming at the inner lining of the slipper opening, the side hollow decoration, the heel radian and other parts for close-up shooting. The whole process focuses on product detail display, the camera accurately switches between different detail perspectives, clearly presenting the skin-friendly material of the slipper inner lining, the stitching craftsmanship of the side strap, and the smooth radian of the sole, enhancing the luxurious texture performance of the product.
  - Subject: Ternyata sandal Arkapolo ini lagi turun harga. Dengan tampilan semewah ini, banyak yang ngira-ngira. Harganya di atas seratus ribuan, makanya jangan berhubung.
Shot 5:
  - Duration: 17.5sec - 19.0sec
  - Scene Type: Limited time offer
  - Scene: The index finger of a hand gently presses the leather strap on the surface of the slipper, then the fingertip slowly slides across the stitching position at the edge of the strap, fully demonstrating the soft rebound property of the leather and the firm craftsmanship of the stitching. The finger movement is gentle and steady: the leather naturally produces slight deformation when pressed and quickly rebounds, intuitively reflecting the soft texture of high-quality leather. The finger moves along the entire stitching path, highlighting the neat and meticulous workmanship.
  - Subject: kaget pas lihat harga promonya sekarang, coba
[Background Sound]:
- A highly upbeat TikTok-style background music track with a brisk, rising tempo, moderately high volume, electronic drum beats and a playful synthesizer melody. It is tailored for short product promotion videos targeting young consumer groups, creating an atmosphere of surprise promotions and impulsive product recommendation. The track style resembles original promotional BGM themed around trendy flash sales or shopping sprees, paired with surprising pricing and premium visual content to boost conversion impulse.
[Transition / Editing]:
- The shots are naturally connected through smooth zoom push-pull between detail close-ups and panoramic views. Finally, a scene-blending transition method replaces the original home background with the high-end shoe store background to achieve a smooth scene transition. The overall editing rhythm follows the progression logic of the voiceover, highlighting the detailed selling points of the product.
prompt_zh:
[Style]: 电商产品写实展示风，画面质感精致高级，主打突出皮拖鞋的优质皮革纹理、精湛做工与经典复古的奢华外观，营造出平价也能拥有高端质感的视觉效果。
[Environment]: 开篇是简约轻奢的家居展示角：白色阶梯状展示台搭配米白色带金色包边的背景墙，角落摆放插满蒲苇干花的玻璃花瓶；后半段无缝切换至高端品牌鞋店内部，暖光陈列柜里整齐摆放着各式皮鞋与服饰，店内光线柔和通透。
[Tone & Pacing]: 整体种草安利的语气亲切自然，节奏张弛有度：从产品全貌全景逐步推进到细节特写，穿插试穿、触摸展示动作，后期切换店铺场景时节奏保持平缓流畅，全程引导观众逐步深入感知产品的质感与优势。
[Camera]: 以产品特写、微距细节镜头为主，搭配流畅的推拉变焦镜头：开篇全景定格拖鞋全貌，随后镜头缓慢向前推进聚焦皮革纹理，接着跟随足部入镜拍摄上脚试穿画面，后续环绕拖鞋360°转动拍摄多角度细节，最后平移拉远切换至鞋店全景画面。
[Lighting]: 采用柔和均匀的专业打光，以暖白色主光源从侧面打亮皮革表面，清晰凸显皮质的自然纹理与细腻光泽，在缝线、品牌铭牌处形成柔和高光，阴影过渡自然无生硬暗角，全程最大化展现皮拖鞋的奢华高级质感。
[Character]: 无出镜人物，仅露出白人男性的足部与手部，25-45岁成年男性，足部肌肤干净光滑，手部指节线条利落，肢体线条匀称修长，动作轻柔精准，足部自然伸入拖鞋完成试穿贴合动作，手指轻轻按压拖鞋表面的皮革饰带展示皮质柔软度。

[Shots]
Shot 1:
  - 时长: 0.0sec - 3.0sec
  - 镜头类型: 制造悬念
  - 画面: 白色阶梯展示台上整齐摆放着一双深棕色ARKAPOLO男士皮拖鞋，背景是米白配金色包边的墙面与插着蒲苇的花瓶，镜头从全景缓慢向前推进，聚焦拖鞋的整体版型与细腻皮革纹理，画面上方清晰露出品牌logo标识，完整呈现拖鞋经典复古的轮廓、均匀的缝线走线以及压印在鞋垫上的品牌字样，皮革表面透出自然的柔光质感。
  - 口播: Jangan beli sandal kulit Arcapolo ini kalau nggak mau.
Shot 2:
  - 时长: 3.0sec - 5.0sec
  - 镜头类型: 博主亲测体验
  - 画面: 一只男性的脚从画面上方缓缓入镜，自然踩进前景位置的皮拖鞋中，脚面与拖鞋的皮革鞋床完全贴合，轻松完成试穿动作，清晰展示拖鞋的上脚适配度，足部缓慢伸入拖鞋并调整至舒适状态，完整呈现拖鞋对脚型的包容度，直观传递出产品的上脚舒适感。
  - 口播: Serius? Awalnya aku kira serius.
Shot 3:
  - 时长: 5.0sec - 9.5sec
  - 镜头类型: 产品材质展示
  - 画面: 脚部移出画面，镜头回到白色展示台的拖鞋全景，镜头围绕拖鞋缓慢环绕转动，先后展示拖鞋的外侧缝线、金属品牌铭牌、内里包边等多处细节，皮革纹理的凹凸质感被光线清晰勾勒出来，镜头近距离捕捉拖鞋的每一处做工细节：均匀的明线走线、金属铭牌的打磨光泽、压纹皮革的自然肌理，全方位凸显产品的精湛工艺。
  - 口播: Tandal ini harganya mahal karena tampilannya premium. banget.
Shot 4:
  - 时长: 9.5sec - 17.5sec
  - 镜头类型: 超值价格
  - 画面: 镜头再次拉远回到拖鞋全景，随后继续以流畅的推拉变焦动作，依次对准拖鞋的鞋口内里、侧面镂空装饰、鞋后跟弧度等部位进行特写拍摄，全程聚焦产品细节展示，镜头精准切换不同细节视角，把拖鞋内里的亲肤材质、侧面饰带的车线工艺、鞋底的流畅弧度一一清晰呈现，强化产品的奢华质感表现。
  - 口播: Ternyata sandal Arkapolo ini lagi turun harga. Dengan tampilan semewah ini, banyak yang ngira-ngira. Harganya di atas seratus ribuan, makanya jangan berhubung.
Shot 5:
  - 时长: 17.5sec - 19.0sec
  - 镜头类型: 限时优惠
  - 画面: 一只手的食指轻轻按压拖鞋表面的皮革饰带，随后指尖缓慢划过饰带边缘的缝线位置，完整展示皮革的柔软回弹特性与缝线的牢固做工，手指动作轻柔稳定，按压时皮革自然产生细微形变后快速回弹，直观体现优质皮革的柔软质感，手指移动路线沿着缝线走完全程，凸显车工的规整细致。
  - 口播: kaget pas lihat harga promonya sekarang, coba
Shot 6:
  - 时长: 19.0sec - 21.0sec
  - 镜头类型: 下单流程指引
  - 画面: 镜头重新拉远至展示台的拖鞋全景，光线均匀地覆盖整双拖鞋，画面上方再次露出ARKAPOLO品牌logo，拖鞋在白色台面上呈现出沉稳大气的视觉效果，全景画面完整还原拖鞋的整体版型与摆放状态，背景的蒲苇与墙面作为衬托，进一步强化产品轻奢高级的展示氛围。
  - 口播: klik ranjang kuning sekarang, cek sendiri lagi dapat
Shot 7:
  - 时长: 21.0sec - 31.0sec
  - 镜头类型: 产品设计亮点
  - 画面: 场景平滑切换至高端品牌鞋店内部，皮拖鞋放置在金属质感的展示台面上，背景是暖光照明的两侧陈列柜，柜中整齐摆满各式皮鞋与正装服饰，整体空间明亮且充满奢华零售氛围，镜头围绕拖鞋缓缓移动完成收尾拍摄，画面先后弹出两段字幕进行产品说明，多角度展示置于鞋店场景中的皮拖鞋，凸显产品适配高端线下门店的品质定位，结尾画面定格在拖鞋带有金属铭牌的特写角度，完成整套种草展示流程。
  - 口播: harga berapa hari ini. Sandal Arcapolo, tampil elegan tanpa bicara. Kim Kantong Jebol.
[Background Sound]:
- 非常欢快的TikTok风格背景音乐，节奏轻快上扬、音量适中偏高、带有电子鼓点和俏皮合成器旋律，适合年轻消费群体的带货短视频，营造惊喜促销加种草冲动的氛围，歌曲风格类似潮流快闪或购物狂欢主题的原创促销BGM，配合价格惊喜与视觉高级感内容强化转化冲动。
[Transition / Editing]:
- 镜头在细节特写与全景画面之间采用流畅的变焦推拉自然衔接，最后通过场景融合的转场方式，将原本的家居背景替换为高端鞋店背景，实现场景的平滑过渡，整体剪辑节奏贴合旁白解说的推进逻辑，突出产品的细节卖点。

title: Hilo's  Sandal Selop Tali Silang Wanita Simpel Terbaru  size 3 — Handheld Demo (Indonesia · Shoes)
creator: @debinuryl
hook_line: Show hands holding slippers and feet wearing slippers against a tea garden background
prompt_en:
[Style]: A healing, fresh pastoral-style e-commerce showcase video with bright, clear visuals. The soft texture of the slippers creates a comfortable visual contrast with the natural green tea plantation environment, highlighting the casual nature of summer home footwear.
[Environment]: A high mountain tea plantation scene on a sunny day, with layers of emerald green tea fields stretching across gentle slopes into the distance. Rolling bluish-green mountains and scattered tall trees are visible in the background, with abundant natural light. The background is blurred to draw full visual focus to the slipper product.
[Tone & Pacing]: The overall pace is slow and logically structured for product demonstration, with smooth, continuous movements. Slow rotation of the slippers to show fine details, paired with a relaxed, laid-back musical atmosphere, conveys the comfortable, casual summer styling vibe of the slippers.
[Camera]: First-person handheld close-up perspective, with the lens focused entirely on the slippers throughout the shot. No large camera movements, using a stable fixed position to capture the interaction details between the hand and the slippers, keeping the slippers at the core of the frame at all times.
[Lighting]: Bright, even soft natural daylight, with light falling gently from the front, no harsh shadows. It clearly reveals the fine material texture and soft brown tone of the slippers, making the overall image color fresh and luminous.
[Character]: East Asian woman aged 20-30, only her hands and feet are visible. She has fair, delicate hand skin with translucent light-colored extended manicures, and a slender, well-proportioned exposed calf line. Her movements are calm and relaxed, conveying a laid-back summer casual atmosphere.

[Shots]
Shot 1:
  - Duration: 0.0sec - 3.0sec
  - Scene Type: Handheld product showcase
  - Scene: With the layered emerald high mountain tea plantation as the background, a hand holds a brown cross-strap slipper from the left side of the frame, slowly rotating it to first show the front appearance of the slipper, then flipping it to reveal the thick sole with anti-slip texture on the side. On the right side of the frame, a foot is lifted with toes naturally relaxed, already wearing another identical slipper, simultaneously demonstrating the on-foot fit and front silhouette of the slipper.
Shot 2:
  - Duration: 3.0sec - 7.0sec
  - Scene Type: Product material showcase
  - Scene: The hand continues to rotate the slipper toward the camera, clearly showing the three-dimensional texture of the upper cross straps and the detail of the square decorative label on the cross straps, then rotates the slipper a full circle to completely display all details including the sole tread and edge wrapping design. The foot on the right remains naturally lifted, steadily demonstrating the on-foot fit of the slipper.
Shot 3:
  - Duration: 7.0sec - 9.0sec
  - Scene Type: Lifestyle scene demonstration
  - Scene: The hand rotates the slipper back to face the camera directly to show the full overall silhouette of the slipper, while the foot on the right side of the frame gently turns its angle to show the side thick-sole effect of the slipper when worn. Set against the fresh tea plantation background, the casual and comfortable product characteristics of the slippers are further emphasized.
[Background Sound]:
- Very upbeat TikTok-style background music with a light, lively rhythm, moderately high volume, distinct electronic beats and pop melodies, perfectly suited for short videos showcasing summer lifestyle products, effectively boosting viewer mood and watch time.
[Transition / Editing]:
- Seamless, uninterrupted scene transitions, using the slow hand rotation of the slippers as a natural connection throughout, no abrupt clip jumps. The product demonstration process is smooth and fluid, fully presenting every detail of the slippers.
prompt_zh:
[Style]: 治愈清新田园风电商展示视频，画面明亮通透，拖鞋的柔和质感与茶园自然绿境形成舒适视觉对比，突出夏日居家鞋的休闲属性。
[Environment]: 晴朗白天的高山茶园场景，层层叠叠的翠绿茶田顺着缓坡铺展向远方，背景可见连绵青蓝色山峦与零散高大乔木，自然光充足，背景虚化将视觉重心聚焦于拖鞋产品上。
[Tone & Pacing]: 整体节奏舒缓且富有展示逻辑，动作流畅连贯，通过缓慢转动拖鞋的细节展示，结合休闲松弛的音乐氛围，传递出拖鞋舒适随性的夏日穿搭气质。
[Camera]: 第一人称手持特写视角，镜头全程聚焦于拖鞋主体，无大幅度镜头移动，通过稳定的固定机位捕捉手部与拖鞋的互动细节，始终保持拖鞋在画面核心位置。
[Lighting]: 明亮均匀的自然日间柔光，光线从正面方向柔和洒落，没有生硬的阴影，清晰呈现出拖鞋细腻的材质纹理与柔和的棕色调质感，整体画面色调清新透亮。
[Character]: 20-30岁东亚女性，仅露出手部与脚部，手部皮肤白皙细腻，做了透亮的浅色延长美甲，露出的小腿线条匀称纤细，动作从容舒展，传递出夏日休闲放松的氛围感。

[Shots]
Shot 1:
  - 时长: 0.0sec - 3.0sec
  - 镜头类型: 手持商品展示
  - 画面: 以翠绿层叠的高山茶园为背景，一只手从画面左侧托住棕褐色交叉带拖鞋，缓慢转动拖鞋，先展示拖鞋正面外观，随后翻转露出侧边带有防滑纹理的厚鞋底；画面右侧抬起一只脚，脚趾自然舒展，脚部已穿入另一只同款拖鞋中，同步展示拖鞋的上脚效果与正面版型。
Shot 2:
  - 时长: 3.0sec - 7.0sec
  - 镜头类型: 产品材质展示
  - 画面: 手部继续将拖鞋向镜头方向转动，清晰展示鞋面交叉带的立体纹理与交叉带上的方形装饰标细节，随后将拖鞋环绕展示一圈，完整呈现拖鞋的鞋底纹路、包边设计等所有细节；右侧脚部始终保持自然抬起的状态，稳定展示上脚后的贴合度。
Shot 3:
  - 时长: 7.0sec - 9.0sec
  - 镜头类型: 场景化生活秀
  - 画面: 手部将拖鞋转回正对镜头的正面视角，展示拖鞋整体的完整版型，同时画面右侧的脚轻轻转动角度，展示拖鞋上脚后侧面的厚底效果，在茶园清新背景的衬托下，进一步凸显拖鞋休闲舒适的产品特质。
[Background Sound]:
- 非常欢快的TikTok风格背景音乐，节奏轻快活泼、音量适中偏高、带有明显电子节拍与流行旋律，适配夏日生活好物展示类短视频，能有效提升观众情绪与停留时长。
[Transition / Editing]:
- 采用连贯无断点的画面转场，全程以手部缓慢转动拖鞋的动作作为自然衔接，无生硬剪辑跳转，产品展示过程流畅顺滑，完整呈现拖鞋的每一处细节。

title: GOKOTTA Lompat Tali Alat Olahraga / Skipping Portable Active P — Real Review (Indonesia · Sports & Outdoor)
creator: @babangjek_
hook_line: How long does it take you to jump rope from a beginner to a pro?
pain_point: Beginner jumpers often trip over rope and lack stamina
prompt_en:
[Style]: Creative 3D animated realistic style, using a transparent anthropomorphic skeleton character to intuitively demonstrate the entire exercise process, with dynamic, fluid visuals that balance popular science entertainment and athletic appeal.
[Environment]: The filming locations include an open high-rise urban rooftop fitness area, a bright modern home kitchen, and an outdoor tree-lined running track. All scenes are fully and brightly lit with natural daylight from a clear sunny day, and the environment setups are fully aligned with the sports and fitness theme.
[Tone & Pacing]: The overall rhythm builds from slow to fast, gradually increasing the visual dynamism as the beginner skater progresses from novice to proficient. The narrative is lighthearted, humorous, and full of inspirational energy, with detailed, vivid depictions of every movement.
[Camera]: Multi-perspective shot switching is used: full front shots show the complete jump rope movement, close-ups highlight fine details of the skeleton character, and follow shots track the character as they complete actions. The camera occasionally produces subtle, natural jitters synchronized with jumps to enhance realistic dynamism.
[Lighting]: Bright, abundant natural daylight is used throughout. In the rooftop scene, sunlight slants down to cast sharp, clear shadows; in the kitchen scene, soft natural light streams in from the window. The overall illumination is crisp and clean, with distinct, well-defined light and shadow layers.
[Character]: A non-human anthropomorphic transparent skeleton character with no gender, designed as a fitness enthusiast. The character wears white sportswear and a blue headscarf accessory, with a playful, positive image and highly expressive emotional delivery. title: Torcia laser ad alta luminosità ricaricabile — Real Review (Italy · Home Improvement)
creator: @user6032271209208
hook_line: A bright blue strong beam instantly shoots to the distant road surface hundreds of meters away
pain_point: Dim environment at night has insufficient lighting
prompt_en:
[Style]: Realistic product demonstration style, fully focused on the functional demonstration of the high-power flashlight, with clean and straightforward visuals that highlight the core selling point of the product's strong long-range illumination.
[Environment]: Nighttime street in an urban residential area, with private cars neatly parked along the roadside, dense street trees and green belts lining the road, and scattered street lamps and building lights visible in the distance. The overall ambient light is dim, fully emphasizing the flashlight's illumination effect.
[Tone & Pacing]: The overall rhythm is brisk and tight, unfolding demonstrations sequentially around the product's functions. Every camera movement is crisp with no redundant or dragging content, clearly conveying the powerful performance of the high-power flashlight.
[Camera]: Primarily uses a first-person handheld shooting perspective, paired with multi-camera angle switching. The camera moves slowly following the flashlight's illumination direction, with occasional natural slight handheld shakes to recreate the on-site feel of a real outdoor demonstration.
[Lighting]: Based on the faint low light of the natural nighttime environment, all primary light sources come from the flashlight's own strong beam. The beam clearly outlines a bright blue light path in the dim environment, with extremely strong light impact that intuitively demonstrates the product's illumination brightness.
[Character]: East Asian male aged 20-30, with defined arm lines, showing part of his side face while wearing a white protective mask, no makeup, well-proportioned build, wearing a plain black short-sleeved T-shirt and a light-colored printed sun visor. He has a neat and capable temperament, operates the flashlight skillfully and smoothly, and his visible eyes are focused and fully engaged in the functional demonstration.

[Shots]
Shot 1:
  - Duration: 0.0sec - 3.5sec
  - Scene Type: Product Effectiveness
  - Scene: Night street from a first-person perspective, one hand holding a black high-power flashlight, fingers pressing the switch to turn on the flashlight. A bright blue strong light beam instantly shoots straight toward the road surface hundreds of meters away, the beam is clearly visible in the dark night sky. In the background, an electric scooter slowly passing by and vehicles parked by the roadside can be seen. The camera follows the hand-held flashlight to slightly adjust the illumination direction, keeping the beam always at the visual center of the frame, focusing on showing that the beam can project an extremely long distance.
Shot 2:
  - Duration: 3.5sec - 7.5sec
  - Scene Type: Product Versatility
  - Scene: Scene switches to the roadside green belt next to a parked black sedan. Both hands hold the flashlight, repeatedly rotating the flashlight head to complete the zoom operation, sequentially demonstrating wide-angle near-field illumination and focused long-range illumination functions: in floodlight mode, it clearly illuminates the entire car front and a large area of ground; in spotlight mode, the blue strong light shoots straight into the depths of the distant trees. The camera remains steady, following the flashlight's zoom action to switch and display the visual effects of different illumination modes, intuitively comparing the different performance of close-range large-area lighting and long-range targeted illumination.
  - Subject: What?
Shot 3:
  - Duration: 7.5sec - 11.5sec
  - Scene Type: Product Effectiveness
  - Scene: First-person perspective holding the flashlight and moving, the camera follows the strong light beam sweeping across the night sky above the street and the buildings on both sides. The bright long-range beam draws a clear light path in the night sky, and the distant building lights and street environment are accented by the beam for a highly visually striking effect. The camera moves naturally with the arm, slowly sweeping across the surrounding night scenery following the beam direction, further demonstrating the flashlight's superior long-range illumination capability and highlighting the beam's coverage distance in an open night scene.
  - Subject: What?
Shot 4:
  - Duration: 11.5sec - 20.0sec
  - Scene Type: Ease of Use Demonstration
  - Scene: Full-body shot of the demonstrator, who stands next to the steps at a nighttime intersection with several electric scooters parked behind him. He holds the flashlight with both hands, skillfully rotates the barrel to adjust the focal length, and repeatedly presses the switch to switch between different illumination modes. The strong light emitted by the flashlight sequentially shoots toward the deep end of the steps, the distant street sign, and the surrounding lanes, comprehensively showing the product's operating feel and practical performance. The camera uses a medium shot framing, steadily recording the demonstrator's complete operation process without violent shaking.
  - Subject: Okay.
Shot 5:
  - Duration: 20.0sec - 21.5sec
  - Scene Type: Product Effectiveness
  - Scene: The camera finally holds a fixed frame, the strong light beam from the flashlight cuts through the dark night sky and illuminates a distant traffic sign, bringing the footage to a complete close that lets viewers clearly perceive the product's powerful performance. The camera pauses briefly, with the final frame resting on the stunning effect of the long-range beam, reinforcing the audience's memory of the product's performance.
  - Subject: Thank you.
[Background Sound]:
- This video contains no recognizable background music melodies; the primary sounds are environmental and action sound effects: a laser-like tech 'whoosh' at the opening, continuous outdoor natural wind noise, a synthesized electronic 'wow' special effect, later paired with mechanical operation sounds, metal friction sounds, and motor engine sounds simulating startup acceleration. The overall sound effect style combines a sci-fi feel, natural ambience, and action special effects, matching the demonstration rhythm of the high-power flashlight product.
[Transition / Editing]:
- Uses natural scene jump editing techniques, with smooth transitions between each functional demonstration shot. The handheld shooting's casual texture is maintained throughout, paired with precise timing to the flashlight's startup sound effect to make the product demonstration rhythm more impactful.

She has a vibrant, energetic temperament full of willingness to share, with smooth, natural hand movements that convey the surprise and sincerity of sharing a great product.

The remaining lip gloss products and their packaging boxes are neatly placed on the background table, and the bright green leaves of the foliage plant are visible at the edge of the frame. It has a catchy melody and clear drum beats, falling under the J-pop trendy genre with a strong sense of rhythm and product recommendation vibe. It effectively matches the fast cuts of product displays and promotional information, boosting viewers' urge to click and purchase, and is tailored for short-form sales videos targeting young female consumers.
[Transition / Editing]:
- Using the fast-cut editing style popular on TikTok, each product display segment connects naturally, with a small number of sparkling particle effects added to the frame to emphasize the shiny texture of the lip gloss, creating an overall lively and dynamic rhythm.

title: 【dadawoca】｜目元エステ 美顔器 EMS｜クマ・小ジワ集中ケア 温感 微振動 — Real Review (Japan · Beauty & Personal Care)
creator: @kailafromhawaii
hook_line: Just one touch and your eye size will change
pain_point: Dark circles and fine lines around eyes, loose eye skin
prompt_en:
[Style]: Realistic Japanese-style home skincare aesthetic, with bright and soft imagery that highlights the real usage experience of the beauty device and the laid-back feeling of daily skincare, carrying the authentic, relatable vibe of a lifestyle product recommendation share.
[Environment]: A well-lit Japanese-style home living room, with light beige walls paired with a dark striped half-wall decoration. On the white counter in the background, there is a transparent vase holding an orange bouquet and small household appliances. The foreground features a round wooden dining table with distinct, clear wood grain. The entire space is wrapped in warm natural afternoon light, creating a warm, healing atmosphere.
[Tone & Pacing]: Adopts the authentic, casual tone of a real daily UGC share, with a slow, natural rhythm. The transitions from product unboxing, function demonstration to skincare practice are smooth and seamless, paired with the host's relaxed movement details to convey a friendly, approachable vibe of a great product experience with no sense of distance.
[Camera]: Primarily uses a first-person selfie perspective, interspersed with close-up macro shots of the product. The footage has slight, natural handheld shake. When shooting the character's face, the focus is precisely locked on the eye area; when shooting the beauty device, the camera prioritizes capturing the details of the indicator light turning on and off. The entire footage remains stable and authentic throughout.
[Lighting]: Ample, soft natural afternoon light pours in from the side, creating an even, natural soft light effect on the tabletop and the character's face with no harsh shadows, perfectly reproducing the character's skin condition and the exquisite texture of the beauty device.
[Character]: An Asian woman aged 25-30, with fine, natural skin that has the translucent, fresh texture of a bare face. She has a soft, smooth face shape, neat shoulder-length short hair, small thin gold hoop earrings, and relaxed, delicate facial features. She wears an almost no-makeup pseudo-bare makeup look, has a well-proportioned, relaxed figure, and wears a light gray casual T-shirt printed with yellow and blue wavy patterns. Her temperament is gentle and laid-back, her movements are soft and slow, her expression is relaxed and genuine, and she shows a slight sense of pleasant surprise while sharing.

[Shots]
Shot 1:
  - Duration: 0.0sec - 3.5sec
  - Scene Type: Product usage scene
  - Scene: The girl faces the camera, presses the black beauty device against her right cheek to operate it, then moves the device away, slowly opens her eyes wide towards the camera to show the changes around her eyes after use. Multiple skincare cotton pads are attached to her face, and corresponding Japanese subtitles appear at the bottom of the frame. The fixed selfie camera stays focused on the character's face and remains stable.
  - Subject: 私はひとなでするだけで目の大きさが変わってしまいます
Shot 2:
  - Duration: 3.5sec - 7.5sec
  - Scene Type: Unboxing
  - Scene: The camera cuts to a close-up of the wooden tabletop. A pair of hands picks up the beauty device's packaging box from the table, rotates the box fully to show the printed beauty device appearance pattern and product text labels on the box surface, then slowly opens the box to reveal the internal accessories. Corresponding Japanese subtitles appear at the bottom of the frame. The perspective switches smoothly from the selfie view to a first-person overhead shot of the tabletop, with the hand movements causing slight camera movement that focuses on the packaging box details.
  - Subject: あんまり期待してなかったんだけどこのメモ取りに
Shot 3:
  - Duration: 7.5sec - 13.5sec
  - Scene Type: Ease of use demonstration
  - Scene: Under the close-up macro lens, a pair of hands takes the black beauty device out of the packaging box and removes the protective film on its surface. Then a finger gently touches the sensing area of the beauty device, the orange wavy indicator light on the device head automatically turns on, and a few seconds later the indicator light slowly turns off, fully demonstrating the device's function of inductive startup without needing to press any manual buttons. Corresponding Japanese subtitles appear at the bottom of the frame. The fixed macro close-up camera clearly captures the entire process of the beauty device's indicator light turning on and off.
  - Subject: このような日は、いることもなくこのように肌を 完治すると自動
Shot 4:
  - Duration: 13.5sec - 19.0sec
  - Scene Type: Product usage scene
  - Scene: The camera cuts back to the character's selfie perspective. The girl gently applies skincare products to complete her basic skincare routine, then lifts the skincare product bottle in her hand to show it to the camera, then carefully pastes the pre-cut skincare cotton pads one by one onto her forehead, eye area, nose wings, cheeks and chin, gently pressing them with her fingertips to make them adhere to her skin. Corresponding Japanese subtitles appear at the bottom of the frame. The fixed selfie camera follows the girl's hand movements to fully record the entire skincare process.
  - Subject: 次回予告 パックをしたまま顔に当ててみました
Shot 5:
  - Duration: 19.0sec - 26.5sec
  - Scene Type: Host personal test experience
  - Scene: The girl picks up the black beauty device, gently presses the device head against her right eyelid and slowly slides it in circular motions for a massage, then moves the device away, opens her eyes wide towards the camera again to intuitively show the changes in the eye area after the operation. Corresponding Japanese subtitles appear at the bottom of the frame. The fixed selfie camera stays focused on the interaction details between the character's eyes and the beauty device.
  - Subject: 特にビリつきもなく目元を温めてくれる感じです でした もうこのひとなでで圧倒的
Shot 6:
  - Duration: 26.5sec - 33.0sec
  - Scene Type: Host personal test experience
  - Scene: The girl closes her eyes, holds the beauty device and slowly, gently slides it across the areas around her left and right eyes, then her chin to perform a massage, fully using the device to stimulate and care for her facial skin. Then she moves the beauty device away, uses the fingertips of both hands to tap on both sides of her temples respectively, and gently presses to relax. Corresponding Japanese subtitles appear at the bottom of the frame. The fixed selfie camera naturally follows the moving trajectory of the beauty device to focus, fully recording the entire facial care process.
  - Subject: はい 目元美顔器なんで顔にはあんまり効果ないかなと思います とは思うんですけれども一応顔にも刺激を与えていきます
Shot 7:
  - Duration: 33.0sec - 38.0sec
  - Scene Type: Product display
  - Scene: The girl faces the camera and gently lifts the skin around her eye to show the firming effect, then lifts the black beauty device to display it in the frame, playfully winks at the camera and makes a light kissing mouth shape. Finally the camera cuts back to the tabletop close-up, a pair of hands pinches the bottom of the beauty device and gently rotates it to show the device's appearance details from multiple angles. Corresponding Japanese subtitles appear at the bottom of the frame. The camera stays in selfie position first, then smoothly switches to the overhead close-up position on the tabletop, focusing on the overall appearance of the beauty device.
  - Subject: 目元がかなり好きだと思いませんが、ぜひ ギターリー下から試してみてください
[Background Sound]:
- No background music, pure human voice narration with natural speaking speed and relaxed tone. There are no soundtracks or background sound effects at all, and the overall style is an unscripted real-person test sharing with no accompanying music.
[Transition / Editing]:
- Uses natural, smooth scene jump editing. The selfie perspective and product close-ups are connected via fade-in and fade-out transitions. The slow rhythm matches the laid-back atmosphere of the home share, with no harsh, fast jumps.

prompt_en:
[Style]: Realistic Japanese-style home goods aesthetic, with warm and soft color tones that closely resemble real home usage scenarios, full of the cozy atmosphere of a casual lifestyle share.
[Environment]: A Japanese-style home balcony scene at night. Soft warm yellow indoor light seeps out from behind the sliding door. The balcony walls are decorated with light gray faux brick texture, surrounded by multiple potted lush green plants. A household washing machine and a floor-mounted height-adjustable clothes drying rack are placed nearby, forming a realistic daily home laundry and drying environment.
[Tone & Pacing]: A relaxed, lively product sharing rhythm, with a smooth, natural overall narrative that transitions seamlessly from product function demonstration to detailed explanation, balancing a gentle pace with a constant sense of pleasant surprise.
[Camera]: Uses a fixed wide-angle shot paired with close-up detail shots. The camera remains steady overall, panning and moving forward naturally following the character's movements to preserve the comfortable, authentic feel of a real home filming setup.
[Lighting]: The initial scene is set in dim nighttime ambient light. When the character pushes open the balcony door and steps outside, the solar motion sensor light installed by the door automatically turns on. Sufficient warm white light instantly illuminates the entire balcony area, clearly lighting the ground under the character's feet and the clothes-drying operation zone, creating a bright, reassuring home lighting atmosphere.
[Character]: A 30-35 year old East Asian woman with natural, clear skin, shoulder-length dark brown short hair, relaxed gentle facial features and a warm, approachable temperament. She wears a no-makeup makeup home look, has a well-proportioned figure, and is dressed in a loose light khaki loungewear set with matching home slippers. Her movements are smooth and relaxed, and she maintains a calm, friendly expression full of the warmth of a casual lifestyle share throughout.

[Shots]
Shot 1:
  - Duration: 0.0sec - 3.5sec
  - Scene Type: Setup of usage scenario
  - Scene: The indoor space is dim at night. A woman is holding a full basket of laundry with both hands, pushes open the balcony sliding door and steps outside. The previously off solar motion sensor light by the door instantly turns on automatically, illuminating the woman and the area around the doorway. The woman looks up at the lit light, a surprised expression on her face. Fixed camera position, the frame naturally transitions from dark to bright as the light turns on to complete the exposure shift.
  - Subject: わっ!一歩出ただけで手にいた!
Shot 2:
  - Duration: 3.5sec - 7.0sec
  - Scene Type: Product effectiveness demonstration
  - Scene: The shot cuts to a full wide view of the balcony. The woman walks to the drying area carrying the full laundry basket, bends down to place the laundry basket steadily on the ground, then takes clothes out of the basket one by one and hangs them sequentially on the nearby drying rack with calm, natural movements. Fixed wide-angle camera position, fully showing the entire range of the woman's activities as she operates on the balcony.
  - Subject: 洗濯物で両手がふすがってても自動で手をかける
Shot 3:
  - Duration: 7.0sec - 12.0sec
  - Scene Type: Product usage scenario
  - Scene: The camera moves in to focus on the drying rack. The woman picks up a white T-shirt, hangs the hanger holding the T-shirt onto the horizontal bar of the drying rack. The camera follows the movement and pans down to show the laundry basket with remaining clothes placed on the ground, with sufficient light clearly illuminating the various colored garments inside the basket. The camera slowly pans down from the close-up of the hands hanging the clothes, finally stopping on the laundry basket on the ground.
  - Subject: てくれるのは本当に助かるくらい夜 でも足元まではっきり
Shot 4:
  - Duration: 12.0sec - 16.5sec
  - Scene Type: Checkout process guidance
  - Scene: The camera pulls back to return to the full wide view of the balcony. The woman turns and walks over to the washing machine, picks up the smartphone placed on top of it, turns to face the camera, holds up the phone with one hand to show its lit screen interface, and points toward the lower left corner of the frame with her other hand, sharing the product with a bright, satisfied smile. Fixed wide-angle camera position, the frame is stable and clear, fully capturing the entire process of the woman sharing directly to the camera.
  - Subject: ちょっとした外の用事にめちゃくちゃ便利。ソーラー充電だから電気代ゼロ気 になる方は日出車のリンクから詳細を見てね。
[Background Sound]:
- Light, lively pop electronic background music with a bright tempo of around 120 BPM, paired with crisp drum beats and bright synthesizer melodies. It is the type of BGM commonly used in popular lifestyle product promotion videos, with a moderately high volume that creates an atmosphere of surprise, practicality, and enthusiastic recommendation, highlighting the product's selling points of convenience, tech-savviness, and small daily joys, belonging to the upbeat lifestyle tech product promo track genre.
[Transition / Editing]:
- Uses natural, smooth scene transition editing. It flows seamlessly from the surprising moment the light turns on at the door, to the wide shot of the drying process, to close-up details of the clothing, and finally to the shot of the character holding up her phone to share. The entire edit connects smoothly, matching the gentle narrative rhythm of Japanese-style home short videos.

hook_line: 1 yen is crazy! Check it out now✨ Those with coupons get it for just 1 yen!?
pain_point: Troubled by mosquitoes, worried about chemicals affecting family and pets
prompt_en:
[Style]: Japanese-style home product recommendation realistic aesthetic, with warm and soft color tones, sharp and clear product details, delivering an overall healing and cozy home product display texture.
[Environment]: A bright and warm Japanese-style home setting, with light wood-grain tabletop and flooring. The surrounding area is decorated with a pure white small vase, fresh green foliage plants, a wooden tray, a side cabinet with rattan woven elements, a log nightstand, and a minimalist table lamp. The entire space is clean and tidy, brimming with a natural, soft home atmosphere.
[Tone & Pacing]: A lively, enthusiastic product recommendation style, with smooth and tight shot switching that highlights the core selling points of the product. The entire presentation maintains a brisk, guiding pace that allows viewers to quickly grasp the product's advantages.
[Camera]: Uses a first-person close-up shooting perspective, paired with a small number of full-scene wide shots. The camera moves steadily and smoothly, focusing closely on product detail areas to accurately showcase the product's appearance and functional features.
[Lighting]: Soft, even natural light pours in from the window, supplemented by warm indoor diffused light with no harsh, hard shadows. The overall lighting is bright and warm, accurately restoring the delicate texture of the product and the healing atmosphere of the home setting.
[Character]: An East Asian woman aged 20-30, with smooth, even-toned delicate hand skin. In the sleep scene, her eyes and brows look soft, her facial lines are relaxed, she has a no-makeup bare face, a slender well-proportioned figure, and wears loose, comfortable loungewear. Her temperament is gentle and tranquil, her movements are soft and slow, and she looks relaxed and peaceful while sleeping.

[Shots]
Shot 1:
  - Duration: 0.0sec - 1.5sec
  - Scene Type: Product Appearance Display
  - Scene: A product packaging box sits on a light wood-grain tabletop, printed with a render of the mosquito-repellent night light and brand text. A small potted green plant rests on a wooden tray in the upper left corner of the frame, and a fan-shaped wooden-base table lamp is partially visible in one corner of the background. Eye-catching Japanese promotional text pops up on the screen.
  - Subject: Dijien, naratorias, ¿qué es lo que?  Cono coupon, arrujito a
Shot 2:
  - Duration: 1.5sec - 4.5sec
  - Scene Type: Handheld Product Display
  - Scene: The shot cuts to a pure white tabletop. A hand reaches in from the right side of the frame, picks up the white mosquito-repellent night light next to the packaging box, and turns the product to face the camera directly, clearly showing the hot-stamped gold brand text and touch control marks on the device surface.
  - Subject: ¡Más acá no ichien! ¡Concentronizazos nakide!
Shot 3:
  - Duration: 4.5sec - 8.0sec
  - Scene Type: Ease of Use Demonstration
  - Scene: Two mosquito-repellent night lights, one white and one light green, are plugged side by side into a wall power socket. The background shows a home corner decorated with a white porcelain vase and green foliage plants. A woman's finger wearing a plain band ring presses the touch control marks on the surface of both devices one after another, and the annular light strips on both devices light up with soft warm yellow glow sequentially.
  - Subject: ¡Muchas!
Shot 4:
  - Duration: 8.0sec - 12.0sec
  - Scene Type: Functional Operation Demonstration
  - Scene: The white mosquito-repellent night light is plugged alone into another wall socket. The background is a wooden shelf decorated with photo frames and green foliage plants. A hand gently presses the touch control area on the device surface again to turn off the light, pauses briefly, then presses again to turn the warm annular light strip back on.
  - Subject: ¡Gracias!
Shot 5:
  - Duration: 12.0sec - 15.5sec
  - Scene Type: Product Usage Scenarios
  - Scene: The shot cuts to different wall socket scenarios in various home spaces. The two mosquito-repellent night lights are plugged into sockets at different positions respectively. A hand reaches out again to gently press the touch control area on the device surface, keeping the light strips steadily glowing with soft warm yellow light. Detailed backgrounds of different home environments flash by quickly in sequence.
  - Subject: ¡Gracias!
Shot 6:
  - Duration: 15.5sec - 17.5sec
  - Scene Type: Scenario-Based Lifestyle Showcase
  - Scene: In a nighttime bedroom scene, a woman is lying peacefully asleep in bed covered by a light brown quilt. The mosquito-repellent night light plugged into the wall socket beside the bed is emitting soft warm light. A night light and a green plant are placed on the nightstand, creating an overall quiet and cozy atmosphere.
  - Subject: ¡Pures sí! ¡Puñeca el chazo! ¡Mino Casaraglioni! ¡Di sin!
Shot 7:
  - Duration: 17.5sec - 19.5sec
  - Scene Type: Multiple Style Options Display
  - Scene: The shot returns to the bright white tabletop. The white and light green mosquito-repellent night lights are placed side by side on a wavy-shaped wooden tray, with scattered green leaf decorations around the tray. A white porcelain vase and glass container are visible in the background. The two devices are neatly arranged to clearly show their full appearance, and guiding Japanese text pops up on the screen.
  - Subject: ¡Soyven! ¡Ya está listo! ¡Jip, ¿estas?
[Background Sound]:
- A highly upbeat TikTok-style product promotion background music with a fast tempo, strong drum beats, and a catchy melody. The volume is moderately high, featuring electronic synthesizers and light vocal samples. It is a Japanese-style flash sale promotional BGM with strong rhythmic drive, matching rapid scene cuts and sales pitches to create the urgent, joyful atmosphere of 'limited-time flash deals' and 'amazing value surprises'. It is perfectly suited for short promotional videos and lifestyle product recommendation clips, amplifying viewers' impulse to make a purchase.
[Transition / Editing]:
- Uses smooth scenario-based transition editing, naturally shifting from product appearance display to functional operation demonstration, then extending to different home usage scenarios. The entire editing pace is brisk with seamless connections, highlighting the diverse usage advantages of the product.
prompt_zh:
[Style]: 日系居家种草写实风，画面色调温暖柔和，产品细节清晰锐利，整体呈现治愈舒适的家居产品展示质感。
[Environment]: 明亮温馨的日系家居场景，铺设浅原木色木纹桌面与地板，周边摆放纯白小花瓶、鲜绿观叶植物、木质托盘、带编藤元素的边柜、原木床头柜与简约台灯，整体环境干净整洁，充满自然柔和的家居氛围。
[Tone & Pacing]: 活泼热情的带货种草风格，镜头切换节奏流畅紧凑，突出产品核心卖点，全程保持轻快且有引导性的展示节奏，让观众能快速捕捉产品优势。
[Camera]: 采用第一人称特写拍摄视角，搭配少量全景场景镜头，镜头移动平稳顺滑，针对产品细节部分进行近距离对焦，精准展现产品外观与功能特点。
[Lighting]: 柔和均匀的自然光从窗边倾洒而入，辅以室内暖调漫射光，无强烈硬阴影，整体光线明亮温暖，精准还原产品的细腻质感与家居场景的治愈氛围。
[Character]: 东亚女性，20-30岁，手部皮肤细腻光滑肤质匀净，睡眠场景中眉眼柔和面部线条舒展，素颜无妆感，身形匀称纤细，身着宽松舒适的居家服饰，气质温柔恬静，动作轻柔舒缓，睡眠时神情放松安详。

[Shots]
Shot 1:
  - 时长: 0.0sec - 1.5sec
  - 镜头类型: 产品外观展示
  - 画面: 浅原木色的桌面上摆放着产品包装盒，包装盒上印有驱蚊小夜灯的产品效果图与品牌文字，画面左上角的木托盘上放着一盆小型绿植，背景一角露出扇形木底台灯，画面弹出醒目的日文促销文字。
  - 口播: Dijien, naratorias, ¿qué es lo que?  Cono coupon, arrujito a
Shot 2:
  - 时长: 1.5sec - 4.5sec
  - 镜头类型: 手持商品展示
  - 画面: 镜头切换到纯白桌面，一只手从画面右侧伸入，取出包装盒旁的白色驱蚊小夜灯，将产品转至正面朝向镜头，清晰展示设备表面的烫金品牌文字与触控标识。
  - 口播: ¡Más acá no ichien! ¡Concentronizazos nakide!
Shot 3:
  - 时长: 4.5sec - 8.0sec
  - 镜头类型: 展示易用性
  - 画面: 白色与浅绿两款驱蚊小夜灯并排插在墙面上的电源插座中，背景是摆放着白瓷花瓶与绿植的家居角落，一根戴着素圈戒指的女性手指先后按压两款设备表面的触控标识，两款设备的环形灯带逐一亮起暖黄色柔光。
  - 口播: ¡Muchas!
Shot 4:
  - 时长: 8.0sec - 12.0sec
  - 镜头类型: 演示功能操作
  - 画面: 白色驱蚊小夜灯单独插在另一处墙面插座上，背景是摆放着相框与绿植的木质置物架，手再次轻按设备表面的触控区域，关闭灯光后稍作停顿，再次按压点亮暖光环形灯带。
  - 口播: ¡Gracias!
Shot 5:
  - 时长: 12.0sec - 15.5sec
  - 镜头类型: 产品使用场景
  - 画面: 镜头切换到不同家居墙面的插座场景，两款驱蚊小夜灯分别插在不同位置的插座上，手再次伸出轻按设备表面的触控区域，灯带保持暖黄色柔光常亮，不同家居环境的细节背景依次快速闪过。
  - 口播: ¡Gracias!
Shot 6:
  - 时长: 15.5sec - 17.5sec
  - 镜头类型: 场景化生活秀
  - 画面: 夜晚的卧室场景中，一位女性盖着浅棕色被子安稳躺在床上熟睡，插在床侧墙面插座上的驱蚊小夜灯正发出柔和暖光，床头柜上摆放着小夜灯与绿色植物，整体氛围静谧温馨。
  - 口播: ¡Pures sí! ¡Puñeca el chazo! ¡Mino Casaraglioni! ¡Di sin!
Shot 7:
  - 时长: 17.5sec - 19.5sec
  - 镜头类型: 展示多款式选择
  - 画面: 镜头回到明亮的白色桌面，白色与浅绿两款驱蚊小夜灯并排摆放在波浪造型的木质托盘上，托盘周边散落着绿色叶片装饰，背景露出白瓷花瓶与玻璃容器，两款设备整齐排列，清晰展示整体外观，画面弹出引导性日文文字。
  - 口播: ¡Soyven! ¡Ya está listo! ¡Jip, ¿estas?
[Background Sound]:
- 非常欢快的TikTok风格带货背景音乐，节奏明快、鼓点强烈、旋律抓耳，音量中等偏高，带有电子合成器和轻快人声采样，属于日系快闪促销BGM，节奏驱动性强，配合画面快速切换和促销话术，营造出“限时抢购”“超值惊喜”的紧迫感与欢乐氛围，适配促销类、生活用品种草类短视频，增强观众冲动消费心理。
[Transition / Editing]:
- 采用流畅的场景化转场剪辑，从产品外观展示自然过渡到功能操作演示，再延伸至不同家居使用场景，全程剪辑节奏明快且衔接自然，突出产品的多样使用优势。

title: Beelicious ノンフライヤー 4.5L 大容量、静音マットブラック / 木目調（指紋が目立ちにくい）・見える窓付き、 — Promo Pitch (Japan · Household Appliances)
creator: @elchan0721
hook_line: Wait, this shows only 2500 yen on my screen
pain_point: Worry about high air fryer price, can't see cooking status
prompt_en:
[Style]: Realistic Japanese home appliance recommendation style, with bright and saturated image colors, appetizing food texture, combining practical demonstration feel and the promotional sharing vibe of short videos
[Environment]: A well-lit home kitchen countertop scene, with a neat and clean dark red wood-grain countertop, the overall environment is warm and tidy with no extra clutter to distract, the core visual focus is on the air fryer and various finished cooked foods, creating a relaxed home cooking sharing atmosphere
[Tone & Pacing]: Recommendation sharing style, with a tight and smooth pace, quickly switching to display multiple finished food items, interspersed with promotional price information, highlighting core product advantages such as large capacity and visible window, the overall rhythm is brisk and engaging
[Camera]: First-person close-up perspective, using close-up shots throughout the whole process, the camera moves synchronously following hand movements to accurately capture details such as pulling out the fry basket and operating the touch panel, using a slight orbiting camera movement when showcasing food to clearly present the appetizing golden crispy texture of the food
[Lighting]: Sufficient and even indoor top light supplemented by bottom fill light, clearly illuminating the ingredient details inside the air fryer, the food surface shows a natural glossy sheen with no unwanted shadow dead zones, the whole image is clean and bright
[Character]: 20-30 year old Asian male, only hands are visible, the hand skin has slight daily minor scratch marks, the skin texture is natural and realistic, no face or body is shown, no makeup, the temperament is natural and casual, with the friendly vibe of a person sharing good finds at home, hand movements are smooth and natural, completing actions in sequence including pulling out the fry basket, tapping the touch panel, rotating the fry basket to show ingredients, with skilled and relaxed movements

[Shots]
Shot 1:
  - Duration: 0.0sec - 3.0sec
  - Scene Type: Demonstrate cooking method
  - Scene: A hand grips the handle of the black brushed texture air fryer, pulling the fry basket out steadily, the fry basket holds several pieces of golden crispy fried chicken, the camera is positioned close to the fried chicken inside the basket, clearly showing its appetizing crust texture, the camera moves backward synchronously following the hand's pulling motion, maintaining close-up focus on the fried chicken throughout the process
  - Subject: え、待ってこれ手元の画面では2500円になってるよ
Shot 2:
  - Duration: 3.0sec - 6.5sec
  - Scene Type: Great value price
  - Scene: The shot cuts to the fry basket lined with baking paper, a full basket of golden fluffy fries arranged neatly, Japanese text information showing the discounted price of the fries is overlaid on the screen, clearly highlighting the original price and the discounted price of the product, the camera slowly pans across the entire portion of fries, showcasing the generous quantity and appetizing color of the fries
  - Subject: これ7500円のノースライヤーなのにTikTokの
Shot 3:
  - Duration: 6.5sec - 9.5sec
  - Scene Type: Limited-time offer
  - Scene: A screenshot of the TikTok Shop 5000 yen coupon interface appears on the screen, with a red circle marking the coupon area, in the background several golden glossy baked croissants are placed inside the air fryer, a hand holding a silicone tong gently touches a croissant to demonstrate its fluffy crispy texture
  - Subject: 5000円オフクーポンでめっちゃお得になってる人がいる
Shot 4:
  - Duration: 9.5sec - 12.5sec
  - Scene Type: Fan interaction
  - Scene: A screenshot of the e-commerce platform's checkout page is overlaid on the screen, with a red circle marking the 2500 yen discount amount area, in the background several golden fried foods are placed inside the air fryer, a hand uses silicone tongs to pick up one of the fried food pieces, clearly showing its full fluffy shape
  - Subject: ただしこれアカウントによって出る人か出ない人がいる
Shot 5:
  - Duration: 12.5sec - 15.0sec
  - Scene Type: Order process guide
  - Scene: A hand pulls out the air fryer's fry basket, the basket is lined with baking paper with several neatly arranged bright green broccoli florets on top, the ingredients look fresh and plump, on-screen text prompts users to click the lower left corner to view relevant information first
  - Subject: 先に左下から確認してみてください
Shot 6:
  - Duration: 15.0sec - 19.0sec
  - Scene Type: Product versatility
  - Scene: The shot cuts to the inside of the air fryer's fry basket, four neatly arranged raw croissants with egg wash brushed on their surfaces, then a hand pushes the fry basket steadily back into the main unit, a finger taps the upper panel of the air fryer, displaying the blue temperature control digital interface showing 185℃
  - Subject: ポテトもチキンも野菜もお肉も
Shot 7:
  - Duration: 19.0sec - 24.5sec
  - Scene Type: Show core design highlights
  - Scene: The shot shows a finger tapping the air fryer's touch keys in sequence to adjust the cooking time, through the air fryer's transparent window, the dynamic cooking process of the internal fried food slowly puffing up and turning golden under hot air can be clearly seen, users can intuitively observe the browning level of the food without pulling out the fry basket
  - Subject: おわり
ご視聴ありがとうございました。
ご視聴ありがとうございました。
Shot 8:
  - Duration: 24.5sec - 29.5sec
  - Scene Type: Great value price
  - Scene: The shot cuts to the finished cooked croissant, the croissant's crust has interlaced shades of caramel color, distinct layers and fluffy texture, blue promotional text information is overlaid on the screen, showing the high discount that can be obtained even without using a coupon
  - Subject: オフ出ているかどうか左下から今すぐチェックしてね
Shot 9:
  - Duration: 29.5sec - 34.5sec
  - Scene Type: Product usage scenarios
  - Scene: A hand pulls out the air fryer's fry basket again, sequentially showing the neatly arranged golden fried chicken inside the basket, and the plump golden fries lined with baking paper, the camera sweeps close-up across every food item, conveying the relaxed home cooking vibe of easily making a variety of delicious dishes
  - Subject: 揚げ物をもっと気軽に
ご視聴ありがとうございました。
[Background Sound]:
- Very upbeat TikTok-style background music, with a brisk and lively rhythm, moderately high volume, electronic drum beats and playful synthesizer melodies, suitable for food/promotional product marketing videos, creating an atmosphere of 'limited-time offer + sense of surprise + sense of urgency', the song style is similar to viral promotional BGM online, designed to quickly grab young viewers' attention and drive clicks/orders
[Transition / Editing]:
- Using smooth scene jump editing, applying natural fade-in and fade-out transition effects between different food display shots, screenshots of coupons and order interfaces are integrated into the food background image with a semi-transparent overlay effect, the overall editing rhythm is brisk, with key information prominently displayed
prompt_zh:
[Style]: 日系家电种草写实风，画面色彩鲜亮饱和，食品质感诱人，兼具实用展示感与短视频的促销分享质感。
[Environment]: 光线充足明亮的居家厨房桌面场景，深红色木纹台面整洁干净，整体环境温馨整洁，无多余杂物干扰，核心视觉聚焦在空气炸锅与各类烹饪完成的美食上，营造轻松的居家烹饪分享氛围。
[Tone & Pacing]: 种草分享风格，节奏紧凑流畅，快速切换展示多种美食成品，穿插促销价格信息，重点突出产品大容量、可视化视窗等核心优势，整体节奏明快有感染力。
[Camera]: 第一人称近景视角，全程采用特写镜头拍摄，镜头跟随手部动作同步移动，精准捕捉拉开炸篮、操作触控面板等细节，展示美食时采用轻微环绕移动运镜，清晰呈现食物诱人的金黄酥脆质感。
[Lighting]: 充足均匀的室内顶光辅以下方补光，清晰照亮空气炸锅内部的食材细节，食物表面呈现出自然的油润光泽，没有多余的阴影死角，整体画面干净明亮。
[Character]: 20-30岁亚洲男性，仅露出手部，手部皮肤略带日常细微划伤痕迹，肤质自然真实，未露出面部、身体，无妆容，气质自然随性，是日常居家分享好物的亲和感，手部动作流畅自然，依次完成拉开炸篮、点击触控面板、转动炸篮展示食材等动作，动作熟练放松。

[Shots]
Shot 1:
  - 时长: 0.0sec - 3.0sec
  - 镜头类型: 演示烹饪方法
  - 画面: 一只手握住黑拉丝质感的空气炸锅把手，将炸篮平稳拉开，炸篮内放置着几块色泽金黄酥脆的炸鸡块，镜头近距离对准炸篮内的炸鸡，清晰展示其诱人的外皮质感，镜头跟随手部拉拽动作同步后移，全程保持特写对焦在炸鸡上。
  - 口播: え、待ってこれ手元の画面では2500円になってるよ
Shot 2:
  - 时长: 3.0sec - 6.5sec
  - 镜头类型: 超值价格
  - 画面: 画面切换到铺有烘焙纸的炸篮内，满满一篮金黄蓬松的薯条整齐排列，画面叠加展示薯条优惠价格的日文文字信息，清晰突出产品的原价与折扣后价格，镜头缓慢平移扫过整份薯条，展示薯条饱满的数量与诱人色泽。
  - 口播: これ7500円のノースライヤーなのにTikTokの
Shot 3:
  - 时长: 6.5sec - 9.5sec
  - 镜头类型: 限时优惠
  - 画面: 画面中出现TikTok Shop 5000日元优惠券的界面截图，红色圆圈标注出优惠券区域，背景里空气炸锅内摆放着几个烤到金黄油亮的可颂，一只手拿着硅胶夹子轻轻触碰可颂，展示其蓬松酥脆的质感。
  - 口播: 5000円オフクーポンでめっちゃお得になってる人がいる
Shot 4:
  - 时长: 9.5sec - 12.5sec
  - 镜头类型: 粉丝互动
  - 画面: 画面叠加电商平台的下单结算页面截图，红色圆圈标注出2500日元的优惠金额区域，背景里空气炸锅内摆放着几块金黄的炸物，一只手用硅胶夹子夹起其中一块炸物，清晰展示其完整的蓬松形态。
  - 口播: ただしこれアカウントによって出る人か出ない人がいる
Shot 5:
  - 时长: 12.5sec - 15.0sec
  - 镜头类型: 下单流程指引
  - 画面: 一只手将空气炸锅的炸篮拉开，炸篮内铺着烘焙纸，上面整齐摆放着多块鲜绿色的西兰花，食材状态新鲜饱满，画面文字提示用户可以先点击左下角查看相关信息。
  - 口播: 先に左下から確認してみてください
Shot 6:

creator: @kana_style
hook_line: This oil spray is half price, it's really a godsend for cooking
pain_point: Hard to control oil amount, easy to overuse, high cooking calories
prompt_en:
[Style]: Healing, realistic product showcase style for kitchen essentials, with clear and delicate image quality, soft warm highlights, and natural, lifelike luster on ingredients and oil bottles, highlighting the core practical and aesthetic features of the products.
[Environment]: A warm, neatly arranged modern home kitchen. Next to the stove are glass storage jars with wooden lids and metal storage racks, with light brown wooden cutting boards and minimalist kitchen utensils placed in a well-organized layout. The entire scene creates a cozy, homely cooking atmosphere under ample natural light.
[Tone & Pacing]: Fast-paced narrative typical of short video product promotions, progressing step by step from cooking scene demonstrations to product detail introductions with well-balanced rhythm. It first grabs the audience's attention quickly through practical cooking scenarios, then focuses on the core advantages of the product, and finally introduces the limited-time promotional offer, keeping the whole flow smooth, compact and engaging.
[Camera]: Entirely shot with close-up macro lenses, flexibly using a first-person cooking perspective to accurately capture detailed actions such as oil spraying and egg liquid flowing. The camera moves smoothly and delicately to maximize the fluidity and visual effect of the product in use.
[Lighting]: Soft, even natural light combined with fill light, uniformly illuminating the kitchen countertop and cooking utensils. It fully showcases the fine texture of the non-stick baking tray, the bright color of the egg liquid, and the transparent luster of the oil bottle's glass material, resulting in a bright, clean image with no harsh shadows.
[Character]: No fully visible face appears in this video. Only the partial hands of an adult aged 20-40 are shown, with clean, smooth skin and no obvious blemishes. The movements are neat and skillful, completing a series of continuous actions including pressing the oil bottle to spray oil, pouring egg liquid, and holding the oil bottle for demonstration, conveying the proficiency and comfort of home cooking.

[Shots]
Shot 1:
  - Duration: 0.0sec - 2.0sec
  - Scene Type: Usage scenario setup
  - Scene: Bright and tidy home kitchen stove area. A black square non-stick baking tray is placed steadily on the gas stove. In the background, white glass storage jars with wooden lids and a minimalist metal kitchenware rack are clearly visible. A hand holds an oil spray bottle with a light beige cap, aims it at the baking tray and presses it gently. Fine, even oil mist sprays out in a fan shape onto the inner surface of the baking tray, with oil droplets spreading evenly across the matte non-stick coating.
  - Subject: このオイルスプレーが半額ってエグイ!マジで料理の
Shot 2:
  - Duration: 2.0sec - 4.5sec
  - Scene Type: Product effectiveness
  - Scene: Following the tilted rim of a bowl, the smooth, bright yellow egg liquid is slowly poured into the square non-stick baking tray. The egg liquid spreads naturally and evenly across the entire bottom surface of the oil-sprayed baking tray. Then the frame shows several tender white bubbling spots gradually appearing on the surface of the heated egg liquid, and the edges of the egg liquid start to set slightly.
  - Subject: の神アイテムシュッと人振りで 適量ノンフレーション
Shot 3:
  - Duration: 4.5sec - 8.5sec
  - Scene Type: Product versatility
  - Scene: The scene switches to the inside of an air fryer. Multiple shrimps that have been evenly coated with breadcrumbs are neatly arranged in the fryer basket. A hand holds the same oil spray bottle, reaches into the air fryer and presses it repeatedly to spray oil onto the breaded shrimps. The fine oil mist evenly covers the surface of every shrimp, and the breadcrumbs take on a slightly moist, appetizing luster after being coated with the oil mist.
  - Subject: フライヤーにも使えてカロリー オフガラス製で
Shot 4:
  - Duration: 8.5sec - 12.0sec
  - Scene Type: Product design highlights
  - Scene: The scene returns to the bright and tidy kitchen countertop, showing a close-up of this glass oil spray bottle. The fingertip of a hand gently presses the push button on the top of the bottle body, clearly demonstrating how easy and effortless the pressing action is. Then the hand holds the built-in light beige handle on the bottle body and lifts the oil bottle gently. The golden edible oil inside the bottle and the transparent glass material are fully in view. The oil bottle is held suspended to show all details to the camera from every angle. Finally, the hand slowly rotates the oil bottle against the kitchen background, clearly presenting the exquisite texture of the product that sets it apart from cheap, low-quality alternatives.
  - Subject: 押しやすさ抜群!安物とは全然違う!
Shot 5:
  - Duration: 12.0sec - 16.5sec
  - Scene Type: Limited-time offer
  - Scene: The oil spray bottle is placed steadily on a wooden countertop with a reflective finish, with the bottle body facing the camera directly. The background is a blurred, warm kitchen environment. At the bottom of the frame, three eye-catching yellow dynamic downward arrows keep jumping slowly, visually guiding the audience to pay attention to the purchase link area below.
  - Subject: 今なら限定半額クーポン配布中。下のリンクから。急いでゲットして
[Background Sound]:
- Upbeat TikTok-style background music with a fast tempo, strong drum beats, and relatively high volume, featuring electronic synthesizers and light vocal samples. Perfect for fast-paced product promotion videos, it creates a sense of urgency and excitement of 'limited-time flash sale + surprise discount', with a style similar to a 'promotion carnival anthem'. The track may be named 'Flash Sale Bounce' or 'Limited Time Deal Anthem', tailored for viral promotion of kitchen supplies and daily household goods.
[Transition / Editing]:
- Smooth fast jump cut editing that switches scenes naturally following the real logic of users' daily cooking scenarios. The overall rhythm is bright and compact, matching the popular editing style of Douyin short videos, with no awkward or abrupt transition effects throughout.

creator: @maina.diet
hook_line: This super popular compact self-standing pouch, you can buy it for 1 yen now
pain_point: Pouches tip over, messy storage, poor water resistance
prompt_en:
[Style]: Realistic Japanese e-commerce product recommendation aesthetic, with bright, vivid colors, sharp and clear product details, and a lively, engaging overall atmosphere that highlights the compact, practical nature of the cosmetic pouch.
[Environment]: A well-lit indoor home setting, with the core shooting area centered on a clean small white round table. On the right side of the table sits an ivy plant potted in a light green flower pot, and the background is a soft-textured light gray matte wall. Midway through the video, the scene switches to a bathroom vanity with a wall covered in small brown square tiles. The entire environment is neat, fresh, and full of the cozy comfort of everyday home life.
[Tone & Pacing]: The overall rhythm is tight and brisk, with one product selling point fully demonstrated every 2 to 3 seconds. Camera movements are sharp and unhurried, with a tone that carries the surprise and excitement of discovering a hidden gem product, firmly holding the audience's attention.
[Camera]: The entire video uses a first-person close-up perspective, primarily featuring fixed-position close-up shots of the product. The camera stays focused on the yellow portable self-standing cosmetic pouch, smoothly tracking and focusing on product details following hand movements, with no unnecessary shaking, resulting in a stable, clear image.
[Lighting]: Bright, soft indoor top-side natural light is used, with light evenly falling on the table surface and the product, creating soft highlights on the fabric surface of the cosmetic pouch. There are no harsh, sharp shadows, and the true color and fine texture of the product are clearly reproduced.
[Character]: A 20-30 year old Asian woman, with only her hands visible in the frame. Her hands have smooth, delicate skin, and her nails are done with an elegant nude fine-glitter manicure. Her movements are neat and gentle, exuding the refined, capable vibe of a home lifestyle sharing content creator.

[Shots]
Shot 1:
  - Duration: 0.0sec - 1.5sec
  - Scene Type: Handheld product display
  - Scene: A hand reaches in from the left side of the frame, holding the bright yellow cosmetic pouch, steadily rotating it from its side-lying position to face the camera directly. The yellow cosmetic pouch has a subtle white brand logo printed on its front, with the small white round table and the ivy plant on the right side of the table in the background. The Japanese subtitle 'マジか？！' pops up on the screen at the same time.
  - Subject: 1円でマジかこれがこうなっちゃうで
Shot 2:
  - Duration: 1.5sec - 3.5sec

  - Scene: The hand places the yellow cosmetic pouch steadily on the white table, then extends two fingers to perform a playful pinching and releasing motion. The background remains the light gray wall and the ivy potted plant behind it, and the Japanese subtitle 'こうなっちゃうで' pops up on the screen.
  - Subject: 1円でマジかこれがこうなっちゃうで
Shot 3:
  - Duration: 3.5sec - 4.5sec
  - Scene Type: Handheld product display
  - Scene: Both hands pinch the two side edges of the cosmetic pouch and pull it fully open, revealing all the various cosmetic items inside to the camera. Lipsticks, a powder compact, makeup brushes and other items are neatly stored in the inner compartments, with the light green flower pot and green plant on the table in the background.   - Subject: 今日バズルってコンパクト自立防止今田圭一
Shot 5:
  - Duration: 5.5sec - 8.5sec
  - Scene Type: Limited-time offer
  - Scene: The yellow cosmetic pouch is placed in the center of a pure white flat surface, with various beauty products including a powder compact, lipsticks, an eyelash curler, and a liquid foundation bottle arranged neatly in a circle around it. Then large, repeated white characters '超ラッキー' densely fill the entire frame, creating a strong promotional atmosphere. The Japanese subtitle '今だけ1円で買えちゃうあなたは' and dense '超ラッキー' text effects appear on the screen.
  - Subject: お疲れ様でした。
Shot 6:
  - Duration: 8.5sec - 10.5sec
  - Scene Type: Ease of use demonstration
  - Scene: The scene cuts back to the small white round table. Both hands pinch the zipper pulls on both sides of the yellow cosmetic pouch and slowly pull the zipper open toward both sides. During the movement, one hand gives a thumbs-up gesture toward the camera, with the ivy plant in the background. The Japanese subtitle 'まずはカートに追加して 価格を確認して！' pops up on the screen.
  - Subject: でかさ価格を確認してがばっと開くから
Shot 7:
  - Duration: 10.5sec - 12.0sec
  - Scene Type: Ease of use demonstration
  - Scene: Both hands quickly pull the yellow cosmetic pouch fully open, creating a wide opening that reveals all items inside the pouch completely unobstructed to the camera, making the storage space immediately clear. The Japanese subtitle 'ガバッと開くから' pops up on the screen.
  - Subject: でかさ価格を確認してがばっと開くから
Shot 8:

  - Scene Type: Ease of use demonstration
  - Scene: The camera cuts to a close-up of the other inner side of the cosmetic pouch, clearly showing the neatly arranged various beauty products in the layered inner compartments, with all items fully visible at a glance. The Japanese subtitle '中が一目で見えて' pops up on the screen.
  - Subject: 中が一目で見えてさっとコスメも取り出せしかもそのまま
Shot 9:

  - Subject: 中が一目で見えてさっとコスメも取り出せしかもそのまま
Shot 10:

  - Scene Type: Product design highlight
  - Scene: After the hand takes out the item, the yellow cosmetic pouch remains standing steadily upright on the white table without tipping or tilting, perfectly demonstrating its self-standing feature. The Japanese subtitle 'しかもそのまま自立するから' pops up on the screen.
  - Subject: 自立するからメイク中も超解析発生ショット
Shot 11:
  - Duration: 15.5sec - 17.5sec
  - Scene Type: Usage scenario setup
  - Scene: The scene cuts back to a close-up of the open cosmetic pouch. A hand easily takes out a black-shelled beauty product from inside the pouch, while the entire cosmetic pouch remains stably upright, simulating the usage scenario during daily makeup application. The Japanese subtitle 'メイク中も超快適' pops up on the screen.
  - Subject: 自立するからメイク中も超解析発生ショット

- A highly upbeat TikTok-style sales background music track with a fast tempo, strong drum beats, and full of energy. It plays at a relatively high volume with electronic synthesizer tones, featuring a catchy, highly repetitive melody perfect for fast-paced promotional short videos. The track is interspersed with hype-style vocal samples such as 'Yo!' and 'Check it!' to boost interactivity and a sense of urgency. The overall atmosphere is dynamic and pushes viewers to place orders, perfectly matching promotional phrases in the video like '1円で買える！', '今だけ！', and '即決！'. It is a typical viral BGM style for Japanese e-commerce short videos, similar to a mix of 'Kawaii Pop' and 'J-POP Dance', designed to create strong visual and audio impact for 'limited-time flash sales' and 'unbeatable surprises'.
[Transition / Editing]:
- The entire video uses bright, snappy jump cuts within the same scene, with smooth, natural shot transitions and tightly connected selling point demonstrations. Quick scene switches in the middle of the video raise the overall pace, amplifying the visual impact of the promotional product recommendation.

title: 新作 メンズストレッチパンツ スリムジョガーパンツ 吸汗速乾 軽量 ナイロンパンツ トレーニングウェア スポーツウェア カジ — Promo Pitch (Japan · Menswear & Underwear)
creator: @rina_lipg
hook_line: This men's stretch pants is light and stretchy
prompt_en:
[Style]: Japanese-style realistic product promotion aesthetic, with clear and bright imagery that highlights product details and discount promotional information. The overall visual style is clean and sharp, full of the authentic texture of a physical offline retail store.
[Environment]: A bright, tidy offline sports apparel store with sufficient soft lighting. In the background, various colored sports trousers are hung in a staggered arrangement, there are neatly stacked piles of folded clothing, and a standing sign printed with brand Sora Peak promotional content that displays a styling reference image of a fitness man, with a striking red promotional price tag hanging above it.
[Tone & Pacing]: An energetic product sharing promotion style, with a brisk and tight rhythm. The finger guiding movements are smooth and natural, leading the audience to learn about product selling points and discount information step by step, with full of contagious enthusiasm.
[Camera]: A fixed-position medium full shot perspective, focusing entirely on the men's stretch sports pants on the display stand and the guiding hand movements throughout the whole process. The footage is stable and clear with no large camera movements, ensuring the audience can fully see all product details and promotional information.
[Lighting]: Evenly distributed commercial store lighting, bright and soft with no harsh shadows, clearly illuminating the fabric texture of the pants and the text details on the promotional signs, creating a comfortable offline shopping visual atmosphere.
[Character]: Only one hand is visible, with fine, even natural skin tone, presenting a clean and neat product sharing vibe. The index finger is extended while the other four fingers are naturally bent and tucked in, pointing sequentially to different positions including the pants fabric, the function labels on the brand standing sign, and the promotional sign. The movements are steady, smooth, and accurately guide the audience's line of sight, with no face or other body parts shown.

[Shots]
Shot 1:
  - Duration: 0.0sec - 2.5sec
  - Scene Type: Product Design Highlights
  - Scene: Inside the bright sports apparel store, black men's stretch pants are displayed statically on a display stand printed with the Sora Peak brand logo, paired with black sports shoes. The background features the brand promotional standing sign and shelves full of various colored sports pants. Corresponding introduction subtitles appear at the bottom of the frame, and a hand reaches in from the right side of the frame, with the index finger first pointing at the leg part of the pants. The camera stays fixed, the frame remains stable, clearly capturing the complete full view of the product display.
  - Subject: このメンズストレッチパンツ、軽くてよく伸びるウィン
Shot 2:
  - Duration: 2.5sec - 7.5sec
  - Scene Type: Product Versatility
  - Scene: The finger moves slowly left from the pant leg, pointing sequentially to the function labels on the brand standing sign including High Stretch, Sweat Wicking & Quick Dry, Lightweight, Slim Fit. The movements are steady and smooth, guiding the audience to learn about each selling point of the pants one by one, with corresponding introduction subtitles appearing synchronously at the bottom of the frame. The camera remains fixed the entire time, focusing fully on the hand and the product display area.
  - Subject: 次に、急間速間でトレーニングにも 普段が使いにもぴったり。
Shot 3:
  - Duration: 7.5sec - 16.5sec
  - Scene Type: Limited-Time Offer
  - Scene: The finger lifts upward, pointing at the TikTok limited-time promotional price tag hanging in the upper right of the frame, pausing and moving the fingertip slightly to highlight the original price, discounted price, 65%OFF discount information, and relevant prompts for the limited-time promotion printed on the tag. Corresponding offer information introduction subtitles appear at the bottom of the frame. The camera still stays fixed, fully presenting all the promotional text details on the price tag.
  - Subject: しかも今なら2000都合。500円が875円なんと65%期間限定セール気になる方今すぐチェック。
[Background Sound]:
- Extremely upbeat TikTok-style instrumental music, with a lively brisk tempo of around 120-130 BPM, featuring electronic drum beats and bright synthesizer melodies, moderately high volume, belonging to the trendy promotional flash sale music style similar to the popular 'Shop Now Vibes' BGM commonly used in e-commerce short videos. It is purely rhythm-driven with no lyrics, creating a sense of urgency and excitement for limited-time flash deals and great value offers, perfectly matching promotional content such as 65%OFF and limited-time offers, improving the efficiency of visual information delivery and prompting viewers to click and buy immediately.
[Transition / Editing]:
- Smooth scene connection editing is used, maintaining a fixed camera perspective throughout the whole process. Different introduction segments are switched naturally through the hand movements without abrupt jumps, paired with synchronously appearing corresponding subtitles to help the audience understand product selling points and discount information.

prompt_en:

[Environment]: A sunlit corner of a home dining area, with light natural wood flooring paired with simple white walls. A white window frame on the left side of the frame lets in streams of light, and a minimalist dining chair with a natural wood frame is placed in the corner. The entire space is clean and tidy with no unnecessary clutter.
[Tone & Pacing]: A friendly, natural home sharing rhythm, with slow, clear movements that fully demonstrate every step of the operation. The narrative pace is gentle and smooth, allowing viewers to clearly understand the installation process and usage advantages of the dining chair cover.
[Camera]: Primarily shot from a first-person operation perspective, paired with close-up detail shots. The camera moves slowly following the hand movements, remaining steady throughout to clearly capture every detailed action of slipping, stretching, and smoothing the dining chair cover.
[Lighting]: Warm natural light pours in from the left-side window, casting soft, distinct shadows of the chair on the walls and floor. The light is even and bright, fully showcasing the fabric's texture and elastic quality.
[Character]: An Asian woman aged 25 to 30, with only her arms and hands visible. Her hands have delicate skin with natural texture, and her arm lines are well-proportioned. She wears a loose, long-sleeved loungewear top in light beige apricot, with slightly gathered, ruffled cuffs. She has a calm, meticulous, and approachable homey demeanor, with gentle, steady, unhurried and fluid hand movements.

[Shots]
Shot 1:
  - Duration: 0.0sec - 4.5sec
  - Scene Type: Set up the usage scenario
  - Scene: From a first-person perspective, a pair of hands enter the frame from both sides, holding the top edge of the grey elastic chair cover printed with black abstract line patterns. They align the cover with the top of the natural wood dining chair back, then slowly pull it down to gradually slip the entire chair back fully into the cover. During the process, the hands gently adjust the angle to make the cover fit smoothly against the chair back's contours, with Japanese product introduction subtitles appearing at the bottom of the frame at the same time.
  - Subject: 子供が失託の椅子をいつも散らかす
Shot 2:
  - Duration: 4.5sec - 10.5sec
  - Scene Type: Demonstrate ease of use

The fingertips of one hand pinch the corner of the chair cover and gently pull it outward to showcase the fabric's excellent elasticity. Then the palm is laid fully flat on the surface of the chair cover, slowly wiping and gliding across it to smooth out all wrinkles on the cover's surface, making the cover fit tightly against the edges of the seat. Japanese subtitles introducing the fabric's elasticity appear at the bottom of the frame at the same time.
  - Subject: これをさっとかぶせるだけでOK。この伸びぴったりフィットして花火で部屋が一気にまぶる
Shot 3:
  - Duration: 10.5sec - 17.5sec
  - Scene Type: Showcase product effectiveness

The camera slowly moves backward, gradually pulling further away to show the overall look of the chair in the corner. Japanese subtitles introducing the machine-washable property and encouraging viewers to purchase the product soon appear sequentially at the bottom of the frame.

- This video contains no background music or sound effects at all, with no musical distractions, fully highlighting the casual, conversational product introduction delivered in Japanese voiceover, featuring a friendly, natural tone and a brisk, clear rhythm.

- Smooth sequential scene editing is used, transitioning naturally from the close-up of installing the cover on the chair back to the detailed demonstration on the chair seat, before smoothly pulling back to a full wide shot. There are no abrupt cuts throughout, maintaining a visually coherent and comfortable viewing experience.
