[Environment]: 室内桌面手工创作场景，背景铺有柔软的浅粉色毛绒垫，桌面摆放着多格透明拼豆收纳盒、手工垫板、平板设备与各类手工配件，整体环境干净整洁，尽显手作爱好者的专属创作空间氛围。
[Tone & Pacing]: 轻松活泼的好物分享调性，节奏明快流畅，画面跳转衔接自然，用充满分享欲的节奏展示手工拼豆的选购与制作细节。
[Camera]: 全程采用第一人称近景特写视角，镜头聚焦拼豆收纳盒、手持的色卡、拼豆操作过程与像素图纸，镜头保持稳定，以静态定格的展示方式为主，精准呈现所有手工细节。
[Lighting]: 明亮均匀的室内顶光补光，光线柔和无阴影，清晰凸显拼豆的饱满色彩与细腻质感，整体画面通透鲜亮。
[Character]: 无出镜人物，所有画面均为物品特写展示，仅露出局部手指完成取豆、摆放等手工操作动作。

[Shots]
Shot 1:
  - 时长: 0.0sec - 3.5sec
  - 镜头类型: 产品展示
  - 画面: 铺满浅粉色毛绒垫的桌面上，整齐摆放着多套96色透明拼豆收纳盘，收纳盘内的拼豆色彩丰富饱满，画面全程叠加闪耀星光特效，搭配对应展示文字。
  - 口播: 이 영상은 이 영상에서 만났습니다.
Shot 2:
  - 时长: 3.5sec - 6.5sec
  - 镜头类型: 产品材质展示
  - 画面: 局部露出的手拿着印有“DIY拼豆【色盘A】”的色卡，将色卡贴近摆满绿、蓝、紫、粉等彩色拼豆的透明收纳盒，清晰展示收纳盒上标注的各色拼豆编号标签。
  - 口播: 私の買った96色パレットには
Shot 3:
  - 时长: 6.5sec - 9.5sec
  - 镜头类型: 产品设计亮点
  - 画面: 镜头切换到另一组拼豆收纳盒特写，盒内拼豆以蓝、紫、粉调为主，局部露出的手继续拿着色卡，展示色卡底部标注的G8色号标识，画面保留闪耀星光特效。
  - 口播: G15
Shot 4:
  - 时长: 9.5sec - 14.0sec
  - 镜头类型: 展示易用性
  - 画面: 一只手握着粉色的兔子造型拼豆工具，在白色带网格的拼豆垫板上，一粒粒精准摆放棕色拼豆，逐步拼出像素图案的轮廓，背景边缘可见平板设备的屏幕，过程中手的动作平稳细致。
  - 口播: 入ってなかったのよ
Shot 5:
  - 时长: 14.0sec - 16.0sec
  - 镜头类型: 产品使用场景
  - 画面: 画面展示平板屏幕上的轻松小熊像素线稿，平板正前方摆放着两个已经熨烫完成的立体拼豆成品，分别是浅色系带装饰的白熊造型、戴着厨师帽手持厨具的棕熊造型，还原度极高。
  - 口播: 다음 영상에서 만나요.
Shot 6:
  - 时长: 16.0sec - 19.5sec
  - 镜头类型: 产品多功能性
  - 画面: 镜头对准电脑屏幕显示的拼豆像素图纸，先是展示完整的小熊像素图案，随后画面逐步放大图纸的细节部分，清晰呈现图纸上标注的每一处拼豆色号标识，画面带有中文水印提示请勿二转图纸。
  - 口播: 君の目が僕を引き続ける
Shot 7:
  - 时长: 19.5sec - 22.0sec
  - 镜头类型: 产品设计亮点
  - 画面: 镜头聚焦像素图纸的局部特写，画面上布满G15、D17等色号标识，通过高亮底色突出G15色号的相关区域，搭配对应说明文字。
  - 口播: 도시 도시하는 이 느낌
Shot 8:
  - 时长: 22.0sec - 25.0sec
  - 镜头类型: 产品材质展示
  - 画面: 局部露出的手拿着两袋分装的奶白色G15拼豆，袋子上贴有标注“G15 MARD”的标签，画面叠加闪耀星光特效，清晰展示两袋拼豆的颗粒数量差异。
  - 口播: 이 생각에
Shot 9:
  - 时长: 25.0sec - 27.0sec
  - 镜头类型: 产品展示
  - 画面: 镜头切回初始的拼豆收纳盘全貌，收纳盘旁摆放着星星造型的拼豆模具、未拆封的配件包装等手工周边，画面保留闪耀星光特效，展示全套手工材料组合。
  - 口播: 君の笑顔가 잊혀질 수 없어
Shot 10:
  - 时长: 27.0sec - 28.0sec
  - 镜头类型: 互动收尾
  - 画面: 背景切换为纯黑色，仅保留蓝色发光风格的说明文字，画面简洁干净，作为视频收尾画面。
  - 口播: 감사합니다.
[Background Sound]:
- 非常欢快的TikTok风格背景音乐，节奏轻快活泼、音量适中偏高、带有电子流行元素，旋律抓耳且富有动感，属于日本流行电子舞曲（J-Pop Dance）风格，营造青春、时尚、高能量的氛围，适配手作好物分享内容，强化轻松活泼的分享氛围。
[Transition / Editing]:
- 采用流畅的场景跳转剪辑手法，每段展示画面自然衔接，画面全程叠加统一的闪耀星光特效，强化少女心手作视频的氛围质感。

title: ユーモア和文メッセージ風バックプリント半袖Tシャツ ユニセックス 綿100% オーバーサイズ クルーネック モノトーン 韓国 — Product Close-Up (Japan · Womenswear & Underwear)
creator: @salenavi
hook_line: Limited time discount
prompt_en:
[Style]: Realistic display style of Japanese trendy goods, the picture texture is clean and bright, the colors are vivid and full, with the typical stylistic features of local Japanese apparel promotion short videos.
[Environment]: Warm and bright home interior space, a round woven mat with tan edges laid on light log-colored flooring, soft natural diffused light filters in through the window, simple white soft furnishings are faintly visible in the background, the whole space is neat, comfortable and full of warm daily life atmosphere.
[Tone & Pacing]: The overall rhythm is slow and smooth, the camera movement is steady and fluid, there are no redundant actions throughout the process, focusing on the display of the T-shirt's details and style, conveying a relaxed product recommendation promotional atmosphere.
[Camera]: Adopt a top-down overhead perspective paired with a slow pulling-back panning camera movement, keep the lens steady and smooth throughout, sequentially present the close-up of the single item, the side-by-side display of two styles, and the enlarged view of the single item's details, accurately capturing the print details and silhouette texture of the T-shirt.
[Lighting]: Ample and soft diffused natural light pours in from the window, the light evenly covers the surface of the mat and the T-shirts, there are no harsh heavy shadows, the fabric texture and print colors of the T-shirts are presented naturally and clearly.
[Character]: No on-screen characters

[Shots]
Shot 1:
  - Duration: 0.0sec - 2.0sec
  - Scene Type: Limited-time offer
  - Scene: A white short-sleeved T-shirt printed with multiple lines of black, white and red contrasting color text and Chinese character patterns, laid flat on a light khaki round woven mat. The initial frame has blurry red and yellow dynamic light and shadow effects that fade away, then the picture becomes clear, a Japanese-style promotional sign with radial yellow lines pops up directly above the T-shirt, clearly marked with limited-time discount information, the camera maintains a steady overhead state, slowly focusing on the print pattern on the back of the T-shirt.
  - Subject: Oh
Shot 2:
  - Duration: 2.0sec - 5.5sec
  - Scene Type: Display of multiple style options (fashion category)
  - Scene: The camera perspective slowly pulls back, fully revealing two identical-print T-shirts, one black and one white, placed side by side on the mat. The text and patterns on the black T-shirt use white and red color matching, while the text and patterns on the white T-shirt use black and red color matching. The two T-shirts are neatly spread out, fully demonstrating the reference for the wearing effect of different colorways, the promotional sign at the top remains fixed at the top of the frame for continuous display.
  - Subject: Music
Shot 3:
  - Duration: 5.5sec - 8.5sec
  - Scene Type: Product material display
  - Scene: The camera pushes forward and focuses on the back print of the black T-shirt, zooming in to clearly show the full details of every line of text and Chinese character pattern on the T-shirt, then the camera slowly pulls back again, gradually revealing the full silhouette of the black T-shirt, the home space elements in the background are also slowly exposed, keeping the top promotional sign visible at all times.
  - Subject: Music
Shot 4:
  - Duration: 8.5sec - 8.7sec
  - Scene Type: Product material display
  - Scene: The camera stays in the pulled-back state that shows the full silhouette of the black T-shirt, with the home space elements in the background fully revealed.
  - Subject: you
[Background Sound]:
- Light and healing Lo-fi piano tune: soft piano melody, slow rhythm, with subtle drum beats and ambient white noise, the overall atmosphere is warm and relaxing, suitable for the daily life display scene of Japanese-style trendy T-shirts, instrumental music with no obvious lyrics, moderate volume that does not steal focus, enhancing the immersive feeling of relaxed product recommendation.
[Transition / Editing]:
- Use dynamic blur light and shadow effects as the opening transition, then use smooth push-pull camera movements to complete natural transitions between different display shots, the overall editing rhythm is slow, the picture connection is smooth and unbroken, prioritizing the display of the T-shirt products.
prompt_zh:
[Style]: 日系潮品写实展示风，画面质感干净通透，色彩明快饱满，带有典型的日本本土服饰促销短视频的风格特征。
[Environment]: 温暖明亮的家居室内空间，浅原木色地板上铺着边缘棕褐色的圆形编织地垫，窗边透进柔和的自然漫射光，背景隐约可见白色简约软装，整体整洁舒适充满温馨生活化氛围。
[Tone & Pacing]: 整体节奏舒缓流畅，运镜平稳丝滑，全程无多余冗余动作，专注于T恤的细节与款式展示，传递出轻松种草的促销氛围。
[Camera]: 采用俯视顶拍视角搭配缓慢拉远的平移运镜，全程保持镜头平稳顺滑，依次完成单品特写、双款同框展示、单品细节放大的画面呈现，精准捕捉T恤上的印花细节与版型质感。
[Lighting]: 充足柔和的漫射自然光从窗边倾洒而入，光线均匀覆盖在地垫与T恤表面，没有生硬浓重的阴影，T恤的面料肌理与印花色彩都得到自然清晰的呈现。
[Character]: 无出镜人物

[Shots]
Shot 1:
  - 时长: 0.0sec - 2.0sec
  - 镜头类型: 限时优惠
  - 画面: 一件印有多行黑白红撞色文字与汉字图案的白色短袖T恤，平整铺放在浅卡其色的圆形编织地垫上。初始画面带有模糊的红黄动态光影特效过渡消散，随后画面恢复清晰，T恤正上方弹出一块带有放射状黄色线条的日系促销标识牌，清晰标注着限时折扣信息，镜头保持平稳俯视状态，缓慢聚焦在T恤后背的印花图案上。
  - 口播: Oh
Shot 2:
  - 时长: 2.0sec - 5.5sec
  - 镜头类型: 展示多款式选择（时尚品类）
  - 画面: 镜头视角缓缓拉远，地垫上完整呈现出并排摆放的黑色与白色两款同款印花T恤，黑T恤的文字图案为白红配色，白T恤的文字图案为黑红配色，两款T恤整齐铺展，完整展示出不同配色的上身效果参考，顶部的促销标识牌始终固定在画面上方保持展示。
  - 口播: Music
Shot 3:
  - 时长: 5.5sec - 8.5sec
  - 镜头类型: 产品材质展示
  - 画面: 镜头向前推近并聚焦在黑色T恤的后背印花上，放大清晰展示T恤每一行文字与汉字图案的完整细节，随后镜头再次缓慢拉远，逐步呈现出黑色T恤的完整版型，背景里的家居空间元素也随之缓缓露出，始终保持顶部促销标识牌的可见状态。
  - 口播: Music
Shot 4:
  - 时长: 8.5sec - 8.7sec
  - 镜头类型: 产品材质展示
  - 画面: 镜头处于拉远后呈现黑色T恤完整版型的状态，背景家居空间元素完整露出。
  - 口播: you
[Background Sound]:
- 轻松治愈的Lo-fi钢琴小调：柔和的钢琴旋律，节奏舒缓，带有轻微的鼓点和环境白噪音，整体氛围温暖、放松，适配日系潮流T恤的生活化展示场景，纯音乐无明显歌词，音量适中不抢镜，强化轻松种草的情绪代入感。
[Transition / Editing]:
- 以动态模糊的光影特效作为开场转场，后续采用丝滑的推拉运镜完成不同展示画面的自然过渡，全程剪辑节奏舒缓，画面衔接流畅无卡顿，突出T恤商品的展示优先级。

title: シアートップス 長袖 透け感 夏 涼しい UV シアー カットソー トップス レディース ラウンドネック 選べるタイプ 重ね — Talking Head (Japan · Womenswear & Underwear)
creator: @mamalife_jp
hook_line: Does this have a sheer effect? This sheer top can be worn, if you wear a camisole inside
pain_point: Sheer tops are see-through, improper matching affects appearance
prompt_en:
[Style]: Japanese-style daily outfit sharing aesthetic, with bright and soft image quality, fresh and natural colors, balancing practicality and a strong product-recommending vibe.
[Environment]: A well-lit Japanese-style clothing room, with a white floor-standing clothing rack against the wall filled with clothes of all colors, a mannequin dressed in a brown top and dark wide-leg pants standing next to it, a round vintage wall clock hanging on the wall, and solid wood flooring, creating a neat and cozy setup.
[Tone & Pacing]: An energetic Japanese-style blogger sharing tone, with a friendly and natural manner, brisk and smooth rhythm, sharp clean shot transitions, maintaining a tight yet approachable presentation pace throughout the video.
[Camera]: Primarily uses the blogger's front-facing selfie perspective, paired with close-up detail shots. The camera moves naturally following the blogger's demonstration actions, stays stable, and occasionally zooms in slightly to adjust focus for showcasing finer details.
[Lighting]: Uses even, soft indoor natural light that spills naturally from the side, with no harsh strong shadows, clearly presenting the colors and sheer texture of the clothing, making the entire frame bright and translucent.
[Character]: East Asian woman aged 23-28, with fair smooth skin, an oval face and natural long wavy hair, sheer no-makeup makeup look, well-proportioned figure, wearing casual Japanese-style outfits, with a friendly and lively temperament, relaxed natural movements, and a bright smile the entire time.

[Shots]
Shot 1:
  - Duration: 0.0sec - 9.5sec
  - Scene Type: Outfit styling demonstration
  - Scene: The blogger wears a white sheer long-sleeve top paired with blue jeans, holds a mini lavalier mic, gently pulls the shoulder fabric towards the camera to show the top's sheer texture, then lifts up a brown camisole to show the styling effect to the camera, keeping a natural sharing smile with smooth, relaxed movements the whole time.
  - Subject: これって透け感あるん?このシェアトップスちゃんとつけますでも中にキャミタンクトップ着たら透けててもめっちゃ変わらないですよね
Shot 2:
  - Duration: 9.5sec - 16.0sec
  - Scene Type: Outfit styling demonstration
  - Scene: The blogger smiles, raises a hand to show the number one to emphasize a key point, then holds a stack of long-sleeve tops in various colors to showcase different color and style options, and makes a cute playful gesture of crossing her arms as if feeling cold on camera to introduce the idea of layered outfits.
  - Subject: で、一番のおすすめは実は2枚買い一番は1枚でこんな感じでさらっときて ちょっとだけ肌寒くなってきたら
Shot 3:
  - Duration: 16.0sec - 19.5sec
  - Scene Type: Outfit styling demonstration
  - Scene: The blogger changes into a brown long-sleeve inner top layered under the white sheer top, stands in front of the camera, raises her hand to show the detail of the white fabric edge peeking out from the cuff, and the camera zooms in slightly to focus on the layered effect at the cuff.
  - Subject: 今生きるのが今年のトレンドやで配色がちら見えして一気におしゃれ上級者
Shot 4:
  - Duration: 19.5sec - 21.5sec
  - Scene Type: Outfit styling demonstration
  - Scene: The blogger changes into a pink long-sleeve inner top layered under the white sheer top, turns around in a small circle while slightly sideways, showing the fashion sense of the full layered outfit from multiple angles, with a relaxed and cheerful surrounding atmosphere.
  - Subject: 一体めちゃくちゃ可愛くない?袖とか
Shot 5:
  - Duration: 21.5sec - 28.5sec
  - Scene Type: Outfit styling demonstration
  - Scene: The blogger changes into a yellow-green long-sleeve inner top layered under the white sheer top, pulls the fabric at the shoulder and neck positions to show the detailed layered effect of the two overlapping fabrics at the neckline and cuffs, looking at the camera with a satisfied smile.
  - Subject: この首元とかも前重ねになっててそれが見えるのがむちゃくちゃ可愛い ただすでに売り切れてるから
Shot 6:
  - Duration: 28.5sec - 32.0sec
  - Scene Type: Product material demonstration
  - Scene: The camera switches to a close-up perspective, a hand swipes across the various colored long-sleeve tops hanging on the clothing rack one by one, then pinches the fabric of the white sheer top to show the fine sheer texture of the fabric up close.
  - Subject: 今なら50%オフの方がいいです
Shot 7:
  - Duration: 32.0sec - 37.5sec
  - Scene Type: Order process guidance
  - Scene: The blogger changes into a dark gray long-sleeve top, stands in front of the camera holding a stack of clothes in various colors, introduces the discount information to the camera with a surprised happy smile, and at the same time raises her hand to follow the red on-screen arrow pointing to the left side of the frame, guiding viewers to click to view the link.
  - Subject: クーポンで出てこんなに安く買えるから左上のリンクからチェックしてみてー
[Background Sound]:
- Very upbeat TikTok-style background music with a lively, brisk rhythm, moderately high volume, featuring pop electronic beats and playful synthesizer tones. The style is similar to popular TikTok fashion outfit background tracks, creating a relaxed, trendy, highly product-recommending atmosphere that perfectly matches the pace of the outfit sharing and promotion video.
[Transition / Editing]:
- Uses bright, smooth jump-cut editing. The scene switches naturally after demonstrating each individual item's details or a full layered outfit, paired with dynamic pop-up on-screen text and guiding arrows to match the relaxed pace of Japanese-style short product recommendation videos.
prompt_zh:
[Style]: 日系日常穿搭分享风，画面质感明亮柔和，色彩清新自然，兼具实用性与种草氛围感。
[Environment]: 采光充足的日系风格服装间，靠墙摆放挂满各色衣物的白色落地衣架，旁立棕色上衣配深色阔腿裤的人台模特，墙面挂圆形复古挂钟，地面为实木地板，布置整洁温馨。
[Tone & Pacing]: 活力满满的日系博主分享风格，语气亲切自然，节奏轻快流畅，镜头切换利落，全程保持紧凑且富有亲和力的展示节奏。
[Camera]: 以博主正面自拍视角为主，搭配近距离细节特写镜头，运镜随博主的展示动作自然移动，镜头稳定，偶尔配合展示细节微微拉近对焦调整。
[Lighting]: 采用室内均匀柔和的自然光，光线从侧面自然洒落，没有强烈的明暗阴影，清晰呈现出衣物的色彩与透视质感，整体画面通透明亮。
[Character]: 东亚23-28岁女性，肌肤白皙细腻，鹅蛋脸配自然长卷发，清透裸妆，身形匀称，身着休闲日系风穿搭，气质亲切活泼，动作舒展自然，全程面带明媚笑容。

[Shots]
Shot 1:
  - 时长: 0.0sec - 9.5sec
  - 镜头类型: 穿搭搭配示范
  - 画面: 博主身着白色透视长袖上衣搭配蓝色牛仔裤，手持迷你收音麦，对着镜头抬手轻扯肩部面料展示上衣的透视质感，随后举起一件棕色吊带背心，向镜头展示搭配效果，全程面带自然的分享笑容，动作流畅放松。
  - 口播: これって透け感あるん?このシェアトップスちゃんとつけますでも中にキャミタンクトップ着たら透けててもめっちゃ変わらないですよね
Shot 2:
  - 时长: 9.5sec - 16.0sec
  - 镜头类型: 穿搭搭配示范
  - 画面: 博主面带笑容，抬手比出数字强调重点，随后抱着一堆各色长袖上衣，展示不同的颜色款式，配合画面表现出微微抱臂作势发冷的可爱动作，引出叠穿的搭配思路。
  - 口播: で、一番のおすすめは実は2枚買い一番は1枚でこんな感じでさらっときて ちょっとだけ肌寒くなってきたら

[Camera]: The video opens with a full wide shot that shows the entire space and the empty wardrobe. The camera then pans steadily to the right to follow the woman's movement as she pulls open the wardrobe curtains, before naturally shifting to a medium close-up to capture the fine details of hanging clothes and arranging folded items. Finally, the camera pulls back to a full wide shot, remaining completely stable and free of shake throughout the entire sequence.
[Lighting]: Soft natural light filtering in through the window is used as the main light source, spreading evenly across the wardrobe and the woman with no harsh, sharp shadows. The overall lighting is soft and luminous, creating a warm, cozy home atmosphere.

She has a slender, well-proportioned figure, wears a fitted olive green short-sleeve T-shirt paired with off-white high-waisted wide-leg trousers, and carries a friendly, energetic demeanor. title: Vaso térmico infantil de acero inoxidable con pajita — Handheld Demo (Mexico · Kitchenware)

hook_line: Are you looking for a thermos for this back to school?
pain_point: Can't find a suitable thermos for kids back to school
prompt_en:
[Style]: Douyin-style realistic product review aesthetic, with bright, saturated screen colors that emphasize the soft, delicate pastel texture of the macaron-colored thermos cups, bringing an authentic, real-life filming feel that makes product displays intuitive and clear.
[Environment]: A home indoor desktop scene, covered with a tablecloth that has a white base and light gray daisy patterns. On the warm orange wall in the background, the brand outer packaging boxes of the two thermos cups are placed. The overall lighting is bright and clean, creating a warm and cozy atmosphere for product sharing.
[Tone & Pacing]: The rhythm is relaxed and gentle, with a strong explanatory sharing vibe. Sufficient screen dwell time is reserved for every product function demonstration, allowing viewers to clearly observe core details of the thermos cups such as leak-proof performance and the stainless steel inner liner.
[Camera]: The entire video is shot from a first-person top-down fixed camera position, with the lens focused on the two thermos cups on the table. There are no large-scale camera movements, only extremely slight natural shakes that follow hand movements, to the greatest extent restoring the real perspective of daily unboxing and display.
[Lighting]: Even, bright indoor top-lit diffused natural light, with no harsh shadows. The soft light spreads evenly across the entire table, perfectly presenting the fine matte texture on the surface of the thermos cups and the metallic luster of the inner stainless steel liner.
[Character]: Only a pair of hands appears on screen, no full human figure is shown. The hands have delicate, fair and smooth skin with no obvious fine lines, and the movements are gentle and neat, conveying a careful and patient product sharing vibe, flexibly completing operations such as pouring water, twisting the lid, and flipping the thermos cups.

[Shots]
Shot 1:
  - Duration: 0.0sec - 3.5sec
  - Scene Type: Problem setup

One hand holds the pink lid of the pink thermos cup and slowly pours water into the pink thermos cup, the water level gradually rises, and fine foam forms inside the cup. The title text 'Vaso térmico para niños' decorated with cursive hearts and the white text 'Anti derrames' pop up on the screen in sequence.

Shot 2:
  - Duration: 3.5sec - 7.5sec
  - Scene Type: Product material display

One hand holds the pink water cup and pours water into the light purple thermos cup, clear water flows into the cup, layers of fine bubbles form inside, fully demonstrating the stainless steel inner liner structure of the thermos cup.
  - Subject: Yo encontré este y me encantó porque es antiderrapalmático.
Shot 3:
  - Duration: 7.5sec - 11.0sec
  - Scene Type: Ease of use demonstration
  - Scene: After pouring water is finished, one hand pinches the white lid of the light purple thermos cup which has a purple handle, and slowly twists the lid tight along the threads with a steady, smooth motion to ensure the lid is fully tightened and sealed.
  - Subject: y es perfecto para traerlo en la mochila
Shot 4:
  - Duration: 11.0sec - 15.0sec

  - Subject: o lonchera escolar.  Además, hay muchos conocimientos
Shot 5:

The two macaron-colored thermos cups are fully presented in the frame, with the product packaging boxes in the background also clearly visible. The screen freezes to showcase the overall appearance and shape of the products.
  - Subject: colores. Gracias.
[Background Sound]:
- A very cheerful TikTok-style background music with a brisk, lively rhythm, moderately high volume, and electronic pop elements. The melody has strong memorability and a distinct beat, perfectly suited for campus life and student product marketing videos, creating an atmosphere of youth, energy, practicality and fashion. The song style is similar to 'Pop Dance' or 'Gen Z Trendy', and pairs well with keywords such as 'Back to School Season', 'Must-Have for Students', 'Portable Design' to boost audience immersion and purchasing impulse.
[Transition / Editing]:
- Natural, coherent action-matched editing is used, with every operation segment seamlessly connected without abrupt jumps. The screen perspective remains consistent throughout, allowing viewers to smoothly follow the demonstration rhythm to watch the full function display of the thermos cups.

title: Camiseta cómoda para hombre Alo — OOTD Showcase (Mexico · Menswear & Underwear)
creator: @batflux2
hook_line: A man stands in a bedroom with vintage records and posters, holding four pink short-sleeved T-shirts
prompt_en:
[Style]: American streetwear realistic style, with sharp and clear image quality that accurately highlights muscle definition and the fine texture of clothing fabrics, presenting the authentic tough temperament of street sport outfit sharing.
[Environment]: A men's bedroom decorated with vintage records and trendy posters, with a large bed covered in white bedding, dark brown walls and a white door frame visible in the background, accented with trendy personalized hanging ornaments in the corners. The overall space is well-lit, a daily home display scene full of personal style.
[Tone & Pacing]: Energetic and tough product presentation style, with a bright, smooth pace and natural, unhurried shot transitions. The entire showcase focuses on the details and wearing effect of the men's fitted short-sleeve shirt, and the camera movement rhythm precisely aligns with the drum beats of the background music.
[Camera]: Opens with a full-body panoramic view, then flexibly switches to medium close-ups, collar close-ups, and fabric macro shots, paired with a 45-degree side angle to show the lines of the arms and pectoral muscles, and finally uses an orbiting moving shot to present the full silhouette. All camera movements are stable and fluid.
[Lighting]: Uses a combination of bright, soft indoor top light and side fill light to evenly illuminate the entire body of the subject, effectively softening facial shadows, and clearly outlining the fitted drape of the T-shirt and the three-dimensional contours of the man's muscles. The overall lighting is clean and translucent.
[Character]: A 25-30 year old Caucasian man with a healthy tanned complexion, sharp, clear tattoo lines on his arms, firm and glossy skin, a well-defined jawline, no makeup, and a robust, athletic build with full, defined pectoral and arm muscles. He wears a light pink fitted branded short-sleeve shirt on top and black athletic shorts on the bottom, with a sunny, tough and powerful temperament. His movements focus on showcasing the features of the clothing, and his expression is calm, confident and relaxed.

[Shots]
Shot 1:
  - Duration: 0.0sec - 1.0sec
  - Scene Type: Handheld product display
  - Scene: A man stands in a men's bedroom decorated with vintage records and trendy posters, with walls covered in record posters and a large bed with white bedding visible in the background. He holds four neatly stacked pink short-sleeve T-shirts printed with brand logos in both hands, then sets down the stack of T-shirts to reveal the same style light pink short-sleeve shirt he is wearing, with tattoos covering the man's arms.
Shot 2:
  - Duration: 1.0sec - 3.5sec
  - Scene Type: Product material display
  - Scene: The man standing in place first raises his hand to gently smooth the fabric across his chest to remove wrinkles, then pinches the hem of the T-shirt and pulls it outward slightly before releasing it, demonstrating the fitted cut of the T-shirt and the elasticity of the fabric. Shot 3:
  - Duration: 3.5sec - 5.5sec
  - Scene Type: Product design highlights
  - Scene: The camera cuts to a close-up of the collar. The man, wearing a silver bracelet on his hands, pinches both sides of the crew neck collar respectively, gently pulls it outward and then releases it to let the collar return to its original shape, clearly showing the detailed stitching of the collar and its deformation-resistant property.
Shot 4:
  - Duration: 5.5sec - 6.5sec
  - Scene Type: Product material display
  - Scene: The camera pushes in to a close-up of the chest and abdomen area. The man places the palms of both hands on the chest and abdomen of the T-shirt, and gently rubs in circular motions to showcase the fine, smooth texture of the fabric. The close-up shot fully presents the flat, smooth fabric surface of the T-shirt.
Shot 5:
  - Duration: 6.5sec - 8.0sec
  - Scene Type: OOTD outfit display
  - Scene: The camera shifts to a 45-degree side angle of the subject. The man stands naturally, showing the fitted cut effect on the side of the T-shirt, fully presenting the fit between the arm muscle lines and the tight T-shirt. The bedroom bed in the background is faintly visible, and the arm tattoos and firm muscle lines are clearly prominent from the sleeves of the fitted short-sleeve shirt.
Shot 6:
  - Duration: 8.0sec - 9.5sec
  - Scene Type: OOTD outfit display
  - Scene: The camera returns to a full front panoramic view of the subject. The man takes small steps slightly and turns his body at a small angle, fully showing the wearing effect of the entire pink short-sleeve shirt from different perspectives, comprehensively presenting the overall silhouette of the T-shirt and the trendy feel of daily wear.
[Background Sound]:
- West Coast vintage hip-hop rap background music with a strong rhythmic beat, heavy bass and dense drum patterns, featuring a magnetic male rap verse with lyrics referencing street life imagery such as homies and prayers in the streetlight. Vintage synthesizer tones enhance the nostalgic street vibe, the tempo is bright and full of energy, the overall atmosphere is tough and assertive, perfectly matching the display rhythm of trendy sportswear.
[Transition / Editing]:
- Uses fast, smooth hard-cut editing techniques, precisely switching to the next display shot after each demonstration action is completed, fully matching the drum beat rhythm of the background music. No unnecessary transition effects are used throughout, the picture rhythm is tight and bright, highlighting all core selling points of the clothing.

title: [JARETA]Pegamento Impermeable Transparente — Real Review (Mexico · Tools & Hardware)

hook_line: This is not glue, it's waterproof adhesive, I swear...
pain_point: Building cracks leak water and are hard to repair
prompt_en:
[Style]: Realistic engineering demonstration style, highlighting the actual construction effect and waterproof performance of the product. The image details are sharp and clear, with distinct light and shadow layers, emphasizing the translucent texture of the waterproof material after it cures transparently.
[Environment]: Covers multiple typical building waterproofing work scenarios: under the stone vault of an arcade-style commercial street in daytime, on the rooftop terrace of a high-rise urban building, next to the curved concrete exterior wall of a building under construction, in the drainage ditch area of a red-tiled roof, beside the outer windowsill of a modern office building, and on the cement floor of a spacious industrial factory. All scenes are set on clear sunny days with ample natural light, and the locations are clean and tidy.
[Tone & Pacing]: Conversational recommendation sharing style, with a tight, smooth rhythm. Each shot switches quickly, sequentially showing different construction scenarios, material properties and waterproof testing processes. The entire video maintains a dynamic, engaging introduction pace, conveying product advantages intuitively and efficiently.
[Camera]: Uses low-angle upward shots to display the vault work scene, paired with high-altitude aerial shots to overlook the completed large-area construction effect on the rooftop. A large number of close-ups and detail shots are used to focus on the smearing details of the material, the transparent film-forming texture, and the waterproof testing process as water flows over the surface. Camera movements are steady and smooth.
[Lighting]: Sufficient natural daylight is used as the main light source, with even, bright light that accurately outlines the translucent luster of the cured transparent waterproof material, and clearly shows the crack details of the concrete base layer. The rooftop scene at dusk uses soft golden side light to enhance the atmospheric feel of the frame.
[Character]: Multiple adult male construction workers aged 25-45, primarily of East Asian and Caucasian descent, with tanned skin from outdoor work, no makeup, and robust, upright builds. They wear professional work uniforms, some paired with bright-colored safety reflective vests and safety helmets, perform skilled, standard movements, appear focused and dedicated, and carry a professional, reliable demeanor.

[Shots]
Shot 1:
  - Duration: 0.0sec - 3.5sec
  - Scene Type: Product Effectiveness
  - Scene: Under the stone vault of a commercial street arcade, a construction worker wearing a yellow safety helmet, dark work uniform, and protective gloves of different colors on both hands holds a long-handled hard brush, repeatedly and evenly brushing white waterproof material onto the stone surface of the vault. The camera then moves briefly to show an empty shot of the finished vault surface. Immediately after, the construction worker stands under the vault holding a black bucket, and pours the entire bucket of water onto the completed vault surface to perform a water spray test. The initial shot uses a stable low-angle upward angle aimed at the vault work area, naturally capturing the flowing trajectory of the water as the pouring action happens. The person on screen is a building waterproofing worker holding a long-handled brush.
  - Subject: No es pegamento, es un adhesivo impermeable. Juro que...
Shot 2:
  - Duration: 3.5sec - 6.0sec
  - Scene Type: Product Usage Scenario
  - Scene: On the open rooftop terrace of a high-rise urban building, two construction workers — one wearing an orange reflective vest over a gray work uniform, the other wearing a plain gray T-shirt and dark work pants — cooperate seamlessly, holding a long-handled scraper and a long-handled rake respectively to spread the waterproof material evenly, fully covering the large cracks on the cement rooftop surface. The camera pauses briefly to show the completely filled rooftop puddle area, where the water surface reflects the drifting clouds in the sky, and the original cracks are entirely gone. The camera moves slowly upward from the workers' foot area, fully showing the entire process of the two construction workers cooperating on the task. The people on screen are two rooftop waterproofing workers.
  - Subject: que nunca esperé que fuera tan bueno soluciona por completo
Shot 3:
  - Duration: 6.0sec - 8.5sec
  - Scene Type: Product Effectiveness
  - Scene: A construction worker wearing an orange reflective vest holds a high-pressure water gun, continuously spraying water onto the completed cement rooftop surface. The camera then cuts to a high-altitude aerial perspective, looking straight down at the entire rooftop from above. The waterproof layer on the rooftop surface forms a complete, continuous water surface that clearly reflects the surrounding residential buildings and the sky, with no trace of the original cement cracks visible. The high-pressure water gun shot uses a medium shot at eye level, then the camera seamlessly switches to the high-altitude overhead aerial perspective to show the finished effect of the entire rooftop. The person on screen is a construction worker holding a high-pressure water gun.
  - Subject: Las filtraciones y la humedad de mi casa Se vuelve totalmente
Shot 4:
  - Duration: 8.5sec - 14.0sec
  - Scene Type: Product Design Highlights
  - Scene: Next to the curved rough concrete exterior wall of a building under construction, a hand grips a stainless steel trowel, spreading the white viscous waterproof material evenly onto the wall surface covered with numerous spiderweb cracks. The material flows naturally, levels out gradually, and finally cures into a fully transparent waterproof membrane that almost blends into the wall, as if a transparent curved glass is embedded in the wall. Then someone holds a high-pressure water gun and continuously sprays water onto the transparent waterproof layer; the water flows quickly down the smooth surface of the transparent membrane, leaving no water seepage traces on the concrete base layer. The entire shot uses a close-up framing, focusing on the trowel's spreading action and the full process of the material gradually curing and turning transparent. The person on screen is a construction worker holding a stainless steel trowel.
  - Subject: transparente después de secarse. Es reciente
[Background Sound]:
- No background music, the entire runtime is accompanied by a clear, energetic Spanish voiceover introducing the product, with an overall enthusiastic, engaging atmosphere full of recommendation appeal.
[Transition / Editing]:
- Uses fast jump-cut editing with no black frames, directly hard-cutting between different work scenes. All shots are connected through the unified narrative logic showing the full process of the waterproof material from application, curing to water-spraying testing, creating a visually coherent and dynamic flow that fits the fast-paced storytelling style of short-form recommendation videos.

title: TOYO-G 4T Fuel System Cleaner Motorbike — Real Review (Malaysia · Automotive & Motorcycle)
creator: @nafkahhalal90
hook_line: When I floor the throttle, power is insufficient and exhaust emits black smoke
pain_point: Motorcycle engine clogged with carbon, poor power performance
prompt_en:
[Style]: Cartoon-realism creative style that anthropomorphizes the internal parts of a motorcycle engine, combining real riding scenes with hand-drawn textured industrial animation, sharp highlights and full of dynamic energy
[Environment]: Opening on a nighttime urban highway where warm streetlights form glowing light trails and palm trees loom faintly through the dark; then cuts to the dim, aged interior of a motorcycle engine heavily caked with carbon deposits and covered in oil grime; next transitions to a private driveway front porch in daytime with bright pouring sunlight and a tidy environment; finally moves to the brightened engine interior, first-person riding perspective on a nighttime highway, and a product display workshop
[Tone & Pacing]: The early segment uses anthropomorphized parts in painful struggle to build anxiety, the mid segment demonstrating product pouring has a gentle, approachable rhythm, the later cleaning process is full of satisfying, cathartic relief, and the closing riding and product showcase flows smoothly and powerfully. The overall pace is tight, perfectly suited for fast-paced short video distribution
[Camera]: Abundant close-up animation shots focus on the facial expression details of the anthropomorphized parts, paired with first-person riding perspective to simulate real driving sensation. Fast jump cuts connect different scenes, and tight close-ups clearly display the product's exterior details
[Lighting]: The opening nighttime highway uses warm yellow side lighting from street lamps to create a traffic atmosphere; the engine interior combines orange-red firelight and low light to emphasize the grimy, run-down condition; the daytime front porch uses warm natural light that is bright and soft; during the cleaning phase, the cool glow of blue liquid paired with orange-yellow flames creates a strong warm-cold contrast; the workshop uses warm ambient lighting to highlight the product's texture
[Character]: A 30-something Southeast Asian male rider with healthy tanned skin, a cartoon-style small mustache on his face, large-frame sunglasses, no extra makeup, a sturdy and well-proportioned build, wearing a black motorcycle leather jacket and jeans, and a blue branded helmet. He is sunny and confident, leaning forward to control the throttle while riding with smooth, natural movements, his mood shifting from frustrated and annoyed to relaxed and proud, with full and infectious emotion

[Shots]
Shot 1:
  - Duration: 0.0sec - 5.5sec
  - Scene Type: Highlight the pain point problem
  - Scene: On a nighttime urban highway, the cartoon-style Southeast Asian rider on a blue motorcycle follows behind a car, his body swaying back and forth continuously, black smoke billowing from the motorcycle exhaust pipe, and the background streetlights stretching into long glowing light trails. The entire frame is full of dynamism, showing the scene of the motorcycle suffering from weak power output
  - Subject: Aduh, asal semput ni.  Tengah sedap lock throttle high speed.
Shot 2:
  - Duration: 5.5sec - 15.0sec
  - Scene Type: Highlight the pain point problem

title: [Affiliate Top Pick] Dettol Washing Machine Cleaner — Real Review (Malaysia · Home Supplies)

[Environment]: A well-lit residential laundry room scene. Above the silver front-loading washing machine in the background sits a wooden shelf, neatly stacked with folded beige towels and various laundry care bottles. Abundant natural light streams in through the window, making the entire space tidy and warm.
[Tone & Pacing]: The overall recommendation style is sincere and down-to-earth, with a smooth, relaxed pace and steady, natural camera movement. It demonstrates the full washing machine cleaning process step by step, allowing viewers to easily pick up the cleaning tip.
[Camera]: Fixed close-up shots are used throughout the whole sequence, focusing tightly on the washing machine drum and product details. The camera stays completely stable without shaking, accurately capturing key moments including liquid pouring, drum agitation, and the spotless empty drum.
[Lighting]: Even, soft indoor overhead lighting is paired with diffused natural light from the window. The illumination is bright and clear with no harsh shadows, clearly highlighting the sheen of the washing machine's metal inner drum, the flowing texture of the liquid, and the vivid colors of the product packaging.
[Character]: No full human figure appears on screen, only a partial arm is visible: a healthy, evenly toned adult male arm wearing a black sports wristband, performing steady, smooth movements that only complete the action of pouring the cleaning liquid.

[Shots]

  - Duration: 0.0sec - 3.5sec
  - Scene Type: Demonstration of usage method
  - Scene: Close-up shot of a hand wearing a black wristband, holding a yellow-bottled Dettol washing machine cleaner, slowly pouring the pale yellow cleaning liquid inside the bottle into the empty inner drum of the silver front-loading washing machine, as the cleaning liquid flows down the drum wall.
Shot 2:
  - Duration: 3.5sec - 9.5sec
  - Scene Type: Product effectiveness demonstration
  - Scene: The frame cuts to a close-up of the running washing machine. Inside the transparent door of the LG-branded front-loading washing machine, the yellow cleaning liquid churns continuously as the drum rotates, generating fine, dense foam. The numbers on the top electronic display of the washing machine count down gradually starting from 1:34, while the wooden shelf in the background still holds neatly arranged beige towels and laundry care products.
Shot 3:
  - Duration: 9.5sec - 14.5sec
  - Scene Type: Product effectiveness demonstration
  - Scene: The yellow cleaning liquid inside the washing machine drum is drained away, leaving clear, translucent rinse water in the drum. A small amount of fine foam floats on the water surface, resting still at the bottom of the metal drum. The smooth, spotless stainless steel drum wall is clearly visible through the transparent door, and the number on the top electronic display of the washing machine stops at 1:34, with the shelf furnishings in the background remaining unchanged.
Shot 4:
  - Duration: 14.5sec - 19.5sec
  - Scene Type: Product effectiveness demonstration
  - Scene: The washing machine stops running completely, and the washing machine door opens automatically. The camera performs a slow orbiting push-in close-up on the empty stainless steel inner drum, fully showcasing the details of the clean, shiny metal drum wall with zero residual stains. The adjustment knobs and control panel on top of the washing machine are visible in the background.

  - Duration: 19.5sec - 25.5sec
  - Scene Type: Display of multiple product variants
  - Scene: The frame cuts to the white laundry countertop, where two bottles of Dettol washing machine cleaner are placed side by side: one is the pine scent variant with green packaging, the other is the lemon scent variant with yellow packaging. The camera slowly pushes forward from a slightly distant position, gradually zooming in to focus on the packaging details of the two bottles, clearly displaying product text printed on the bottles including '6 in 1 Kills 99.99% Bacteria'. Blurred window light and distant domestic furnishings are visible in the background.

The lyrics center around longing, waiting, and heartbreak, carrying a delicate overall mood that perfectly matches the vibe of a home goods sharing session.

The frame cuts directly from the cleaning liquid pouring shot to the washing machine running shot, and subsequent shots of the rinse water, empty drum, and product display all use seamless hard cuts, keeping the overall visual style consistent and cohesive.

The background features the back kitchen wall with hanging tableware, stacks of clean plates, and diners waiting for their meals outside the window. The operation area is filled with swirling steam, and the lighting is bright and warm yellow.
[Tone & Pacing]: A down-to-earth practical sharing style with a brisk, tight pace. The entire video follows the workflow of using the rice serving tool, with sharp, decisive movements that have no unnecessary delays, accurately conveying the core advantage of efficient meal preparation.
[Camera]: Entirely shot from a first-person handheld perspective with slight, natural camera shake. The shot slowly pushes in from a full view of the operation area to a close-up of the tool details, paired with smooth, eye-level follow-cam that tracks the rice serving movements.
[Lighting]: Multiple long strip ceiling lamps in the shop evenly illuminate the entire meal preparation area. Warm white light clearly highlights the plump, distinct texture of every grain of rice, and the steam rising from the hot rice forms a soft halo under the lights. The overall lighting is bright, clean, and free of obvious harsh shadows.
[Character]: A 25-35 year old Southeast Asian man with a healthy wheat-colored complexion, sharp facial lines and clear eyes, no makeup, a sturdy, robust build, wearing a navy blue short-sleeved work uniform. title: DOUBLE C Plain Bedsheet Only — Lifestyle Scene (Malaysia · Textiles & Soft Furnishings)
creator: @syamistudio
hook_line: Place the navy pillow on the bed and smooth the navy fitted sheet
prompt_en:
[Style]: Realistic home goods showcase aesthetic with crisp, clean image quality, natural soft lighting and shadow, accurately reproducing the true colors and fine texture of the bedding, balancing a lived-in feel with the polished refinement of a product display
[Environment]: A modern minimalist bedroom with excellent natural lighting, featuring light wood flooring paired with a low-saturation light gray upholstered headboard accent wall, and a light-toned abstract decorative painting hung on the wall. Symmetrically placed on either side of the bed are matching light wood nightstands holding minimalist white decorative items. On the other side of the bedroom stands a sleek white floor lamp, and semi-transparent white sheer curtains hang by the window, making the entire space neat and warm
[Tone & Pacing]: The overall rhythm is brisk and smooth. The opening uses close-up operation shots to intuitively show the bedding tidying effect, then cuts to the bed-making process to display product details, with sharp shot transitions that fully fit the fast-paced product recommendation rhythm of short videos
[Camera]: Starts with a close-up shot of the person performing the operation, then pulls back to a full panoramic view of the bedding. The camera follows the bed-making movements to capture the tidying details at the corners, paired with precise partial close-up shots that clearly show the fabric and edge stitching details of the bedding
[Lighting]: Uses even, soft indoor diffused natural light, supplemented by hidden fill light sources in the bedroom. There are no harsh hard shadows across the frame; the light fills the entire bedroom space, making the navy blue bedding rich in color and clear in layers, creating a comfortable, soothing visual experience
[Character]: A 25-30 year old Caucasian woman with smooth, firm skin, distinct and relaxed facial features, a neat low bun, subtle no-makeup makeup, a well-proportioned figure, wearing a simple light gray short-sleeve T-shirt. She has a gentle, capable temperament, performs movements skillfully and neatly, looks focused and calm, and appears relaxed and natural

[Shots]
Shot 1:
  - Duration: 0.0sec - 1.5sec
  - Scene Type: Product usage scenario
  - Scene: A close-up shot shows the character's hands placing a navy blue pillow in the correct position on the bed, then the palm glides smoothly over the surface of the navy blue fitted sheet, carefully smoothing out tiny wrinkles on the fabric. The abstract decorative painting above the headboard is visible in the background. The camera initially focuses on the interaction area between the hands and the pillow, then moves slowly and steadily horizontally following the hand smoothing the fabric, keeping the frame consistently focused on the smooth state of the bedding. Only the character's arms and part of their torso are visible as they focus on tidying the bedding
Shot 2:
  - Duration: 1.5sec - 2.5sec
  - Scene Type: Lifestyle showcase scene
  - Scene: The camera cuts to a full panoramic view of the bedroom, fully displaying the entire large bed made up with the solid-color navy blue cotton fitted sheet, with two matching navy blue pillows symmetrically placed on either side of the bed. The surrounding nightstands, floor lamp and decorative painting are all included in the frame. The bedding has neat, smooth lines for a clean, comfortable visual effect. Shot with a fixed-position panoramic camera that remains completely still, capturing the full bed and the surrounding bedroom environment with no person visible in the frame
Shot 3:
  - Duration: 2.5sec - 4.0sec
  - Scene Type: Ease of use demonstration
  - Scene: The scene cuts to the bare white quilted mattress with no bedding on it. The character's hands grasp two opposite corners of the navy blue fitted sheet, gently shake the entire sheet open, and spread it evenly over the surface of the white mattress. The sheer curtains by the window and a small round table with floral decor are visible in the background. The camera stays at a medium shot position, moving synchronously with the character's lifting and spreading movements to clearly capture the full process of the fitted sheet going from folded to fully laid out. Only the character's arms are visible, with movements that are relaxed and natural
Shot 4:
  - Duration: 4.0sec - 7.5sec
  - Scene Type: Product design highlight showcase
  - Scene: The character stands bent over at the side of the mattress, using both hands to grab the corners of the fitted sheet, then tucks the elasticated side skirt of the sheet down over each edge of the mattress one by one, carefully arranging the fabric at every bed corner so the fitted sheet wraps tightly around all sides of the mattress, fully demonstrating the full-perimeter all-around wrapping design feature of the fitted sheet. The camera follows the character's moving footsteps, sequentially switching to capture the tidying process at different corners of the mattress to fully present the details of the wrapping operation. The character's full upper body and the partial lower half of their bare feet standing on the wood floor are visible as they focus on securing the fitted sheet
Shot 5:
  - Duration: 7.5sec - 8.5sec
  - Scene Type: Product usage scenario
  - Scene: The scene returns to the opening perspective of the video. The character's hands place the navy blue pillow back at the head of the bed, gently adjusting the pillow's placement angle to complete the full bedding tidying and showcase. The camera locks the frame at a medium close-up position, clearly presenting the final finished look of the pillow paired with the fitted sheet, with only the character's arms visible as they perform the pillow arranging operation
[Background Sound]:
- Upbeat TikTok background music driven by electronic drum beats with a strong, loud rhythm, featuring a looping synthesizer melody in a Trap/Hip-Hop fusion style, perfectly suited for fast-paced product marketing or showcase short videos to effectively boost viewer attention and purchasing impulse
[Transition / Editing]:
- Uses smooth sequential scene editing that naturally transitions from the finished tidying shot of the previous segment to the starting scene of the bare mattress without bedding, paired with auxiliary text labels at the bottom of the frame to clearly demonstrate the bedding installation process. The entire edit maintains a consistent, smooth rhythm to highlight the product's usage advantages

[Environment]: Ordinary residential indoor setting, covering damaged plain white walls in various conditions, finally settling on a clean pale white background display area, with sufficient light and a tidy, uncluttered space throughout
[Tone & Pacing]: Tight, brisk pacing, each repair demonstration step takes very little time to intuitively and efficiently show the product's ease of use, transitioning sequentially from different damaged wall problems to the final product showcase with clear, smooth logic, maintaining an enthusiastic vibe of daily household good sharing the entire time
[Camera]: Fixed close-up shooting throughout the whole process, accurately aimed at every damaged wall section, clearly recording the interactive operations between the hand, the wall repair paste and the tools, no unnecessary camera movement, fully focused on the product usage process
[Lighting]: Even, bright indoor soft light with no harsh shadows, ensuring wall details and the white paste texture of the repair paste are clearly visible. Natural light and shadow effects are added in the sunlit wall scenes to emphasize the selling point of fast drying speed
[Character]: 22-28 year old Southeast Asian woman with natural, healthy wheat-toned glowing smooth skin, soft relaxed facial features and a friendly smile, full lip shape, fresh everyday no-makeup makeup look, petite well-proportioned figure, wearing a light gray casual collared shirt paired with a matching draping headscarf, warm and approachable temperament, holding the product with relaxed, natural movements, keeping a bright sweet smile the entire time

[Shots]
Shot 1:
  - Duration: 0.0sec - 3.5sec
  - Scene Type: Highlight the pain point problem

A hand picks up the blue and white packaged wall repair paste, squeezes out the white paste to fill the damaged area around the hole, then uses a white scraper to spread and smooth the paste evenly. Finally, the wall connects seamlessly with the socket edge, and the damaged hole is completely covered and repaired. Corresponding demonstration-related text is kept on the frame, with orange subtitles popping up synchronously at the bottom of the screen.
  - Subject: Nak tutup lubang-lubang kat dinding tak payah panggil tukang tak payah cek.
Shot 2:
  - Duration: 3.5sec - 6.5sec
  - Scene Type: Show ease of use
  - Scene: The camera cuts to another white wall with a thin long vertical crack, the wall texture is clearly visible. A hand holds the wall repair paste, squeezes the white paste fully along the crack to fill it completely, then uses a small putty knife to repeatedly scrape and smooth the paste surface. title: Simplee Chanca Piedra Capsule Supplements – FDA Approved — Talking Head (Philippines · Health)

[Environment]: Scenes are shot sequentially in a bright bathroom, a deep red tubular passage simulating human blood vessels, a dim industrial-style dialysis room, a hospital ward scattered with lab test sheets, a warm-lit interior of the human body, and a fresh sun-dappled forest meadow, with the lighting style of each scene shifting to match the progression of the story.
[Tone & Pacing]: The opening unfolds with a serious, anxious warning tone, at a tight, fast pace to deliver health alerts related to kidney disease. The mid-section shifts to a tense, slightly desperate mood, before transitioning in the later part to a relaxed, pleasant sharing rhythm, creating an overall well-balanced dynamic of tension and relief.
[Camera]: The entire video uses a straight-on eye-level shooting perspective focused on the anthropomorphic characters. It makes extensive use of close-ups on the characters' faces to highlight their exaggerated expressions and physical movements, alongside close-ups of key items to emphasize fine details. The camera moves gently to follow the characters' actions, enhancing the sense of personified interaction.
[Lighting]: The opening bathroom scene uses bright, even cool white light. The blood vessel scene uses dark red backlighting to outline character silhouettes. The dialysis room is lit by dim industrial ceiling lamps paired with glowing device indicator lights. The hospital ward uses the soft cool white lighting standard for medical facilities. The forest scene uses warm natural side backlighting to create a healing, comforting atmosphere.
[Character]: No real human actors appear on screen. All characters are 3D anthropomorphic cartoon figures: the urine can has a translucent blue smooth texture, the kidney has the texture of a plump, healthy reddish organ, the salt shaker has a clear glass texture, and the capsule has a smooth, glossy green texture. All characters are designed with large round eyes and exaggerated eyebrows, with distinct emotional layers and natural, flexible movements.

[Style]: 夸张拟人动画广告风，视觉冲击力强，色彩鲜亮明快，卡通角色表情生动富有戏剧感，适配短视频平台吸睛种草调性。
[Environment]: 开篇是充满工业冷感的昏暗场景，管道环绕、浓雾弥漫；随后逐步过渡到清新明亮的浅色调空间，散落着薄荷叶、晶莹冰块，背景点缀朦胧绿植与闪耀星光，整体氛围从压抑说教转向清爽治愈。
[Tone & Pacing]: 前半段语气尖锐直白，带着强烈的警示感，后半段画风一转，语调瞬间变得轻松俏皮、充满亲和力，整体节奏紧凑明快，镜头切换利落，从冲突感拉满的吐槽快速切换到软萌好物安利，毫无拖沓。
[Camera]: 全程采用产品居中的拟人化特写镜头，镜头始终锁定卡通化的产品主体，轻微的镜头推近动作强化角色的表情与动作细节，保证每一个画面的视觉焦点都牢牢落在拟人化产品身上。
[Lighting]: 开篇采用冷调暗光，烟雾笼罩下光线偏阴沉，营造压抑的警示氛围；后半段切换为柔和明亮的漫射光，整体光线清透明亮，在冰块与薄荷叶上形成细碎高光，烘托清爽舒适的产品使用感。
[Character]: 全程出镜的均为拟人化卡通产品角色，无真人出镜。

[Shots]
Shot 1:
  - 时长: 0.0sec - 5.5sec
  - 镜头类型: 点明痛点问题
  - 画面: 开篇画面模糊虚化，随后画面清晰定格在黑色碳纤维纹理的卡通电子烟角色身上，角色脸上带着愤怒的夸张神情，手指直指向镜头，身体周围环绕着大量浓密的灰白色烟雾，背景是布满旧管道的昏暗工业空间，角色身体屏幕上显示着30.0W的参数画面。
  - 口播: Kupal!  Hindi ka pa ba nagsasawa sa kakahipa?
Shot 2:
  - 时长: 5.5sec - 10.5sec
  - 镜头类型: 点明痛点问题
  - 画面: 镜头切换到另一款棕色调碳纤维纹理的卡通电子烟角色，角色双臂交叉抱在胸前，满脸不耐烦的嫌弃神情，周身萦绕着线条更为轻盈的灰白色烟雾，背景还是朦胧的工业暗调空间。
  - 口播: Nawawa na ang baga mo niyan, Gar!  Araw-araw na lang. Yan ang una mong hinahanap kapag umos na juice mo. Parang hindi
Shot 3:
  - 时长: 10.5sec - 19.5sec
  - 镜头类型: 设置使用场景
  - 画面: 画面瞬间切换为清新的亮绿色浅背景，浅蓝色的卡通鼻吸棒角色站在画面中心，它笑着抬起一只手挥手打招呼，身体周围环绕着蓝色烟雾、飞舞的薄荷叶与散落的透明冰块，周身还旋转着亮绿色的光环特效，时不时对镜头比出友好的手势。
  - 口播: hindi ka na mapakalik kapag wala na, di ba?  Teka muna, ako naman ang Subukan mong hipakin, Ann Lipa. Ako si Pocket Refreshing Aroman. isang hipak lang ng refreshing mint aroma ko, fresh na agonapagawa.
Shot 4:
  - 时长: 19.5sec - 25.5sec
  - 镜头类型: 产品多功能性
  - 画面: 画面中一字排开站着六只不同颜色的卡通鼻吸棒角色，分别是紫色、浅蓝、粉色、黑色、白色、黄色，每只角色都露出灿烂的笑容，各自从顶部呼出对应淡彩色的烟雾，身边飞舞着薄荷叶与细碎星光，脚下是柔软的白色云状平面。
  - 口播: Pag-agad ang pakiramdam mo. Araw-araw, lait lang ako. Kaya kasha sa bulsa at pag-aaraw. Pwede mong dalhin kahit saan  At hindi lang isang magpipilihan mo
Shot 5:
  - 时长: 25.5sec - 31.5sec
  - 镜头类型: 展示多款式选择（时尚品类）
  - 画面: 浅蓝色的卡通鼻吸棒角色站在队伍最前方C位，身后跟着其余五只不同颜色的鼻吸棒角色，它一边对着镜头做手势，一边眨眼互动，画面右下角摆放着一只明黄色的编织小篮子，薄荷叶与冰块从画面上方缓缓飘落。
  - 口播: Marami akong flavors para hindi ka magsawak.  Kaya kung gusto mo na magsawak, press kong pakiramdam sa alaw-alaw.  Check out po na ako. Nasa Yellow basketball.
[Background Sound]:
- 非常欢快、节奏感强的TikTok风格背景音乐，带有轻快的电子节拍和俏皮的合成器旋律，音量适中偏高，节奏约120-130BPM，风格类似Pop-Punk融合商业广告小曲，拥有洗脑重复的旋律节奏，整体氛围活泼俏皮充满小确幸感，和产品便携、清新、日常使用的特性高度契合。
[Transition / Editing]:
- 采用强反差快速转场，前半段暗黑电子烟场景直接硬切到明亮清新的鼻吸棒画面，瞬间打破压抑氛围；后续画面切换均使用顺滑的淡入过渡，配合角色动作同步切换字幕信息，视觉节奏流畅动感。

title: 1 bundle Regular chicharon — Handheld Demo (Philippines · Home Supplies)
creator: @mommynengs
hook_line: Wow! This is exactly what you've been waiting for!
prompt_en:
[Style]: Realistic e-commerce product showcase style, matching the authentic, native feel of local TikTok product recommendation content. The footage is bright and clean, with product details presented clearly and intuitively.
[Environment]: Simple indoor home setting with clean off-white walls. Half a light grey louvered window is visible on the left side, and round warm downlights are embedded in the ceiling. The space has bright, uncluttered lighting with no extra messy furnishings in the background, creating an overall fresh and comfortable vibe.
[Tone & Pacing]: Lively rhythm with strong product recommendation appeal. The opening grabs attention with a striking full view of the bundled products, then moves gradually to detailed displays, and finally lands on the high cost-performance selling point. The overall pace is fast, smooth, and aligned with the viewing habits of short video users.
[Camera]: The shot transitions gradually from a full wide shot of the bundled products to a close-up of a single bag, then pushes in to a macro shot of the fried pork rinds, and finally pulls back to the original natural viewing angle. The camera movement is steady and smooth, keeping full focus on the product throughout.
[Lighting]: Even, soft overhead diffused indoor lighting paired with supplementary fill light, with no harsh, sharp shadows. It fully highlights the crispy, fluffy golden texture of the fried pork rinds, resulting in a bright, clear overall image with natural, true-to-life color reproduction.
[Character]: Filipino woman aged 20 to 30, with only her arms and part of her palms visible. She has a healthy wheat-toned skin tone, smooth, flawless hand skin, and a well-proportioned, firm arm line. Her movements are neat and friendly, full of the enthusiasm of sharing a great product, and her full face never appears in the frame.

[Shots]
Shot 1:
  - Duration: 0.0sec - 2.5sec
  - Scene Type: Product close-up shot
  - Scene: The person's two hands hold the top and bottom ends of a full bundle of ten NANDO'S brand pork rind snack bags respectively, holding the entire bundle of snacks horizontally in front of the camera. They steadily display the complete appearance of the ten snacks arranged in two large tied rows, against a bright off-white simple indoor background. The camera stays in a fixed wide shot position, fully capturing the entire view of the snack bundle.
  - Subject: Wow! Ito na talaga ang hinintay nyo!
Shot 2:
  - Duration: 2.5sec - 5.0sec
  - Scene Type: Handheld product showcase
  - Scene: The person shifts to holding a single bag of pork rind snack with both hands, lifting the bag in front of the camera and gently rotating it to clearly show the details of the red brand label printed on the bag surface. Through the transparent packaging, the outline of the stacked golden pork rinds inside is visible. The camera moves naturally from the wide shot to a medium close-up of the single snack bag, with the focus locked firmly on the product packaging.
  - Subject: at pinapangarap niyong chicharon. Sampung balo
Shot 3:
  - Duration: 5.0sec - 8.0sec
  - Scene Type: Product texture showcase
  - Scene: The camera moves very close to the transparent packaging, using a macro perspective to clearly show the real texture of the pork rinds inside the bag. The golden, crispy surface of the pork rinds is covered with a fluffy pore structure, and the curled shape of every piece is clearly visible, directly highlighting the fluffy, crispy characteristic of the snack. The camera uses a macro close-up position, making slight focus adjustments to fully present the texture details of the fried pork rinds.
  - Subject: na isang bandil
Shot 4:
  - Duration: 8.0sec - 10.5sec
  - Scene Type: Promotional selling point highlight
  - Scene: The person holds the full bundle of ten snack bags in one hand, and extends the index finger of the other hand to point at several bags on the side. Eye-catching yellow promotional text appears at the bottom of the frame, and the camera pulls back to the wide shot position, restoring the natural viewing angle that users experience when scrolling through short videos daily.
  - Subject: Check out na! Samunamas nilang ma!
[Background Sound]:
- Upbeat, highly rhythmic TikTok-style background music with distinct electronic beats and drum hits, moderately high volume, and a bright, uplifting melody that creates a surprise and promotional atmosphere. This is a widely used BGM for Southeast Asian popular e-commerce product marketing, perfectly suited for snack and food recommendation short videos, and it amplifies viewers' impulse to place orders.
[Transition / Editing]:
- Smooth progressive transition logic: the shot switches seamlessly from the full wide shot of the whole bundle of products to a close-up of a single bag, then flows naturally into the macro detail shot, and finally returns to the original interface view. There are no abrupt cuts throughout the sequence, and the transitions match the rhythm of the upbeat background music to enhance the smooth, engaging product recommendation viewing experience.
prompt_zh:
[Style]: 写实电商展示风格，贴合TikTok本地好物种草原生质感，画面明亮干净，商品细节展现清晰直观。
[Environment]: 室内简约居家环境，墙面为干净的浅白色，左侧可见半扇浅灰色百叶窗，天花板内嵌圆形暖光筒灯，光线通透整洁，背景无多余杂乱陈设，整体清爽舒适。
[Tone & Pacing]: 种草感极强的活泼节奏，开场用震撼的组合商品视觉抓住注意力，随后逐步推进细节展示，最后落脚到高性价比卖点，整体节奏明快流畅，符合短视频用户观看习惯。
[Camera]: 从全景展示组合商品逐渐过渡到单袋特写，随后推近至炸猪皮的微距细节，最后拉远还原原生视角，镜头运动平稳顺滑，全程聚焦商品主体。
[Lighting]: 采用室内均匀柔和的顶置漫射光搭配辅助补光，无明显生硬阴影，充分凸显炸猪皮酥脆蓬松的金黄质感，整体画面明亮通透，色彩还原真实自然。
[Character]: 菲律宾裔20-30岁女性，仅露出手臂和部分手掌，小麦色健康肤质，手部皮肤细腻无瑕疵，手臂线条匀称紧致，动作利落亲和，充满分享好物的热情感，无完整面部出镜。

[Shots]
Shot 1:
  - 时长: 0.0sec - 2.5sec
  - 镜头类型: 产品镜头特写
  - 画面: 人物的两只手分别握住一整束共十袋NANDO'S品牌猪皮脆零食的上下两端，将整束零食水平举在镜头前方，稳稳展示十袋零食捆绑成两大排的完整组合外观，背景是明亮的浅白色简约室内空间，镜头保持固定全景机位，完整收纳整束零食的全貌。
  - 口播: Wow! Ito na talaga ang hinintay nyo!
Shot 2:
  - 时长: 2.5sec - 5.0sec
  - 镜头类型: 手持商品展示
  - 画面: 人物双手转而握持单独一袋猪皮脆零食，将袋子举到镜头前方，轻轻转动袋身，清晰展示印在袋面的红色品牌标签细节，隔着透明包装袋可以看到内部堆叠的金黄色猪皮脆轮廓，镜头从全景自然推近至单袋零食的中近景，焦点牢牢锁定商品包装。
  - 口播: at pinapangarap niyong chicharon. Sampung balo
Shot 3:
  - 时长: 5.0sec - 8.0sec
  - 镜头类型: 产品材质展示
  - 画面: 镜头彻底贴近透明包装袋，以微距视角清晰展示袋内猪皮脆的真实质感，金黄酥脆的猪皮表面布满蓬松的气孔结构，每一块卷曲的形态都清晰可见，直观凸显出零食蓬松酥脆的特性，镜头采用微距特写机位，轻微调整对焦，完整呈现炸猪皮的纹理细节。
  - 口播: na isang bandil
Shot 4:
  - 时长: 8.0sec - 10.5sec
  - 镜头类型: 促销卖点强推
  - 画面: 人物的一只手举着整束十袋零食，另一只手伸出食指指向侧边的几袋零食，画面底部显示醒目的黄色宣传字幕，镜头拉远回全景机位，还原用户日常刷短视频的原生观看视角。
  - 口播: Check out na! Samunamas nilang ma!
[Background Sound]:
- 非常欢快、节奏感强的TikTok风格背景音乐，带有明显电子节拍和鼓点，音量适中偏高，旋律轻快上扬，营造惊喜+促销氛围，属于东南亚流行电商带货常用BGM，适配零食美食类种草短视频，能增强观众下单冲动感。
[Transition / Editing]:
- 采用流畅的递进式转场逻辑：从整束商品全景平滑切换到单袋特写，再无缝推进到微距细节画面，最后自然还原到原生界面，全程无生硬跳转，配合轻快背景音乐节奏，强化商品种草的流畅观感。

title: Electric Kettle Heater — Handheld Demo (Philippines · Household Appliances)
creator: @rizenwander
hook_line: Boils fast, durable and easy to use
prompt_en:
[Style]: Exquisite realistic home style, with fine picture texture, the premium matte black finish of the home appliance product is presented naturally and authentically, and warm-toned light and shadow set off a cozy home atmosphere.
[Environment]: A modern minimalist kitchen with soft lighting, featuring an off-white countertop paired with light wood cabinets. A sink, metal faucet and wooden cutting board are visible in the background, with a stove and fresh green plants faintly showing in the distance. The space is clean, tidy and full of everyday life vibes.
[Tone & Pacing]: Authentic home product recommendation style, with a relaxing and comforting atmosphere, steady and smooth rhythm. Through coherent product operation demonstrations, the core practical and convenient features of the electric kettle are conveyed naturally.
[Camera]: Centered on product display, using a fixed close-up shot that orbits the product, paired with close-up follow shots of hand operations. The camera movement is stable and smooth, focusing entirely on the details and usage process of the electric kettle without unnecessary shaking.
[Lighting]: Soft and even indoor side-top lighting, with delicate, non-harsh light that clearly outlines the premium matte black silhouette of the electric kettle, while casting natural, soft faint shadows on the countertop to create a warm and cozy home atmosphere.
[Character]: Only the hands of a 20-30 year old Asian man are visible, with clean, smooth, even-toned skin. His movements are gentle and fluid, with natural, relaxed posture when operating the electric kettle. The actions of opening the lid, filling water, placing the kettle body and holding the handle are completed in one seamless flow, looking overall simple and neat to convey the comfort of home life.

[Shots]
Shot 1:
  - Duration: 0.0sec - 1.5sec
  - Scene Type: Demonstrate ease of use
  - Scene: On the off-white countertop of a softly lit modern minimalist kitchen, a black electric kettle is placed next to the sink. One hand grips the kettle handle, while the other lifts the lid upwards, and tap water slowly pours into the kettle from the faucet. The camera gradually moves forward, focusing on the details of the water filling inside the kettle.
  - Subject: Mabilis magpakulo, matibay at madaling gamitin.
Shot 2:
  - Duration: 1.5sec - 3.5sec
  - Scene Type: Demonstrate ease of use
  - Scene: The camera cuts to beside the electric kettle base. A hand places the water-filled kettle body back onto the base, then closes the lid downwards and presses the power switch, the red indicator light at the bottom of the kettle lights up immediately. The camera moves steadily, fully following the entire process of the kettle body from being picked up to being placed back on the base.
  - Subject: Mabilis magpakulo, matibay at madaling gamitin. 10.
Shot 3:
  - Duration: 3.5sec - 7.0sec
  - Scene Type: Product design highlights
  - Scene: The black electric kettle is placed on a white circular rotating display stand, which rotates at a constant slow speed to present the kettle's matte black exterior, front brand logo, metal spout and comfortable non-slip handle in a full 360-degree view, clearly showing the overall shape and detailed texture of the product. The camera stays at a fixed position, completing the full panoramic product display via the rotation of the stand.
  - Subject: Stainless steel na may premium finish at komportabling hawakan.
Shot 4:
  - Duration: 7.0sec - 10.0sec
  - Scene Type: Product usage scenario
  - Scene: The camera switches to another kitchen countertop. A hand grips the electric kettle's handle to lift the kettle body, then steadily places it back on the base, and a finger gently presses the switch on the kettle body to complete the operation, demonstrating the kettle's convenient pick-and-place design. Using a close-up fixed camera position, the shot focuses entirely on the interactive movements between the hand and the kettle.
  - Subject: Perfect para sa araw-araw mong pangangailangan sa kusina. Thank you.
[Background Sound]:
- No background music, the video features only a voiceover introducing the product, with a steady speaking pace and clear tone, focused on highlighting product features, suitable for static display of kitchenware or e-commerce product detail page voiceover scenarios.
[Transition / Editing]:
- Using smooth scene jump editing, each shot connects naturally and seamlessly, paired with a 360-degree rotating product display effect shot to emphasize the appearance texture and detail selling points of the electric kettle. The overall rhythm matches a soothing tempo.
prompt_zh:
[Style]: 精致写实家居风，画面质感细腻，家电产品哑光黑的高级质感呈现自然真实，暖调光影烘托出温馨居家氛围。
[Environment]: 光线柔和的现代简约厨房，浅白色台面搭配浅木色橱柜，背景可见水槽、金属水龙头、木质砧板，远处隐约露出灶台与清新绿植，空间干净整洁充满生活气息。
[Tone & Pacing]: 地道的家居好物种草风格，氛围轻松治愈，节奏平稳流畅，通过连贯的产品操作演示，自然传递电热水壶实用便捷的核心特点。
[Camera]: 以产品展示为核心，采用固定特写镜头环绕产品旋转，搭配手部操作的近景跟拍，镜头移动平稳顺滑，全程聚焦电热水壶的细节与使用过程，无多余晃动。
[Lighting]: 采用柔和均匀的室内侧顶光，光线细腻不生硬，既清晰勾勒出电热水壶哑光黑的高级轮廓，又在台面上形成自然柔和的浅淡阴影，营造出温暖舒适的居家氛围感。
[Character]: 仅露出20-30岁亚洲男性的手部，手部皮肤干净细腻、肤色均匀，动作轻柔流畅，操作电热水壶时姿势自然舒展，开合壶盖、接水、放置机身、握持壶身的动作一气呵成，整体简约利落，传递出居家生活的舒适感。

[Shots]
Shot 1:
  - 时长: 0.0sec - 1.5sec
  - 镜头类型: 展示易用性
  - 画面: 光线柔和的现代简约厨房浅白色台面上，黑色电热水壶放置在水槽旁，一只手握住壶把，另一只手向上掀开壶盖，自来水从龙头中缓缓注入壶内，镜头逐步向前推进，聚焦壶内注水的细节。
  - 口播: Mabilis magpakulo, matibay at madaling gamitin.
Shot 2:
  - 时长: 1.5sec - 3.5sec
  - 镜头类型: 展示易用性
  - 画面: 镜头切到电热水壶底座旁，手将接完水的壶身放回底座，随后向下合上壶盖，按下开关，壶身底部的红色指示灯随即亮起，镜头平稳移动，完整跟拍壶身从拿起至放回底座的全过程。
  - 口播: Mabilis magpakulo, matibay at madaling gamitin. 10.
Shot 3:
  - 时长: 3.5sec - 7.0sec
  - 镜头类型: 产品设计亮点
  - 画面: 黑色电热水壶被放置在白色圆形旋转展示台上，展示台匀速缓慢转动，360度全方位呈现壶身的哑光黑外观、正面的品牌标识、金属壶嘴以及舒适的防滑把手，清晰展现产品的整体造型与细节质感，镜头保持固定机位，依托展示台的旋转完成产品全景展示。
  - 口播: Stainless steel na may premium finish at komportabling hawakan.
Shot 4:

title: Betterland Kids Girls Pants Girls Cargo Pants Loose Fashion Ko — OOTD Showcase (Philippines · Kids' Fashion)
creator: @ambee.aur
hook_line: A little girl in light blue cargo pants shows in a pink and blue children's clothing store
prompt_en:
[Style]: Realistic street-style photography for trendy kids, with bright, vivid colors that clearly and naturally display the garment cuts, delivering an overall energetic visual texture ideal for children's clothing sales content.
[Environment]: A bright, airy children's clothing retail store, featuring signature pink and blue contrasting arched walls. Multi-tier shelves neatly display work pants in various colorways, a wide range of children's shoes, and delicate kids' crossbody bags. Mannequins dressed in children's clothing are placed around the space, with a glossy, reflective floor, creating a clean, child-friendly, trend-forward atmosphere.
[Tone & Pacing]: Energetic Douyin-style children's clothing sales vibe, with a smooth, brisk pace. Camera cuts align perfectly with the music's drum beats, using the model's continuous runway walks and turns to fully showcase the cuts and design details of children's cargo pants in different colorways from all angles.
[Camera]: The shot opens with a fixed full-body framing, then switches to a medium shot to show the upper-body outfit effect, followed by close-up shots that focus on details like the pants' pockets and drawstrings. The camera moves steadily to follow the character's walking and turning motions without any harsh shaking, ensuring every design detail is clearly visible.
[Lighting]: Full-coverage soft light ceiling lamps mounted across the top of the store, casting even, gentle light over the entire shooting space. This eliminates harsh shadows under the character, accurately restores the original colors of the cargo pants in different colorways, and highlights the fine texture of the twill fabric.
[Character]: East Asian young girl, 6-8 years old, with fair, delicate skin that has the natural pinkish glow unique to children, a small rounded face, bright expressive eyes, a neat slender nose, and sleek, long straight black hair. She wears almost no makeup to keep her natural, fresh look, has a slender, well-proportioned figure, and dresses in a trendy streetwear style. She is energetic, lively, confident, and generous, with smooth, fluid movements, and keeps a soft, sweet smile while looking directly at the camera throughout.

[Shots]
Shot 1:
  - Duration: 0.0sec - 6.5sec
  - Scene Type: OOTD Outfit Showcase
  - Scene: The little girl stands inside the store surrounded by shelves of pink and blue children's clothing, wearing light blue wide-leg cargo pants with both hands tucked into the pant pockets. She walks slowly at first, then turns smoothly to show the front, side, and back cuts of the pants. The camera slowly pans upward from a low full-body framing, fully presenting the loose, draping silhouette of the light blue cargo pants. Product introduction text is overlaid at the top of the frame: 'Streetwear Cargo Pants For Kids ·2-14years old sizes | twill fabric·'.
Shot 2:
  - Duration: 6.5sec - 10.5sec
  - Scene Type: OOTD Outfit Showcase
  - Scene: The camera cuts to the pink-toned children's clothing display area on the other side of the store. The little girl changes into pink cargo pants of the exact same cut, and wears a light pink baseball cap on her head. She keeps her hands in her pockets, turns around to show the full view of the pants, then turns back and naturally lifts a small silver kids' crossbody bag, swaying gently to the rhythm of the music. The same product introduction text remains at the top of the frame.
Shot 3:
  - Duration: 10.5sec - 13.5sec
  - Scene Type: Product Material Showcase
  - Scene: The camera switches to a close-up shot, focusing closely on the waist drawstrings, curved patch pockets, and large side cargo pockets with bow laces of the pink cargo pants. The little girl puts one hand inside a pocket to naturally demonstrate the pocket's depth and practicality. Various children's clothing items on the shelves are still visible in the background, and the product introduction text at the top of the frame remains displayed.
Shot 4:
  - Duration: 13.5sec - 15.0sec
  - Scene Type: Multi-Style Selection Showcase (Fashion Category)
  - Scene: The frame shows the display stand in the center of the store, with a pair of pink cargo pants hung at the center of the stand. Various children's shoes are neatly arranged on the multi-tier shelves of the stand, and the shelves on both sides are filled with children's cargo pants in different colorways, paired with various kids' crossbody bags as display decorations, fully presenting the coordinated display atmosphere of the complete children's outfit set. The product introduction text remains overlaid at the top of the frame.
Shot 5:
  - Duration: 15.0sec - 20.5sec
  - Scene Type: OOTD Outfit Showcase
  - Scene: The scene shifts to the area by the white blinds inside the store. The little girl changes into black wide-leg cargo pants, still paired with a white sleeveless top and the light pink cap. She leans against the wall sideways while holding the small silver crossbody bag, then the camera cuts to a close-up shot showing the metal ring tassel charm detail on the side pocket of the black cargo pants. Finally, the camera pulls back to the full-body framing: the little girl stands in the children's clothing display area under the store's arched doorway, with one hand in her pocket, looking at the camera with a sweet smile, fully showcasing the streetwear trend vibe of the black pants. The product introduction text stays at the top of the frame throughout the shot.
[Background Sound]:
- Upbeat, cheerful TikTok-style background music with a fast tempo, strong drum beats, and electronic synthesizer tones, at a moderately high volume, blending Filipino Pinoy Pop with Trap/Hip-Hop elements. The lyrics are sung in Tagalog, full of a confident, cool street vibe, and is a popular Viral Dance BGM on the Philippine TikTok platform, perfectly matching the dynamic rhythm for trendy children's clothing showcases.
[Transition / Editing]:
- Seamless transitions aligned to the music's drum beats, using fade-in effects at the points where the pants' colorways switch, to make the showcase of different colored pants flow smoothly and naturally. The overall editing pace is brisk and consistent, matching the visual logic of short-form children's clothing sales videos.
prompt_zh:
[Style]: 潮童街拍写实风，画面色彩鲜亮明快，服装版型展示清晰自然，整体呈现活力满满的儿童服饰带货视觉质感。
[Environment]: 明亮通透的儿童服装零售店，店内以粉蓝撞色的拱形墙面为标志性装饰，多层货架整齐陈列着不同配色的工装裤、各式童鞋与精致儿童挎包，摆放有身着童装的人体模型，地板光洁反光，空间整洁充满童趣潮流氛围。

[Lighting]: 采用门店顶部的全覆盖式柔光顶灯，光线均匀柔和地铺满整个拍摄空间，既消除了人物脚下的生硬阴影，又能真实还原不同配色工装裤的原本色彩，凸显斜纹面料的细腻质感。

title: Retro Cool Trendy 67 Print Half Price Family Dress — OOTD Showcase (Philippines · Kids' Fashion)
creator: @ambee.aur
hook_line: A little boy in a black cartoon print T-shirt stands in front of a light solid wall showing his outfit
prompt_en:
[Style]: Realistic trend-focused children's clothing showcase style, with clean and sharp image quality, moderate color saturation, highlighting the rich color layers and cartoon print details of the T-shirts, delivering a relaxed streetwear styling atmosphere overall.
[Environment]: Simple indoor shooting location with a plain light solid-color background, the wall is decorated with matching cartoon boy stickers, a small round table in the corner of the frame holds over-ear headphones and books as decorative props, the entire space has even and bright lighting with no extra clutter, keeping the focus on the displayed T-shirt products.
[Tone & Pacing]: Fast, crisp showcase rhythm, switching between different colored T-shirt display shots in time with the music beat, the camera flows smoothly between full-body model shots and close-up product detail shots, each T-shirt is shown for an appropriately controlled duration, the pace is bright and clear, with product features prominently highlighted.
[Camera]: Based on fixed-position medium-long full-body shots, interspersed with push-in shots that focus on print details and partial close-ups, camera movement is smooth and precise, always keeping focus on the T-shirt's cut design, print details and fabric texture, the footage is stable and clear with no unnecessary shaking.
[Lighting]: Uses even, soft indoor studio top light paired with bilateral fill softbox lighting, no harsh shadows, light evenly covers the model's entire body and the T-shirt surface, accurately restores the T-shirt's true colors and fine fabric texture, the overall lighting feels clean and bright.
[Character]: East Asian young boy, approximately 6-8 years old, with smooth, flawless skin, a cute face with soft facial contours, fluffy short black hair, delicate features, a small defined nose, no makeup, a slim and well-proportioned build, sequentially wearing casual short-sleeved T-shirts with cartoon boy prints in different colorways paired with basic solid-color bottoms, with a clean, lively, youthful vibe, relaxed and natural demeanor, hands naturally tucked into his pants pockets, slightly turning his body to different angles to adjust his stance, with a calm, gentle and slightly well-behaved expression.

prompt_en:
