[Environment]: Inside a cozy retro American family home, starting with a bright living room covered in a vintage carpet, furnished with a fabric sofa, retro table lamp, scattered pet toys and magazines; then switching to a warm-lit bedroom with linen bedding, soft morning light seeping in through the window, surrounded by scattered pet toys and wooden furniture, the whole space exudes a relaxed homey vibe.
[Tone & Pacing]: The overall rhythm is well-balanced, with the early part building emotion through the puppy's aggrieved, tearful complaints at a slow, slightly sad pace; the middle segment of the flea revelry and attack speeds up, full of playful comedic effect; the final product introduction and puppy resting segment returns to a slow, healing pace, conveying a reassuring and warm atmosphere.
[Camera]: Using the flexible cinematography of anthropomorphic animation, the opening medium shot shows the full body of the sitting puppy; then a close-up focuses on the puppy's tearful, aggrieved expression; next a macro shot of the fur delves into the dog's hair to show the flea revelry; afterward the camera gradually pulls back to fully display the whole process of sprinkling the powder, the fleas fleeing, and the puppy resting, with smooth and natural camera movement.
[Lighting]: Warm yellow soft lighting is used throughout the whole video. The lighting in the living room area is soft and even, creating a lazy home atmosphere; in the bedroom area, morning light pours in through the window, forming Tyndall effect light beams with floating dust drifting slowly in the light; in the dog fur macro scene, warm side light outlines the hair texture and the fleas' outlines, the overall lighting is warm and healing.

Initially it is covered in fleas with tearful eyes, later its fur is clean and fluffy with a relaxed, happy expression. 2. Cartoon Flea Group: Divided into two batches, one batch has bright yellow big eyes with arrogant expressions, the leading flea has glowing rose-red big eyes, panics and flees in a mess when attacked by powder, with a goofy, comical appearance. 3.   - Subject: I'm still a little bit BWAKA! Panibagong balat na naman to mga tol! Huya!
Shot 4:
  - Duration: 17.5sec - 23.5sec
  - Scene Type: Build suspense
  - Scene: The frame focuses on a flea leader with big glowing rose-red eyes, it stands at the high part of the dog's fur waving its front paws to shout, calling on the surrounding fleas to spread out to multiply and expand, the flea group behind it responds excitedly one after another, crowding and bustling to get ready to scatter in all directions.

Shot 5:

The puppy's originally listless expression gradually softens, then it sits up straight, its tail starts to wag gently, showing a happy and relaxed smile on its face.
  - Subject: Okay. na bahagat tayo mayutan na. Thank you.

The frame finally freezes on the clean dog fur surface, with not a single flea remaining.

The rhythm is light and bouncy, full of the playful, humorous authenticity of everyday life.

title: Stylish summer women's sandals with a thick sole for added hei — Handheld Demo (Philippines · Shoes)

prompt_en:

[Environment]: A home living room with soft lighting. [Tone & Pacing]: A light, pleasant product-sharing pace. The camera moves slowly following the foot movements to showcase the slippers' details from all angles, with a smooth, gentle rhythm that conveys the delightful feeling of discovering a great value item.
[Camera]: The entire video uses close-up shots focused on the feet, with a fixed camera position paired with slight follow movement to accurately capture the slippers' surface patterns, walking dynamics, thick sole details, and on-foot fit. There is no unnecessary camera shake, keeping full focus on the product itself.

[Background Sound]:

[Transition / Editing]:
- 采用烟雾轨迹转场的无缝剪辑手法，顺着香烟升腾流动的自然路径完成不同场景的顺滑过渡，全程色调统一暖润，画面衔接自然流畅，进一步强化神圣静谧的整体氛围。

title: Trolley Fresh Retractable Folding Grocery Shopping Cart with D — Handheld Demo (Singapore · Luggage & Bags)
creator: @glowuphubz
hook_line: Have you received your GST money? If yes, buy this trolley
pain_point: Carrying heavy groceries at wet market is inconvenient
prompt_en:
[Style]: A down-to-earth, realistic product promotion style for daily life, with bright, vivid visuals full of lively street market atmosphere. The footage focuses on demonstrating the product's practical functions, using accessible, highly approachable camera language that aligns with the tone of sharing everyday local useful items
[Environment]: A traditional indoor fresh produce market in daytime, with dense overhead ceiling lights providing ample, even illumination. Stalls are neatly stocked with fresh leafy greens, fresh fish, fresh fruits and other ingredients, with shoppers and vendors actively buying and selling in the background. The floor is clean and smooth, creating a bustling, lively atmosphere of daily grocery shopping
[Tone & Pacing]: An enthusiastic, approachable colloquial sharing style with a tight, brisk rhythm. Scene transitions are sharp and clean, every product function point is paired with corresponding real-life demonstration footage, no redundant frames are included. The entire video maintains a full, passionate sharing energy to quickly convey the product's advantages to the audience
[Camera]: Shot using a combination of medium shot selfie perspective and close-up product detail shots. The camera moves slightly and naturally following the character's movements, with handheld shooting creating a real, everyday feel. When demonstrating details such as product disassembly and pull rod adjustment, the shot switches to a fixed close-up to clearly present every part of the product's design
[Lighting]: Even overhead lighting inside the market, bright and soft with no harsh shadows. The character's face and all product details are clearly illuminated, the overall frame has vivid, transparent colors that highlight the lively atmosphere of the wet market and the fine texture of the product
[Character]: A 30-35 year old Southeast Asian Malay woman with a warm, natural healthy skin tone, soft rounded face and relaxed, gentle eyes. She wears a light, everyday no-makeup makeup look, has a full and well-proportioned figure, and is dressed in a loose light pink base outfit printed with small light blue florals, paired with a gradient hijab in shades of pink, blue and off-white. She has a friendly, cheerful and approachable temperament, moves crisply while sharing, and wears a highly infectious bright smile throughout the video

[Shots]
Shot 1:
  - Duration: 0.0sec - 2.0sec
  - Scene Type: Handheld product demonstration
  - Scene: Against the bustling background of the wet market, the Malay woman stands in front of the camera, holding the top handle of the printed shopping trolley with her left hand, and spreading her right palm upward to point at the trolley in front of her. Her mouth is open as she enthusiastically shares the great find with the camera, with a look of delighted excitement on her face, fully showing the overall appearance of the trolley to the viewer. The camera stays in a fixed medium shot, steadily framing both the person and the full product, so the audience can clearly see the product's overall shape at first glance.
  - Subject: Korang dah dapat duit GST tak? Haa, kalau dah dapat beli troli ni lah.
Shot 2:
  - Duration: 2.0sec - 5.0sec
  - Scene Type: Product usage scenario
  - Scene: The woman pulls the telescopic pull rod of the trolley all the way out, holds the top of the pull rod with both hands, faces sideways to the camera, and pulls the trolley easily and smoothly forward along the market aisle. She passes stalls full of fresh fish and green vegetables in the background, demonstrating the smooth, effortless glide of the trolley when pulled. The camera moves horizontally in sync with her walking path, maintaining a medium tracking shot to intuitively present the real usage effect of the product.
  - Subject: Pergi pasar senang besar, banyak barang boleh sumbat. Yang best, bag dengan
Shot 3:
  - Duration: 5.0sec - 7.0sec
  - Scene Type: Product design highlight
  - Scene: The camera pushes in to switch to a close-up shot of the product. A hand holds a transparent plastic bag filled with fresh long yardlong beans, and places the vegetables into the top bag of the trolley. Then the woman holds the two side handles of the bag with both hands, and lifts the fully loaded bag directly off the trolley frame, fully demonstrating the unique detachable design between the bag and the frame. The camera focuses on the connection point between the bag and the frame, clearly showing the entire separation action process.
  - Subject: Terima kasih kerana menonton!
Shot 4:
  - Duration: 7.0sec - 11.5sec
  - Scene Type: Ease of use demonstration
  - Scene: The woman holds the telescopic metal pull rod of the trolley with both hands, and traces the metal tube wall of the pull rod up and down with her fingers to demonstrate the height-adjustable function of the pull rod. Then she applies force with both hands to press the pull rod all the way down to fold it completely. The camera turns to the whole trolley, showing the easy folding and storage effect of the product. The fixed camera focuses on the pull rod structure and the folding process, making every product design detail clearly visible.
  - Subject: Lepas pakai, pak je, simpan dalam kereta pun senang.
Shot 5:
  - Duration: 11.5sec - 15.0sec
  - Scene Type: Lifestyle scenario demonstration
  - Scene: The fully folded compact printed trolley stands on the ground, the woman releases her grip and steps away from the frame from one side. Then she pulls the trolley's pull rod out again, holds the rod and walks easily forward along the market aisle once more, with a bright, satisfied smile on her face, showing the audience the convenience that the product can still be used normally even after being folded. The camera transitions from medium shot to close-up then pulls back to full wide shot, completely presenting the folded form and the smooth process of resuming use.
  - Subject: Terima kasih kerana menonton!
[Background Sound]:
- No background music or soundtrack throughout the entire video; the audio consists solely of clear, fast, colloquial commentary with a local accent. It follows a pure voiceover format with no music and high-density information output at a tight pace
[Transition / Editing]:
- Uses the fast jump-cut editing style popular on TikTok, switching shots directly and sharply at every product function demonstration point without dragging transition effects. The entire video maintains a brisk product promotion pace to let the audience quickly absorb all the product's highlight information

[Style]: Real-life outfit inspiration and product promotion aesthetic, with sharp, clear imagery, bright vivid colors, and straightforward, impactful cinematography that highlights the cargo pants' silhouette, multi-pocket practical functionality, and outfit versatility.
[Environment]: A sunny outdoor coastal viewing platform during the daytime, under a clear cloudless bright blue sky, with the Marina Bay Sands complex visible in the distance. The platform borders a calm waterfront lake, lush green palm fronds appear on the right side of the frame, and the ground is paved with light gray non-slip square tiles. The entire space is open, bright, and full of tropical urban leisure atmosphere.
[Tone & Pacing]: A relaxed, lively product promotion vibe with the creator sharing in a conversational, natural manner, no forced acting throughout. The shot rhythm shifts speed in sync with the drum beats and demonstration actions, maintaining a balanced pace that quickly showcases the full outfit look while leaving ample time to break down the product's core selling points in detail.
[Camera]: A combined camera movement approach using full-body long tracking shots and medium close-up detail shots. The camera starts by slowly moving around the standing creator to showcase the full outfit, then quickly pushes in to focus on the cargo pants pocket area, follows the subject's walking motion for synchronized tracking, and finally switches to a low-angle close-up shot angled slightly down to capture the squatting action, with smooth, stable footage throughout.
[Lighting]: Bright, abundant natural outdoor daylight during the daytime, with soft, even illumination that casts gentle, faint shadows on the subject and ground, clearly defining the cargo pants' three-dimensional cut and fabric texture. The overall image is crisp and clean with highly accurate color reproduction.
[Character]: 30-40 year old Asian male with a healthy tanned complexion, smooth skin with subtle natural facial texture, wearing black-rimmed glasses, with relaxed eyebrows, a moderately sized nose, and soft, friendly facial contours, no makeup, with a well-proportioned, upright build. He wears a loose brown short-sleeve T-shirt on top, khaki multi-pocket tapered cargo pants on the bottom, and matching color outdoor work boots. He has a mature, approachable demeanor, wears a gentle smile throughout, and maintains bright, engaged eyes while sharing.

[Shots]
Shot 1:
  - Duration: 0.0sec - 3.5sec
  - Scene Type: Outfit matching demonstration
  - Scene: In the open space of the coastal viewing platform, the creator stands at the center of the frame, with the iconic Marina Bay Sands complex and clear blue sky in the background. He naturally slips both hands into the cargo pants pockets, shifts his weight slightly side to side to adjust his stance, and shows off the full outfit from all angles while smiling at the camera. The camera performs a slow horizontal orbit around the subject, fully presenting the creator's full outfit and the iconic landmark scene behind him, featuring the Asian male creator wearing black-rimmed glasses.
  - Subject: See these cargo pants? So cool right?
Shot 2:
  - Duration: 3.5sec - 8.0sec
  - Scene Type: Product multi-functionality demonstration
  - Scene: The camera zooms in close to focus on the side of the creator's cargo pants. The creator pulls the zipper of the side cargo pocket open with one hand, then uses the other hand to take out a smartphone from the pocket to demonstrate the pocket's storage capacity. He then unzips the other side pocket and pulls out a folded black umbrella, fully showcasing the pockets' large capacity and practicality. The camera stays locked in close-up on the pant pocket area, moving slightly in sync with the hand motions to clearly capture the full details of the items being pulled out, showing the creator's upper body hands and the lower section of the cargo pants.
  - Subject: Comfortable, still got many pockets,
Shot 3:
  - Duration: 8.0sec - 10.0sec
  - Scene Type: Brand mention segment
  - Scene: The creator walks naturally forward on the viewing platform paved with light gray tiles, with relaxed, easy strides and his body swaying gently with each step, while the open waterfront landscape remains in the background. This shot demonstrates the drape and silhouette of the cargo pants while walking and the dynamic effect of the full outfit. The camera moves in perfect sync with the subject, smoothly tracking his walking path to capture the creator's full body.
  - Subject: local brand.
Shot 4:
  - Duration: 10.0sec - 12.5sec
  - Scene Type: Showcase multiple style options (fashion category)
  - Scene: The creator slowly squats down on the platform ground, looks down at the shoes by his feet, raises both hands to grasp the shoelaces and performs the action of tying his shoes, then looks up at the camera to continue sharing, with the sunny coastal urban landscape still in the background. The camera switches to a low-angle close-up, focusing on the creator's squatting motion and the matching details of the cargo pants' tapered cuffs and shoes, showing the creator's full lower body and part of his upper body.
  - Subject: Also got few colors  You want which one?
[Background Sound]:
- Upbeat TikTok-style background music with a brisk, lively rhythm, moderately high volume, electronic drum beats and playful synthesizer melodies, perfect for youthful, trend-focused product promotion short videos. The track style is similar to dedicated BGM for 'trendy street style' or 'Gen Z outfit recommendations', effectively boosting viewers' visual interest and purchase impulse for products such as Cargo Pants.
[Transition / Editing]:
- Crisp action-matched transitions that naturally connect the turning motion from the previous scene to the pocket close-up in the next. The entire editing rhythm aligns with the background music's drum beats for a consistent, unified visual style.
prompt_zh:
[Style]: 实景穿搭种草带货风，画面清晰锐利，色彩明快鲜活，镜头语言直白有力，重点突出工装裤的版型、多口袋实用功能与穿搭适配性。
[Environment]: 白天晴朗的户外滨海观景平台，湛蓝无云的干净天空下，远处坐落着滨海湾金沙建筑群，平台旁紧邻平静的滨水湖面，画面右侧露出翠绿的棕榈枝叶，地面铺设浅灰色防滑方形地砖，整体开阔明亮、充满热带都市休闲氛围。
[Tone & Pacing]: 博主口语化分享的轻松活泼带货氛围，全程自然随性无刻意表演，镜头节奏跟随鼓点与展示动作快慢切换，整体张弛有度，既能快速展现穿搭整体效果，又能留出充足时间细拆产品核心卖点。
[Camera]: 采用远景全身跟拍+中景细节特写的组合运镜方式，初始以站立博主为中心缓慢移动镜头展示全身穿搭，随后镜头快速推镜聚焦工装裤口袋区域，后期跟随人物行走动作做同步跟拍，最后切换至低角度近景俯拍蹲姿动作，全程画面平稳流畅。
[Lighting]: 白天自然充足的户外日光照明，光线明亮柔和，在人物身上与地面形成自然浅淡的阴影，清晰勾勒出工装裤的立体版型与面料肌理，整体画面通透干净，色彩还原度高。
[Character]: 30-40岁亚裔男性，健康小麦色皮肤，肤质光滑带少量真实面部纹理，佩戴黑框眼镜，眉形舒展、鼻梁适中，面部线条柔和亲切，无妆容，身形匀称挺拔，上身着咖色宽松短袖T恤，下身穿卡其色多口袋工装束脚裤，脚穿同色系户外工装鞋，气质成熟亲切，全程面带温和微笑，分享时眼神明亮有神。

[Shots]
Shot 1:
  - 时长: 0.0sec - 3.5sec
  - 镜头类型: 穿搭搭配示范
  - 画面: 滨海观景平台的开阔场景中，博主站在画面中央，背景是标志性的金沙建筑群与澄澈蓝天，他双手自然插在工装裤的口袋里，身体轻微左右转动调整站姿，全方位展示全身的穿搭效果，面带微笑看向镜头。镜头围绕人物缓慢做水平环绕移动，完整呈现人物全身穿搭与背后的标志性场景，出镜人物为佩戴黑框眼镜的亚裔博主男性。
  - 口播: See these cargo pants? So cool right?
Shot 2:
  - 时长: 3.5sec - 8.0sec
  - 镜头类型: 产品多功能性
  - 画面: 镜头近距离聚焦博主的工装裤侧面，博主一只手拉住工装裤侧口袋的拉链拉开袋口，另一只手从口袋中取出一部智能手机展示口袋储物能力，随后又拉开另一个侧口袋，从中掏出一把折叠好的黑色雨伞，充分展示口袋的超大容量与实用性。镜头保持特写锁定裤子口袋区域，轻微跟随手部动作做小幅度移动，清晰捕捉手部掏取物品的完整细节，画面呈现博主的上半身手部与下半身工装裤局部。
  - 口播: Comfortable, still got many pockets,
Shot 3:
  - 时长: 8.0sec - 10.0sec
  - 镜头类型: 品牌提及
  - 画面: 博主在铺有浅灰色地砖的观景平台上自然向前行走，脚步放松舒展，身体随步伐轻微摆动，背景依旧是开阔的滨水景观，展示工装裤行走时的版型垂坠感与整体穿搭的动态效果。镜头与人物保持同步移动，平稳跟随人物的行走轨迹进行跟拍，出镜人物为博主全身。
  - 口播: local brand.
Shot 4:
  - 时长: 10.0sec - 12.5sec
  - 镜头类型: 展示多款式选择（时尚品类）
  - 画面: 博主在平台地面上缓缓蹲下身子，低头看向自己脚边的鞋子，双手抬起握住鞋子的鞋带做出系鞋带的动作，过程中抬头看向镜头继续分享，背景依旧是晴朗的滨海都市景观。镜头切换为低角度近景，聚焦在博主的蹲姿动作与工装裤束脚、鞋子的搭配细节上，画面呈现博主全身下半身及上半身部分区域。
  - 口播: Also got few colors  You want which one?
[Background Sound]:
- 非常欢快的TikTok风格背景音乐，节奏轻快活泼、音量适中偏高、带有电子鼓点和俏皮合成器旋律，适合年轻化、潮流感强的带货短视频，歌曲风格类似“潮流街头风”或“Z世代穿搭推荐”专用BGM，能有效提升观众对商品（如Cargo Pants）的视觉兴趣与购买冲动。
[Transition / Editing]:
- 采用利落的动作匹配转场，从前一个场景的转身动作自然衔接下一个场景的口袋特写，全程剪辑节奏贴合背景音乐的鼓点节拍，视觉风格连贯统一。

title: Men's Double Layer Sport Shorts Trendy Design Quick Dry Breath — OOTD Showcase (Singapore · Sports & Outdoor)
creator: @padisteal
hook_line: On a city sidewalk in daytime, under sunlight, men's double-layer sports shorts are shown
prompt_en:
[Style]: Realistic streetwear showcase, with natural and vivid colors on screen, soft light and shadow transitions, blending the laid-back vibe of daily street life with the energetic texture of sportswear, presenting an authentic, unforced outfit presentation.
[Environment]: The sidewalk area of an urban street during the daytime. Under clear sunny weather, warm sunlight covers the ground, the pavement underfoot is asphalt marked with yellow traffic lines and white intersection signs. The background features blurred storefront buildings along the street, with passing pedestrians in the distance, forming a lively, everyday urban outdoor scene full of worldly charm.
[Tone & Pacing]: Slow and steady rhythm, no abrupt camera cuts. The showcase of apparel details unfolds gently in step with the background music melody, creating a relaxed, comfortable atmosphere for the streetwear presentation.
[Camera]: Shoots along a fixed horizontal circular trajectory moving slowly, keeping the entire frame focused on the character's lower body. The camera rotates at a constant slow speed with no noticeable shake, clearly and completely presenting the overall cut, details and texture of the shorts and sneakers.
[Lighting]: Uses natural direct daytime sunlight as the main light source. The light shines from the side, casting a clear soft shadow of the character on the ground. The light is bright and soft, clearly outlining the fabric texture of the athletic shorts and the sleek lines of the sneakers, with overall natural and translucent lighting.
[Character]: An Asian young man aged 20 to 30, with a healthy wheat-toned leg complexion, firm and smooth skin contours, well-proportioned and toned leg muscles, and a tall, relaxed posture. He wears a simple basic white T-shirt on the upper body, black double-layer athletic shorts on the lower body, and white running sneakers with a black brand logo. His style is fresh and energetic, with the sunny, laid-back temperament of an athletic young man. He stands naturally throughout the shot, with his right hand tucked into the side pocket of the shorts holding a white item, and his left hand hanging naturally by his side.

[Shots]
Shot 1:
  - Duration: 0.0sec - 6.0sec
  - Scene Type: OOTD outfit showcase
  - Scene: The frame focuses on the lower body area of the standing character. The character maintains a natural standing posture, with his right hand tucked into the side pocket of the shorts, revealing the edge of the white item inside. The camera slowly moves to the right, gradually showcasing the loose outer cut and the tight inner length of the black double-layer athletic shorts, as well as the full appearance details of the white sneakers. Blurred pedestrians in the background slowly pass by the street in front of the storefronts, and the sunlight casts a clear soft shadow on the ground.
Shot 2:
  - Duration: 6.0sec - 17.0sec
  - Scene Type: OOTD outfit showcase
  - Scene: The camera continues moving at a constant speed along the horizontal circular trajectory, slowly turning from the character's front side to the character's back side, clearly displaying the side tailoring details of the athletic shorts, as well as the brand logo on the heel of the sneaker and the outsole tread details. The character remains in a still standing posture the whole time, his leg muscle lines are naturally relaxed, and warm-toned sunlight evenly covers the clothing and shoe surfaces.
Shot 3:
  - Duration: 17.0sec - 25.0sec
  - Scene Type: OOTD outfit showcase
  - Scene: The camera keeps moving along the circular trajectory, turning back to the front side view of the character, fully presenting the overall matching effect of the complete lower-body athletic outfit. The right hand remains in the pocket with the white item exposed, the blurred background scene changes naturally as the camera moves, and the melody of the background music continues to play.
[Background Sound]:
- Gentle, emotional pop-rock background music led by piano and electric guitar, with a slow tempo that carries emotional undulations. The melody is warm and healing, supported by soft drum beats and string layers. The overall atmosphere is romantic with a touch of sentimentality, leaning into the Chinese pop-rock style, perfectly suited for apparel showcase scenes. The volume is moderate and does not overpower dialogue, enhancing the audience's emotional resonance, and the accompanying English lyrics of the background music run through the entire video.
[Transition / Editing]:
- The entire video uses a seamless continuous long take, no deliberate editing jumps. The natural transition of scenes and display angles is achieved entirely through the camera's constant-speed circular movement, resulting in a smooth, coherent footage that maximally restores the authentic streetwear showcase atmosphere.

prompt_en:
[Style]: Anthropomorphic 3D fantasy animation style with strong color contrast, exaggerated and dramatically expressive character designs that balance a cautionary tone with childlike playfulness, matching the typical aesthetic of Thai maternal and child science-focused viral short videos.
[Environment]: The opening scene is a softly lit home wooden tabletop, with warm natural light casting dappled shadows; the scene then transitions sequentially to a dark red capillary-textured tunnel, a dining plate holding cartoon fried eggs, a red console spaceship cockpit, a magical forest, and finally settles in a vintage magic laboratory furnished with a globe and a magic circle map, with the overall atmosphere shifting from tense to dreamy and soothing.
[Tone & Pacing]: The early segment has a tight, fast pace, with animated characters showing intense emotions and large, dynamic movements to quickly deliver educational warnings about the dangers of iron deficiency; after the product introduction phase begins, the pace slows to a relaxed, cheerful rhythm, with characters appearing calm and happy, and the scene taking on a bright, warm vibe, forming a complete emotional arc from tension to ease.
[Camera]: The entire video uses front-following shots and close-up push-in perspectives for the characters: the opening low-angle upward tracking shot follows the thumb character sprinting to create a sense of oppression; it then cuts to close-up facial shots of each anthropomorphic character to amplify their emotions; finally it switches to an eye-level full shot to show the scene, with steady focus on the product packaging box to highlight the core information.
[Lighting]: Warm side lighting at the opening outlines the soft contours of the finger and the tabletop; the capillary tunnel uses dim dark red ambient light paired with red fluorescent light spots to set a dim, eerie mood; the spaceship cockpit uses large-area red screen backlighting to reinforce the sense of warning; the magical forest uses Tyndall warm light mixed with golden firefly light spots to create a soothing atmosphere; the magic laboratory uses a diagonal key light to precisely illuminate the product and emphasize its prominent display position.
[Character]: 6 anthropomorphic cartoon characters in total: a light-skinned thumb character with an angry, tense expression and hurried movements; a dark red spherical red blood cell character roaring angrily with large, forceful limb movements; a fried egg character made from a cooked fried egg, looking angry and unwilling while clenching its fists; a pink-purple brain character fitted with mechanical armor, looking serious and stern as it points directly at the camera; a silver-gray metallic spherical iron element character that is lively, agile and highly approachable; a translucent orange-yellow small water droplet character that is playful, lively and full of charm.

[Camera]: Fixed close-up shot, with the focus firmly on the pair of hands holding the picture book in the foreground and the yellow promotional label on the cardboard box. He naturally holds the belt with one hand throughout the shot, flexibly flipping his fingers to show different angles, and slightly rotates his wrist to adjust the display orientation. His movements are smooth and relaxed, full of the approachable affinity of a down-to-earth sales presenter.

[Style]: 治愈系写实美学风，画面整体高光柔和清透，色彩温润低饱和，精准还原水晶摇钱树细腻的原石质感与铜丝编织的精致纹理，兼具精致产品展示的高级感与家居场景的温馨氛围感。
[Environment]: 布置雅致的浅色系客厅桌面场景，纯白色圆形哑光桌面旁摆放着带肌理感的米白色陶瓷杯与杯碟，背景虚化出窗边朦胧绿植、半透米白色纱帘，远处点缀插满干花的素色花瓶与简约装饰画，全程笼罩在柔和日间自然光中。
[Tone & Pacing]: 整体氛围舒缓治愈，节奏平缓从容，镜头的切换与物品展示动作都保持轻柔的韵律感，适配好物科普分享的松弛调性，让观者沉浸式感受水晶摆件的温润质感。
[Camera]: 采用产品全景固定机位展示+微距特写镜头交替拍摄，搭配手部托举摆件时的轻微跟拍运镜，全程运镜流畅平稳，无多余剧烈晃动，还原水晶摇钱树的立体造型与细节纹理。
[Lighting]: 柔和均匀的北向日间自然光从窗边倾洒而下，光线通透不刺眼，在水晶原石表面晕开温润高光，铜丝枝干处形成层次细腻的柔和阴影，画面明暗过渡自然，营造出温暖治愈的居家氛围感。
[Character]: 仅出镜年轻东亚女性的手部，手部肌肤细腻白皙，皮肤状态紧致光滑，无夸张美甲；动作轻柔克制，用手掌平稳托住粉色花盆底部，手腕轻轻带动摆件缓慢转动调整角度，将水晶树稳稳放回桌面，尽显珍视摆件的情绪。

[Shots]
Shot 1:
  - 时长: 0.0sec - 1.0sec
  - 镜头类型: 产品材质展示
  - 画面: 全景固定镜头，完整展示放置在纯白色圆形桌面上的桃色月光石水晶摇钱树，摆件稳稳落座在粉色陶瓷花盆中，盆内铺满色彩缤纷的圆润小石子，背景是虚化的绿植、纱帘与干花花瓶，画面顶部同步浮现对应泰语字幕。
  - 口播: คุณเชื่อเรื่องพลังดาลเมตร ที่เกิดขึ้นเองตามธรรมชาติ
Shot 2:
  - 时长: 1.0sec - 2.0sec
  - 镜头类型: 手持商品展示
  - 画面: 一只白皙的手从画面右侧缓缓伸出，手指轻轻搭住粉色花盆边缘，缓缓转动花盆，带动水晶摇钱树缓慢旋转，多角度呈现摆件整体造型，画面顶部同步浮现新的泰语字幕。
  - 口播: คุณเชื่อเรื่องพลังดาลเมตร ที่เกิดขึ้นเองตามธรรมชาติ
Shot 3:
  - 时长: 2.0sec - 3.0sec
  - 镜头类型: 产品细节特写
  - 画面: 镜头切换为微距特写，近距离对准水晶摇钱树的树冠部分，清晰呈现一颗颗水滴形桃色月光石原石被细铜丝逐一串联固定的精致细节，原石表面泛出温润的柔光，铜丝纹理细腻清晰，画面顶部同步浮现对应泰语字幕。
  - 口播: คุณเชื่อเรื่องพลังดาลเมตร ที่เกิดขึ้นเองตามธรรมชาติ
Shot 4:
  - 时长: 3.0sec - 5.0sec
  - 镜头类型: 手持商品展示
  - 画面: 镜头拉回中景，这只手稳稳托住粉色花盆的底部，将整盆水晶摇钱树轻轻托起悬空，缓慢小幅度转动手腕，带着摆件缓缓旋转，从不同方位完整展示水晶树的整体造型，画面顶部先后浮现泰语字幕与英文标识“Peach Moonstone”。
  - 口播: คือพลังที่ส่งด้านที่มีกันที่ส่งด้านที่มีกัน
Shot 5:
  - 时长: 5.0sec - 7.0sec
  - 镜头类型: 产品材质展示
  - 画面: 镜头再次切回微距特写，聚焦水晶摇钱树的部分树冠与枝干，细致展现桃色月光石原石通透柔和的色泽变化，每一颗原石的浅橘调光泽都清晰可辨，铜丝编织的树干纹理自然舒展，画面顶部持续浮现对应泰语字幕。
  - 口播: คือพลังที่ส่งด้านที่มีกันที่ส่งด้านที่มีกัน
Shot 6:
  - 时长: 7.0sec - 9.0sec
  - 镜头类型: 场景化生活秀
  - 画面: 镜头回到温馨的全景居家场景，这只手将托举的水晶摇钱树缓缓放回纯白色圆形桌面，镜头微调角度完整捕捉摆件静置桌面后的优美姿态，画面顶部先后浮现泰语字幕与带爱心标识的英文“Peach Moonstone”。
  - 口播: พีชมูลโซน เด่นเรื่องสนามรัก
Shot 7:
  - 时长: 9.0sec - 10.0sec
  - 镜头类型: 产品设计亮点
  - 画面: 镜头回到温馨的全景居家场景，这只手将托举的水晶摇钱树缓缓放回纯白色圆形桌面，镜头微调角度完整捕捉摆件静置桌面后的优美姿态，画面顶部先后浮现泰语字幕与带爱心标识的英文“Peach Moonstone”。
  - 口播: ความอ่อนยอม
Shot 8:
  - 时长: 10.0sec - 10.5sec
  - 镜头类型: 产品细节特写
  - 画面: 镜头切换为微距特写，近距离对准粉色花盆内部，聚焦盆内铺满的色彩斑斓的圆润小石子，铜丝树干的底端稳稳扎根在石子之间，画面构图饱满柔和。
[Background Sound]:
- 轻柔空灵的氛围音乐，带有自然风铃与流水声的元素，节奏舒缓、音色温暖，营造出神秘而治愈的氛围，展现天然宝石的灵性与能量感。音乐无明显歌词，以弦乐与自然音效为主，属于冥想疗愈系自然灵性音乐，适配能量石类产品的展示场景。
[Transition / Editing]:
- 采用场景间自然流畅的淡入淡出转场方式，微距镜头与全景镜头之间的切换衔接丝滑，没有生硬的跳转感，全程色调统一柔和，最大化放大水晶摆件的温润治愈质感。

title: 【เพียงเสื้อเดียวตัวเดียว】เสื้อกล้ามไร้แขนเด็กผู้หญิงฤดูร้อนรุ่ — Handheld Demo (Thailand · Kids' Fashion)
creator: @pueng_boosara
hook_line: A hand lifts the hanger with light blue polka dot cat print kids' clothes to the center of the lens
prompt_en:
[Style]: Sweet Japanese-style children's clothing showcase aesthetic, the entire frame features a dreamy pastel macaron color palette of pink and purple, with soft, luminous highlights, bright and saturated clothing colors, and an inherent whimsical, childlike filter texture.
[Environment]: A dreamy, comforting purple-themed children's clothing store, with the background lined with racks of matching light blue polka-dot children's outfits. Warm yellow string lights wrap around all the walls, decorated with 3D cartoon stickers of strawberries, flowers, and teddy bears. In the corner sits a vase holding purple flowers and a soft, fluffy teddy bear plush toy. On the small purple foreground counter, children's white sneakers with cartoon patterns are neatly arranged, scattered with small white and purple daisy decorations, full of warm childlike charm.
[Tone & Pacing]: Light, lively e-commerce product recommendation style, with a brisk, tight rhythm. The hand movements swinging the hanger are smooth and natural, full of dynamism, showcasing the cute appearance of the children's clothing from all angles.
[Camera]: Fixed-position medium close-up shot, with the children's clothing set as the absolute visual center. The frame stays steady and in focus throughout, accurately capturing the cat print, polka dot texture, and ruffled trim details on the clothing, with no unnecessary camera shake.
[Lighting]: Surrounding warm-toned string lights act as the base ambient light source, paired with even, soft frontal fill light. This illuminates the fine fabric and playful details of the children's clothing, while the diffused reflected light from the purple walls enhances the dreamy, warm visual effect, delivering extremely accurate color reproduction for the garments.
[Character]: Only the right hand and part of the forearm of a 20-30 year old East Asian woman are visible. The arm has fair, smooth skin, the nails are finished with a sheer, clean white manicure, and a simple thin gold bracelet is worn on the wrist, giving a neat, gentle impression with soft, nimble hand movements.

[Shots]
Shot 1:
  - Duration: 0.0sec - 1.5sec
  - Scene Type: Handheld product showcase
  - Scene: The frame shows the warm scene of the dreamy purple children's clothing store. A right hand wearing a gold bracelet holds a wooden hanger, slowly lifting the hanger with the light blue polka-dot cat print sleeveless children's clothing set from the bottom of the frame to the center of the shot, clearly displaying the full appearance of the outfit's ruffled lace collar, cute cat print, and denim shorts.
Shot 2:
  - Duration: 1.5sec - 3.0sec
  - Scene Type: Product design highlights
  - Scene: The hand gently rotates the hanger in small motions, turning the children's clothing set slightly to the side. The shot fully presents the side silhouette of the set, clearly showing the unique asymmetrical hem design of the top and the side pocket details of the shorts. The matching hanging garments, teddy bear plush, and string lights in the background remain as soft, blurred decorative elements.
Shot 3:
  - Duration: 3.0sec - 5.0sec
  - Scene Type: Product material showcase
  - Scene: The right hand holds the top of the hanger and slowly shakes the children's clothing set up and down in small motions, demonstrating the natural drape of the shorts' soft denim fabric, while fully revealing the cartoon cat print details on the top. The playful purple decor in the background stays steady and does not draw focus away from the product.
[Background Sound]:
- A very upbeat pop-electronic TikTok background track, fast-paced with a medium-high volume level, featuring a playful female vocal performance. Perfect for lively, youth-focused product showcase short videos, it has a strong rhythmic beat that quickly grabs the audience's attention, boosts the video's dynamism and emotional appeal, and the overall vibe matches the light, playful, childlike nature of children's clothing displays.
[Transition / Editing]:
- Seamless, continuous camera movement transitions, using only the natural hand motions of adjusting the hanger to shift the frame, no harsh jump cuts, keeping the entire showcase process smooth and natural, precisely highlighting every cute detail of the children's clothing.
prompt_zh:
[Style]: 甜美日系童装展示风，画面整体呈现粉紫梦幻马卡龙色调，高光柔和通透，衣物色彩鲜亮饱满，自带童趣滤镜质感。
[Environment]: 梦幻治愈的紫色系儿童服装店，背景挂满同款浅蓝色波点童装，墙面四周环绕暖黄色串状灯带，装饰有卡通草莓、花朵、小熊立体贴纸，角落摆放怀抱紫花的花瓶、软萌泰迪小熊玩偶，前景紫色小台面上整齐摆放带卡通图案的儿童小白鞋，散落白紫小雏菊装饰，充满童趣温馨感。
[Tone & Pacing]: 轻松活泼的电商好物分享风格，节奏轻快紧凑，手部摆动衣架的动作流畅自然，动态感十足，全方位展示童装的可爱外观。
[Camera]: 采用固定机位的中近景镜头，以童装套装为绝对视觉中心，全程画面平稳聚焦，精准捕捉衣物上的猫咪印花、波点纹理与木耳领细节，无多余镜头晃动。
[Lighting]: 以环绕式暖色调灯带作为氛围基础光源，搭配均匀柔和的正面补光，既打亮童装的细腻面料与童趣细节，又借助紫色墙面的漫反射光烘托出梦幻温馨的视觉效果，衣物色彩还原度极高。
[Character]: 仅露出20-30岁东亚女性的右手及部分小臂，手臂皮肤白皙细腻，指甲做清透干净的白色美甲，佩戴简约细款金色手镯，气质利落温柔，手部动作轻柔灵动。

[Shots]
Shot 1:
  - 时长: 0.0sec - 1.5sec
  - 镜头类型: 手持商品展示
  - 画面: 画面展示梦幻紫色童装店的温馨场景，一只佩戴金色手镯的右手捏着木质衣架，将挂有浅蓝色波点猫咪印花无袖童装套装的衣架从画面下方缓缓向镜头中心位置提起，清晰展现出童装木耳领花边、可爱猫咪印花以及牛仔短裤的完整外观。
Shot 2:
  - 时长: 1.5sec - 3.0sec
  - 镜头类型: 产品设计亮点
  - 画面: 手部轻轻小幅转动衣架，将童装套装微微侧转，镜头完整呈现出套装的侧面版型，清晰展示出上衣不对称下摆的别致设计与短裤侧边口袋的细节，背景里的同款挂衣、小熊玩偶、串灯等元素始终作为柔和的虚化衬托。
Shot 3:
  - 时长: 3.0sec - 5.0sec
  - 镜头类型: 产品材质展示
  - 画面: 右手捏住衣架顶部小幅度缓慢上下晃动童装套装，展示出短裤柔软牛仔面料的自然垂坠感，同时将上衣上的猫咪卡通印花细节完整呈现，背景的紫色童趣陈设保持稳定不抢焦点。
[Background Sound]:
- 非常欢快的流行电子风格TikTok背景音乐，快节奏、音量中等偏高、带有俏皮女声演唱，适合年轻化活泼的产品展示类短视频，节奏感强，能快速吸引观众注意力，增强视频动感与情绪感染力，整体氛围适配童装展示的轻松童趣属性。
[Transition / Editing]:
- 采用无痕迹连贯运镜衔接，全程依靠手部调整衣架的自然动作完成画面过渡，没有生硬剪辑跳转，保持整个展示过程流畅自然，精准突出童装的每一处可爱细节。

title: เสื้อชั้นในเด็กวัยเริ่มโต 8-13 ปี ไร้ตะเข็บ ผ้าไหมน้ำแข็ง ฟองน — Handheld Demo (Thailand · Kids' Fashion)
creator: @napatsawan_a
hook_line: Students need ice-silk breathable comfortable underwear
pain_point: Student underwear is stuffy and uncomfortable
prompt_en:
[Style]: Fresh, healing e-commerce realistic style, with bright and clean visuals, prominent soft light texture of the clothing, and an overall gentle and cozy atmosphere that accurately conveys the refreshing wearing experience of student underwear camisoles.
[Environment]: A warm girl's bedroom with abundant sunlight during the daytime, soft natural daylight streaming in through the window. In the background, there is a wooden double bed covered with light blue and pink bedding, and a log bedside table with a lamp next to the bed. The indoor light is bright but not harsh, and the space is simply and warmly decorated.
[Tone & Pacing]: A relaxed, lively product-sharing style, with a smooth, flowing rhythm throughout. The camera gradually focuses on product details, using natural zoom-in and push-in movements to clearly showcase the camisole's cut and embroidery highlights.
[Camera]: Two hands hold the camisole facing the camera for display, using a straight-on eye-level shooting angle. Then the camera moves smoothly forward, gradually switching from a full-shot composition to a partial close-up shot, with precise focus locked on the camisole subject the entire time.
[Lighting]: Soft natural light pouring in through the bedroom window paired with indoor diffused fill light. The light is even and soft with no harsh shadows, maximally highlighting the silky, smooth fabric texture of the white camisole, resulting in an overall bright and clear image.
[Character]: No full human figure is shown in the video; only a pair of hands are visible: fair-skinned, with slender, delicate fingers. The hands move gently and smoothly, steadily holding the two shoulder straps of the camisole to display it.

[Shots]
Shot 1:
  - Duration: 0.0sec - 3.5sec
  - Scene Type: Handheld product display
  - Scene: A pair of hands holds the left and right shoulder straps of a white embroidered camisole respectively, holding the camisole flat directly in front of the camera. The full shot completely presents the camisole's U-shaped neckline, one-piece cut, and the cute rabbit and carrot embroidery pattern on the upper left corner. The background is a sunlit warm bedroom, the camera maintains an eye-level position, and the subject slowly moves forward to gradually push in toward the camisole.
  - Subject: เซื่อสับไหนที่นักเรียนต้องมีเนื้อผ้าเย็นสบายรู้สึกเบา
Shot 2:
  - Duration: 3.5sec - 8.0sec
  - Scene Type: Product material display
  - Scene: The camera continues to push forward, the footage transitions from the full view of the camisole to a partial close-up of the neckline and embroidery area, clearly showing the seamless, smooth texture of the camisole fabric and the delicate embroidery details of the little rabbit holding a carrot. The bedroom elements in the background gradually blur, and the shot finally freezes on the close-up of the embroidery pattern.
  - Subject: สบายตลอดวันใส่แล้วเนียนกริบมั่นใจทุกกิจกรรมตอนนี้ มีแฟลสเซล รีบกดสั่งเลยค่ะ
[Background Sound]:
- Very upbeat TikTok-style background music with a lively, brisk tempo of around 120-130 BPM, moderately high volume, featuring electronic pop elements and a drum-driven rhythm. The catchy melody is full of youthful energy, perfect for student-focused product promotion scenarios. Its style is similar to K-pop dance pop or Gen Z trending sounds, creating a relaxed, confident, trendy shopping atmosphere that perfectly matches the selling points of student underwear, lightweight comfort, and confident movement.
[Transition / Editing]:
- Smooth, gradual push-in camera movement is used for scene transitions, with no abrupt clip jumps. The continuous forward movement of the camera naturally achieves the visual switch from the full product view to detailed close-ups, keeping the footage coherent and fluid.
prompt_zh:
[Style]: 清新治愈电商写实风，画面通透洁净，衣物柔光质感突出，整体氛围温柔舒适，精准传递学生内衣背心的清爽穿着感。
[Environment]: 白天阳光充裕的温馨少女卧室，窗边洒入柔和自然日光，背景可见铺着浅蓝与粉色床品的木质双人床，床边摆放带台灯的原木床头柜，室内光线明亮不刺眼，布置简约温馨。
[Tone & Pacing]: 轻松明快的好物分享风格，全程节奏舒缓流畅，镜头逐步聚焦产品细节，通过自然的放大拉近动作，清晰呈现背心的版型与刺绣亮点。
[Camera]: 双手举着背心正对镜头展示，采用正向平视拍摄视角，随后镜头平滑向前推进，从全景构图逐渐切换至局部特写画面，全程对焦精准锁定背心主体。
[Lighting]: 卧室窗边倾洒而入的柔和自然光搭配室内漫反射补光，光线均匀柔和无生硬阴影，最大程度凸显白色背心的冰丝顺滑面料质感，画面整体干净透亮。
[Character]: 视频中未露出完整人物形象，仅展示了一双手：肤色白皙、手指纤细修长，手部姿态轻柔舒展，稳稳捏住背心两侧肩带进行展示。

[Shots]
Shot 1:
  - 时长: 0.0sec - 3.5sec
  - 镜头类型: 手持商品展示
  - 画面: 一双手分别捏住白色刺绣背心的左右肩带，将背心平整地举在镜头正前方，画面全景完整呈现背心的U型领口、一体式版型以及左上角可爱的兔子胡萝卜刺绣图案，背景是充满阳光的温馨卧室，镜头保持平视机位，主体缓慢向前平移逐步推近背心。
  - 口播: เซื่อสับไหนที่นักเรียนต้องมีเนื้อผ้าเย็นสบายรู้สึกเบา
Shot 2:
  - 时长: 3.5sec - 8.0sec
  - 镜头类型: 产品材质展示
  - 画面: 镜头持续向前推进，画面从背心全景过渡到领口与刺绣区域的局部特写，清晰展现背心面料的无痕顺滑质感，以及小兔子抱着胡萝卜的精致刺绣细节，背景卧室元素逐渐虚化，最终定格在刺绣图案的特写画面上。

[Lighting]: 以从窗边倾洒而入的柔和暖调自然光为主光源，光线均匀覆盖桌面与食材，金属刀身形成柔和的高光反光，没有生硬阴影，全程营造温暖治愈的居家烹饪氛围感。

title: กางเกงคาร์โก้สำหรับผู้ชาย พลัสไซส์ ขายดี หลายกระเป๋า ทำจากผ้าฝ — Product Close-Up (Thailand · Menswear & Underwear)
creator: @moou_nt21
hook_line: Show two mannequins wearing gray casual pants front and back
prompt_en:
[Style]: A realistic, high-quality aesthetic for a trendy men's clothing store, paired with partial flickering light and shadow effects to highlight the drape of the trouser fabric and the details of the cut. The overall frame is clean and premium, fully showcasing the sophisticated atmosphere of the clothing items.
[Environment]: Inside a modern trendy men's clothing store, the space is based on dark gray matte walls, with linear cool blue neon light strips outlining the edges. On the left stands a black metal clothing rack holding black and white short-sleeve T-shirts, and deep on the right are wooden display shelves stacked with apparel. The floor is a light gray matte finish, with even and soft lighting throughout.
[Tone & Pacing]: A calm, slow showcase rhythm that focuses entirely on the appearance and cut of the men's casual trousers throughout. Visual focus is enhanced through alternating light and shadow changes on local areas, with smooth and consistent camera movement that fully highlights the refined texture and trendy attributes of the casual trousers.
[Camera]: Primarily uses a fixed-position wide shot, paired with slow orbiting camera movement to fully capture the front and back details of the trousers displayed by the two mannequins respectively. The camera movement remains completely smooth and steady with no large shakes, clearly covering detailed parts including the waist button, brand tag, pocket design, and hem cut.
[Lighting]: The main light source is multi-angle evenly distributed in-store soft lighting, ensuring no harsh shadows on the trouser fabric and natural, true color reproduction. The cool blue neon light strips in the background act as ambient fill light, and periodic brightness-darkness gradient effects are interspersed in the frame to further emphasize the three-dimensional cut and fine fabric texture of the trousers.
[Character]: No on-screen human figures. The main subjects of the video are two mannequins that only retain the waist, hip to foot sections, each wearing the same style of gray casual long trousers and black flip-flops.

[Shots]
Shot 1:
  - Duration: 0.0sec - 3.0sec
  - Scene Type: Product material showcase
  - Scene: The frame fully presents two adjacent mannequins inside the store. One faces the camera directly to show the full front view of the gray casual trousers, with visible silver metal buttons, classic waistband design, and smooth trouser silhouette, wearing black flip-flops printed with the text 'Salami' on its feet. The other mannequin faces the camera sideways to show the back of the trousers, with a black tag on the back waist printed with the text 'LOG-OFF' and a flap-style back pocket. In the background, the black and white T-shirts hanging on the clothing rack and the edge neon light strips are visible. The camera stays in a steady wide shot state, and the frame slowly undergoes a brightness-darkness gradient.
Shot 2:
  - Duration: 3.0sec - 9.0sec
  - Scene Type: Product design highlights
  - Scene: The camera slowly pans and pushes toward the mannequin on the left side of the frame, gradually focusing on the front details of the trousers, clearly showing the stitching of the fly, the stitching of the side pockets, and the natural drape of the trouser hems. During the process, alternating brightness-darkness gradient effects continue to appear in the frame, reducing background interference and drawing all visual focus to the fabric texture and silhouette lines of the trousers.
Shot 3:
  - Duration: 9.0sec - 15.0sec
  - Scene Type: Product design highlights
  - Scene: The camera slowly moves from the left mannequin to the right, pulling back to the wide shot perspective to fully present the overall matching effect of the front and back of the trousers displayed by the two mannequins. The fine stitching of the back pocket and the brand mark on the back waist are clearly visible. The frame uses flickering brightness-darkness changes again to strengthen visual memory points, and finally the frame returns to a bright state, clearly showing the full silhouette of the two pairs of trousers and the trendy spatial atmosphere of the store.
[Background Sound]:
- A light, upbeat song in Thai pop-folk style with a gentle rhythm and soft melody, dominated by guitar and soft drum beats. The female vocalist sings in a playful, slightly coquettish tone, with lyrics centered around sweet interactions. The volume is moderate and does not overpower other audio, perfectly matching the trendy casual vibe of the men's outfit showcase, and plays continuously throughout the entire video as background music.
[Transition / Editing]:
- Uses periodic brightness-darkness gradient of the frame as the core transition connection effect, with no harsh camera jumps. Through the natural alternation of light and shadow brightness, different display perspectives are switched smoothly, maintaining a consistent frame style throughout to achieve a coherent, premium-atmosphere product showcase rhythm.
prompt_zh:
[Style]: 潮流男装店质感写实风，搭配局部明暗闪烁的光影特效，突出裤子面料的垂坠质感与版型细节，整体画面干净高级，尽显穿搭单品的精致氛围感。
[Environment]: 现代潮流男装店内，空间以深灰色哑光墙面为基底，边缘环绕线性冷蓝色霓虹灯带勾勒轮廓；左侧立有黑色金属衣架挂着黑白短袖T恤，右侧深处是叠放服饰的木质陈列货架，地面为浅灰色哑光地坪，光线均匀柔和。
[Tone & Pacing]: 沉稳舒缓的展示节奏，全程围绕男士休闲裤的外观与版型展开呈现，通过局部明暗交替的光影变化强化视觉焦点，镜头移动平缓连贯，尽显休闲裤的精致质感与潮流属性。
[Camera]: 采用固定机位全景为主，搭配缓慢的环绕式镜头推移，完整捕捉两个人台模特分别展示的裤子正面与背面细节，镜头移动全程流畅平稳，无大幅度晃动，清晰覆盖裤腰纽扣、品牌标签、口袋设计、裤脚剪裁等细节部位。
[Lighting]: 主光源采用多角度均匀分布的店内柔光照明，确保裤身面料无生硬阴影、色彩还原自然真实；搭配背景冷蓝色霓虹灯带作为氛围补光，画面穿插周期性的明暗渐变效果，进一步突出裤子的立体版型与细腻面料纹理。
[Character]: 无出镜人物，视频主体为两尊仅保留腰胯至足部的人体模型，分别穿着同款式灰色休闲长裤与黑色人字拖。

[Shots]

Shot 2:
  - 时长: 3.0sec - 9.0sec
  - 镜头类型: 产品设计亮点
  - 画面: 镜头缓慢向画面左侧的人体模型平移推进，逐步聚焦裤子的正面细节，清晰展现裤门襟走线、侧面口袋缝线、裤脚的自然垂坠感；过程中画面持续穿插明暗交替的渐变效果，弱化背景干扰，将视觉焦点完全集中在裤身的面料纹理与版型线条上。
Shot 3:
  - 时长: 9.0sec - 15.0sec
  - 镜头类型: 产品设计亮点
  - 画面: 镜头从左侧人体模型缓慢向右侧移动，重新拉回全景视角，完整呈现两尊人体模型所展示的裤子正面与背面的整体搭配效果，背面后口袋的精致走线、后腰品牌标识清晰可见；画面再次通过明暗闪烁的变化强化视觉记忆点，最终画面回归明亮状态，清晰展现两条裤子的完整版型与门店潮流空间氛围。
[Background Sound]:
- 一首带有泰国流行民谣风格的轻快歌曲，节奏舒缓、旋律温柔，以吉他和轻柔鼓点为主，人声为女声演唱，语调俏皮又带点撒娇感，歌词内容围绕甜蜜互动，音量适中不压声，贴合男装穿搭展示的潮流休闲氛围，全程持续铺底。
[Transition / Editing]:
- 以画面周期性明暗渐变作为核心转场衔接效果，无生硬的镜头跳转，通过光影明暗的自然交替，流畅切换不同展示视角，全程保持画面风格统一，实现连贯且富有高级氛围感的单品展示节奏。

The background is surrounded by dense green shrubs, broad-leaved trees and outdoor potted plants. The lighting is bright and natural, forming an outdoor garden scene with soft sunlight during the daytime.
[Tone & Pacing]: The opening rhythm is slow and oppressive, focusing on the weak state of the dog infested by ticks. Then the rhythm suddenly speeds up, forming a strong visual impact with the footage of ticks falling off rapidly. The second half turns relaxed and bright, showing the happy state of the dog after recovering its health. The overall narrative rhythm is well-controlled with alternating tension and relaxation, and has a strong sales promotion feel.
[Camera]: Use a macro close-up lens to shoot the details of ticks covering the dog's head at close range. Then switch to a medium shot to show the action of holding a spray bottle and spraying the pesticide all over the dog. Next, use a low-angle close-up lens to capture the movement of ticks falling from the dog onto the grass. Finally, switch to an eye-level medium shot to show the full view of the recovered dog standing on the lawn. The overall camera movement is smooth and steady, focusing on the core subject of the frame.
[Lighting]: Soft natural diffused outdoor daylight is used throughout the whole process. The light is even and sufficient, clearly restoring the natural texture of the dog's fur and the detailed texture of the ticks. The lighting in the second half of the footage is bright and clear, highlighting the healthy and happy state of the dog.
[Character]: No on-screen human characters, only part of a human hand operating the spray bottle is visible.

[Shots]
Shot 1:
  - Duration: 0.0sec - 3.0sec
  - Scene Type: Highlight the pain point problem
  - Scene: A dog lying on the grass, with its face, ears, forehead and the skin of its front limbs densely covered with swollen ticks. The dog is listless, its head resting weakly on its front paws lying on the ground, with tired and dull eyes, keeping completely still. The background is the outdoor ground mixed with green grass and dry grass. The camera slowly moves forward to further magnify the dense distribution details of ticks on the dog's face, enhancing the visual impact.
  - Subject: อย่าปล่อยให้เห็บหมัดรุมกัดหมาคุณจนเปื่อย
Shot 2:
  - Duration: 3.0sec - 5.0sec
  - Scene Type: Demonstrate the usage method
  - Scene: The camera pulls back from the close-up of ticks on the dog's head to a medium shot. A hand reaches in from the right side of the frame, holding a white spray bottle printed with cat and dog patterns, and sprays the anti-parasite pesticide evenly all over the dog lying on the ground. The dog still stays in place without moving. The camera pulls back at a constant speed, fully revealing the whole body of the dog and the action of holding the spray.
  - Subject: ชีดปุ๊บ ร่วงปั๊บ ตายเรียบใน 10 ปี
Shot 3:
  - Duration: 5.0sec - 7.0sec
  - Scene Type: Product effectiveness demonstration
  - Scene: The camera switches to a low-angle close-up of the grass under the dog. A large number of ticks instantly fall off the dog after contacting the pesticide, and drop one after another onto the dirt ground covered with fine grass. The fallen ticks scatter between the dry grass and green grass, stop moving on the ground. The outline of the dog's limbs is still visible at the top of the frame. The camera keeps a fixed low angle, clearly capturing the dynamic process of the ticks falling collectively.
  - Subject: สเปร้ย์กำจัดเห็บหมัดสู่เรียร์
Shot 4:
  - Duration: 7.0sec - 10.0sec
  - Scene Type: Limited-time offer
  - Scene: The scene switches to the flat green lawn in the backyard. The dog that was once covered in ticks now has clean and fluffy fur, with no ticks left on its whole body. The dog stands energetically on the lawn, mouth open showing its tongue, tail curling up and wagging happily, eyes bright and cheerful. Then the white spray bottle printed with the brand logo enters the frame from the right side and is placed next to the dog. A striking red promotional text label pops up on the screen at the same time. The camera keeps a fixed eye-level position, fully presenting the full view of the standing dog and the product display next to it.
  - Subject: สั่งเลยวันนี้
[Background Sound]:
- No background music, the only auditory core is a fast, urgent, threatening pure voice-over advertising copy. The voice content emphasizes the harm ticks pose to pets and the highly effective killing power of the anti-parasite spray. The overall rhythm is tight, and the sense of urgency for sales promotion is created through the tone and intonation of the voice.
[Transition / Editing]:
- Adopt smooth scene jump editing. Transition naturally from the close-up shot of the sick dog to the operation shot of spraying the pesticide. Then use match cut to connect the ground shot of ticks falling off. Finally jump to the bright scene of the healthy dog. The sharp contrast between the before and after states intuitively conveys the product efficacy. The overall editing rhythm is tight and smooth, enhancing the sales promotion effect.
prompt_zh:
[Style]: 宠物产品写实带货风，画面细节表现力极强，前后强烈的状态反差营造出直观的产品效果冲击感，整体风格通俗接地气，符合本土短视频带货的视觉调性。
[Environment]: 户外私家庭院的草坪区域，地面铺有混生细草与干茅草的自然地表，背景环绕茂密的绿色灌木丛、阔叶乔木与户外盆栽，光线充足自然，是白天阳光柔和的户外花园场景。
[Tone & Pacing]: 开篇节奏舒缓压抑，聚焦狗狗被蜱虫侵扰的虚弱状态，随后节奏陡然加快，配合蜱虫快速脱落的画面形成强视觉冲击，后半段转为轻松明快，展示狗狗恢复健康后的愉悦状态，整体叙事节奏张弛有度，带货感强烈。
[Camera]: 采用微距特写镜头近距离拍摄蜱虫布满狗狗头部的细节，随后切换中景镜头展示手持喷壶给狗狗全身喷洒药剂的动作，再使用低角度近景镜头捕捉蜱虫从狗狗身上掉落到草地上的动态，最后切换平视中景镜头展示恢复健康的狗狗站在草坪上的全貌，运镜整体平稳顺滑，聚焦核心画面主体。
[Lighting]: 全程使用白天户外柔和的自然散射光，光线均匀充足，清晰还原狗狗毛发的自然纹理与蜱虫的细节质感，后半段画面光线明亮通透，烘托出狗狗健康愉悦的状态。
[Character]: 无出镜人物，仅可见一只操作喷壶的人手部分出镜。

[Shots]
Shot 1:
  - 时长: 0.0sec - 3.0sec
  - 镜头类型: 点明痛点问题
  - 画面: 一只趴在草地上的狗狗，脸部、耳朵、额头及前肢皮肤上密密麻麻爬满了鼓胀的蜱虫，狗狗精神萎靡，脑袋无力地枕在趴在地面的前爪上，眼神倦怠无神，全程保持静止，背景是混生绿草与枯草的户外地面，镜头缓慢向前推进，进一步放大狗狗面部蜱虫分布的密集细节，强化视觉冲击力。
  - 口播: อย่าปล่อยให้เห็บหมัดรุมกัดหมาคุณจนเปื่อย
Shot 2:
  - 时长: 3.0sec - 5.0sec
  - 镜头类型: 演示使用方法
  - 画面: 镜头从狗狗头部蜱虫特写拉远至中景，一只手从画面右侧伸入，握持着印有猫咪和狗狗图案的白色喷雾瓶，对准趴在地上的狗狗全身均匀喷洒驱虫药剂，狗狗依旧趴在原地没有动弹，镜头匀速后拉，完整露出狗狗的全身与手持喷雾的动作。
  - 口播: ชีดปุ๊บ ร่วงปั๊บ ตายเรียบใน 10 ปี
Shot 3:
  - 时长: 5.0sec - 7.0sec
  - 镜头类型: 产品有效性
  - 画面: 镜头切换至狗狗身下的草地低角度近景，大量蜱虫在接触药剂后瞬间从狗狗身上脱落，接连掉落在长有细草的泥土地面上，滚落的蜱虫散落在枯草与绿草之间，静止在地面不再动弹，画面上缘还能看到狗狗的四肢轮廓，镜头保持固定低角度，清晰捕捉蜱虫集体坠落的动态过程。
  - 口播: สเปร้ย์กำจัดเห็บหมัดสู่เรียร์
Shot 4:
  - 时长: 7.0sec - 10.0sec
  - 镜头类型: 限时优惠
  - 画面: 场景切换到庭院的平整绿草坪上，之前满身蜱虫的狗狗此刻毛发干净蓬松，通体不再有蜱虫踪迹，狗狗精神饱满地站立在草坪上，嘴巴张开露出舌头，尾巴欢快向上卷曲摆动，眼神明亮愉悦，随后印有品牌标识的白色喷雾瓶从画面右侧入镜摆在狗狗身旁，画面同步弹出醒目的红色促销文字标签，镜头保持平视固定机位，完整呈现狗狗站立的全貌与身旁的产品展示画面。
  - 口播: สั่งเลยวันนี้
[Background Sound]:
- 无背景音乐，仅以快速、紧迫、带有威胁感的纯语音广告文案作为听觉核心，语音内容强调蜱虫对宠物的危害与驱虫喷雾的高效杀灭效果，整体节奏紧凑，靠语音语调营造带货紧迫感。
[Transition / Editing]:
- 采用流畅的场景跳转剪辑，从狗狗患病的特写画面自然过渡到喷洒药剂的操作画面，随后通过匹配剪辑衔接蜱虫脱落的地面镜头，最后跳转到健康狗狗的明亮场景，前后状态反差强烈，直观传递产品功效，整体剪辑节奏紧凑流畅，强化带货宣传效果。

title: โคมไฟกลางคืนข้างเตียงพร้อมโปรเจคเตอร์ สร้างบรรยากาศคริสต์มาส เ — Lifestyle Scene (Thailand · Phones & Electronics)
creator: @renira_kids
hook_line: Dim warm kids' bedroom, little girl sits on carpet looking up at wall, projector casts sea starry sky light
prompt_en:
[Style]: Dreamy, heartwarming parent-child realistic style, with softened highlights, vibrant colors, and delicate, lifelike projected light and shadow effects that build an immersive underwater starry sky fairy-tale atmosphere.
[Environment]: A dim, cozy children's bedroom with a soft off-white plush carpet covering the floor. On the left sits a child's bed dressed in light pink bedding, warm yellow string lights decorating the curtains beside the bed. A white starry ocean projector rests on the small round wooden table at the center, and plush toys and warm-glow night lights are arranged on the storage cabinet in the corner. The entire space is a typical rest area for children before bedtime.
[Tone & Pacing]: The overall rhythm is slow and smooth, showcasing the dreamy changes of the projection effect with slow dynamics. The mood transitions gradually from the child's curiosity and surprise to deep immersion and relaxation, conveying a warm, comforting pre-bedtime atmosphere.
[Camera]: Starts with a fixed full wide shot that displays the complete bedroom scene, then zooms in to focus on the fine details of the projection, cuts to a close-up of the child's face to capture their subtle expressions, and finally pulls back to a full wide shot to end the sequence. The camera movement stays steady and gentle throughout, emphasizing the immersive quality of the footage.
[Lighting]: The base layer is dim ambient light, with only the warm yellow soft glow from the desk lamp on the table serving as basic illumination. The core light source is the bright, multi-colored underwater starry sky light and shadow projected by the projector, in shades of blue, purple, green, and orange. The dynamic light and shadow are cast onto the walls and the child's face, forming a gorgeous, soft halo effect that creates layered, dreamy visual depth.
[Character]: A 3-5 year old East Asian preschool girl with fair, delicate skin that carries a natural pinkish tint, a round face paired with big, bright watery eyes, neat black bangs, and long, smooth jet-black hair falling naturally down her back. She has soft pink lips, no makeup, a small, gentle build, and wears light pink flannel long-sleeve loungewear. With an innocent, endearing demeanor, she sits cross-legged on the carpet looking up at the projection, full of curiosity and wonder.

[Shots]
Shot 1:
  - Duration: 0.0sec - 2.5sec
  - Scene Type: Scene-based lifestyle showcase
  - Scene: A full wide shot of a dim, cozy children's bedroom. The little girl in light pink loungewear sits cross-legged on the plush carpet, looking up intently at the wall. The white starry ocean projector on the table is casting a brilliant underwater starry sky light and shadow that covers the entire wall. In the frame, blue dolphins, sea turtles, colorful clownfish, and purple jellyfish swim slowly through a space surrounded by vibrant corals and starlight. The string lights, warm desk lamp, and plush toys next to the wall together set off a warm pre-bedtime atmosphere. The little girl's hands are gently folded in front of her legs, her eyes full of curiosity.
  - Subject: เจ้านับล้านที่เลยอยู่บนทรง
Shot 2:
  - Duration: 2.5sec - 4.0sec
  - Scene Type: Product close-up shot
  - Scene: The camera zooms in to focus on the projected image on the wall, clearly showing the subtle movements of the sea turtle flapping its flippers, the jellyfish stretching its tentacles, and the clownfish weaving through the corals. Star-shaped light spots and transparent bubbles float slowly against the deep blue background, and the colored light projected by the projector forms a gradient rainbow beam at the bottom of the frame.
  - Subject: เธอคุณความต้องกัน
Shot 3:
  - Duration: 4.0sec - 5.0sec
  - Scene Type: Emotional connection
  - Scene: The camera cuts to a close-up of the little girl's face. The multi-colored dynamic projected light and shadow flows slowly across her cheeks and around her eyes, casting soft, alternating light spots of blue, yellow, and pink. The little girl slightly opens her mouth, her eyes sparkling, full of a surprised expression.
Shot 4:
  - Duration: 5.0sec - 7.5sec
  - Scene Type: Scene-based lifestyle showcase
  - Scene: The camera pulls back to the full wide shot of the bedroom, and the dynamic effect of the underwater starry sky projection is fully presented once more. Dolphins, sea turtles, and jellyfish keep swimming slowly across the wall, with the light and shadow constantly shifting. The little girl remains sitting cross-legged in her original spot, looking up and fully immersed in this dreamy underwater starry sky world, before the frame gradually transitions to complete black.
  - Subject: ที่ล้อยอยู่ไง ชั้น
[Background Sound]:
- A soft, lyrical pop ballad performed by a female vocalist, with a gentle melody and slow rhythm, primarily accompanied by piano and string instruments. It creates a dreamy, tranquil, slightly poetic atmosphere at a moderate volume, with emotions building gradually and fading out at the end, perfectly matching the warm, comforting scene of a child before bedtime.
[Transition / Editing]:
- Uses natural, smooth zoom pushes and pulls to complete the shift from wide shot to close-up and back to wide shot, and ends with a fade to black effect. The editing rhythm stays slow throughout, reinforcing the dreamy, comforting atmosphere.
prompt_zh:
[Style]: 梦幻治愈亲子写实风，高光柔化色彩绚烂，投影光影效果细腻逼真，打造沉浸式海底星空童话氛围。
[Environment]: 昏暗温馨的儿童卧室，地面铺着柔软的米白色毛绒地毯，左侧有铺浅粉色床品的儿童床，床边窗帘装饰暖黄色串灯，中央小圆木桌上放置白色星空海洋投影仪，墙角收纳柜摆放毛绒玩具和暖光小夜灯，整体是典型的儿童睡前休憩空间。
[Tone & Pacing]: 整体节奏舒缓流畅，以缓慢的动态展示投影效果的梦幻变化，情绪从孩童的好奇惊喜逐渐过渡到沉浸放松，传递出温馨治愈的睡前氛围。
[Camera]: 以固定全景镜头开篇展示完整卧室场景，随后变焦放大聚焦投影画面细节，再切换到孩童脸部特写捕捉细腻神情，最后拉回全景收尾，全程运镜平稳舒缓，突出画面的沉浸感。
[Lighting]: 整体以昏暗的环境光为基底，仅保留桌面台灯的暖黄色柔光作为基础照明，核心光源为投影仪投射出的蓝、紫、绿、橙多色璀璨海底星空光影，动态光影投射在墙面和孩童脸上，形成绚烂柔和的光晕效果，营造出梦幻的视觉层次。
[Character]: 3-5岁东亚学龄前女童，肌肤白皙细腻透着自然粉嫩感，圆圆脸庞搭配水汪汪的明亮大眼睛，留着齐整黑色刘海，乌黑顺直长发自然垂落，唇色粉嫩，纯素颜，身形娇小柔和，身着浅粉色法兰绒长袖家居服，气质天真软萌，盘腿坐在地毯上仰头望投影，满是好奇惊喜。

[Shots]
Shot 1:
  - 时长: 0.0sec - 2.5sec
  - 镜头类型: 场景化生活秀
  - 画面: 昏暗温馨的儿童卧室全景画面，身穿浅粉色家居服的小女孩盘腿坐在毛绒地毯上，仰头专注望向墙面，桌面上的白色星空海洋投影仪正投射出铺满整面墙面的璀璨海底星空光影，画面里蓝色海豚、海龟、彩色小丑鱼、紫色水母在缤纷珊瑚与星光环绕的空间里缓缓游动，墙面旁的串灯、暖光台灯、毛绒玩具共同烘托出温馨的睡前氛围，小女孩的双手轻轻交叠放在腿前，眼神里满是好奇。
  - 口播: เจ้านับล้านที่เลยอยู่บนทรง
Shot 2:
  - 时长: 2.5sec - 4.0sec
  - 镜头类型: 产品镜头特写
  - 画面: 镜头变焦放大，聚焦墙面的投影画面，清晰展示海龟摆动着鳍、水母舒展触须、小丑鱼穿梭在珊瑚间的细腻动态，星星光斑、透明气泡在深蓝的背景里缓缓浮动，投影仪投射出的彩色光线在画面下方呈现出渐变的彩虹光束。
  - 口播: เธอคุณความต้องกัน
Shot 3:
  - 时长: 4.0sec - 5.0sec
  - 镜头类型: 情感连接
  - 画面: 镜头切换到小女孩的脸部特写，多色动态投影光影在她的脸颊与眼部缓缓流动，映出蓝、黄、粉交替变换的柔和光斑，小女孩微微张嘴，眼神亮晶晶的，满是惊喜的神情。
Shot 4:
  - 时长: 5.0sec - 7.5sec
  - 镜头类型: 场景化生活秀
  - 画面: 镜头拉回卧室全景画面，海底星空投影的动态效果再次完整呈现，海豚、海龟、水母在墙面上持续缓缓游动，光影不断变化，小女孩依旧盘腿坐在原地，仰头沉浸在这片梦幻的海底星空世界中，最后画面逐渐过渡到全黑。
  - 口播: ที่ล้อยอยู่ไง ชั้น
[Background Sound]:
- 柔和抒情的流行抒情女声歌曲，旋律轻柔、节奏舒缓，以钢琴和弦乐为主伴奏，营造出梦幻、宁静、略带诗意的氛围，音量适中，情绪层层递进，结尾渐弱，契合儿童睡前的温馨治愈场景。
[Transition / Editing]:
- 采用自然流畅的变焦推拉完成全景到特写再回全景的画面转换，最后以渐隐入黑的效果收尾，全程剪辑节奏舒缓，强化梦幻治愈的氛围感。

title: โคมไฟกลางคืนข้างเตียงพร้อมโปรเจคเตอร์ สร้างบรรยากาศคริสต์มาส เ — Lifestyle Scene (Thailand · Phones & Electronics)
creator: @nate____12
hook_line: On a light wooden table, a pair of hands lifts the lid and takes out the projector lamp
prompt_en:
[Style]: Warm and healing e-commerce display style, with warm light soft focus texture, delicate and full frames, full of childlike atmosphere.
[Environment]: A warmly decorated children's bedroom, with light wood furniture and soft furnishings indoors. Dim warm night lights in the background enhance the relaxed home vibe, paired with a soft children's bed, plush dolls and childlike wall art decorations.
[Tone & Pacing]: A slow, healing display rhythm, smoothly transitioning from the unboxing action to turning on the projector, gradually switching between different projection frames. The overall pace is relaxed and soothing, fully showcasing the dreamy childlike experience created by the product.
[Camera]: Use close-up shots to focus on product unboxing and body details, then switch to a wide-angle panoramic shot to capture the full projection effect across the entire bedroom, and finally return to a close-up of the product. The camera movement is smooth and steady throughout.
[Lighting]: At the opening, dim warm yellow indoor low light creates a warm home feeling. After the product is started, the colorful dreamy light and shadow projected by the device covers the walls and ceiling, with soft and gorgeous light and shadow colors. The overall light has rich layers and a healing quality.
[Character]: Only the hands of an adult Asian male appear on screen, with tight and delicate skin, performing gentle, smooth actions to unbox the product, take out the device, and press the power button with precise, fluid movements. Later, a 6-8 year old Asian boy appears, with short hair, wearing light-colored home short sleeves, looking curious and excited with lively, agile movements.

[Shots]
Shot 1:
  - Duration: 0.0sec - 2.5sec
  - Scene Type: Unboxing
  - Scene: On a home tabletop with a light wood surface, a white packaging box printed with product patterns is placed. A pair of hands lifts and removes the box lid, revealing the off-white projection lamp inside the box. Then the hands take out the projection lamp with a rounded shape and three-legged base from the box, and place it steadily on the wooden tabletop. The camera stays fixed, focusing on the product on the table with no obvious movement.
  - Subject: *Honk*
Shot 2:
  - Duration: 2.5sec - 4.5sec
  - Scene Type: Ease of use demonstration
  - Scene: The camera shows a front close-up of the projection lamp. A finger gently presses the blue power button in the middle of the device, and the top of the device instantly lights up with soft warm yellow light, while emitting colorful beam effects. creator: @pacharaphon_praewa
hook_line: Clearance non-slip soft slippers only 9 baht, the best deal in the world
pain_point: Ordinary slippers are non-slip and not soft
prompt_en:
[Style]: Realistic e-commerce product sales style, with clean and sharp visuals that prioritize highlighting the product. Colors are bright with high saturation, and the full visual focus is entirely on showcasing the slippers.
[Environment]: A well-lit warehouse space during daytime, with natural sunlight pouring in through indoor windows. Multiple open cardboard boxes are scattered on the floor, stacked with the same white-and-blue colorway slippers inside. A large number of sealed brown shipping boxes are piled in the background, and a yellow handwritten promotional price sign is placed at the bottom of the frame.
[Tone & Pacing]: High-energy sales rhythm with smooth, tight shot transitions and crisp, neat hand movements. The entire sequence showcases every detail of the slippers from different dimensions one by one, with a well-balanced pace that allows viewers to clearly catch all the product selling points.
[Camera]: First-person close-up perspective throughout, using a fixed camera position that follows the rotating motion of the hand holding the slipper to capture footage synchronously, with no unnecessary shaking. It precisely focuses on every display surface of the slipper, including its exterior, interior, and sole.
[Lighting]: Ample natural daylight shines in from the side, bright and soft, creating natural light and shadow gradients on the surfaces of the slippers and cardboard boxes. It clearly outlines the slippers' contours and detailed textures without harsh shadows, making the entire frame look bright, clean, and crisp.
[Character]: A 20-30 year old Asian male, only his hands are visible. His hand skin is clean, delicate, and free of obvious blemishes, with sharp, capable movements full of the energy of a live-stream sales host. He holds the slipper with one hand to flip it at multiple angles, and uses both hands to press the slipper to demonstrate its elasticity.

[Shots]
Shot 1:
  - Duration: 0.0sec - 1.5sec
  - Scene Type: Handheld product display
  - Scene: One hand holds a pair of white-and-blue slippers, facing the camera directly to show the slippers' exterior shape. The yellow Thai price tag under the slippers is clearly visible, the cardboard boxes and other identical slippers in the background are neatly arranged, and the blue-and-white color-blocked shoe body as well as the brand logo on the shoe upper are clearly presented.
  - Subject: รถล้างสต็อค ลองเท้าแตะกันลื่น นุ่มใส่ด้วย
Shot 2:
  - Duration: 1.5sec - 3.5sec
  - Scene Type: Product design highlights
  - Scene: The hand slowly rotates the slipper, flipping it in sequence to show the side profile, thick sole shape, and the brand text printed on the side of the sole. The movements are smooth and continuous, fully displaying the three-dimensional silhouette of the slipper, with the blue line decorations on the side and the detailed thickened sole design completely presented.
  - Subject: แค่ 9 บาทคุ้มที่สุดใน 3 โลก
Shot 3:
  - Duration: 3.5sec - 5.5sec
  - Scene Type: Ease of use demonstration
  - Scene: The other hand extends in from the right side of the frame. Both hands pinch the inner insole area of each slipper respectively, applying gentle inward pressure at the same time to intuitively demonstrate the soft resilience of the slipper's inner material. The brand text on the insole deforms slightly along with the pressing motion, clearly showing the slipper's soft, non-irritating-to-feet feature.
  - Subject: กดดวนก่อนโปรกับราคา
Shot 4:
  - Duration: 5.5sec - 7.5sec
  - Scene Type: Product material display
  - Scene: The hand flips the slipper again, turning the white rubber sole of the slipper fully toward the camera to clearly show the detailed anti-slip tread design on the sole. Then it gently tilts the slipper to show the thickness of the sole. The tread outline and embossed brand logo on the slipper sole are clearly presented, intuitively reflecting the slipper's anti-slip and wear-resistant properties.
  - Subject: ทาดิวันกัน
Shot 5:
  - Duration: 7.5sec - 10.0sec
  - Scene Type: Great value price
  - Scene: The hand repositions the slipper to face the camera directly and holds it in a display pose. The yellow promotional price sign at the bottom of the frame is fully in view, and the piles of slipper stock and shipping boxes in the background create a strong clearance sale atmosphere. The slipper finally freezes in a front-facing display pose at the center of the frame, highlighting the high cost-performance clearance promotion information.
[Background Sound]:
- Extremely upbeat TikTok-style background music with a fast tempo, strong drum beats, and relatively high volume, featuring electronic synthesizers and vocal samples. It is a trending e-commerce traffic-driving music style that creates a sense of promotional urgency and high cost-performance, paired with promotional voiceover to amplify viewers' impulse to place orders.
[Transition / Editing]:
- Smooth motion-following transition editing, where every shot transition naturally connects to the hand's motion of rotating the slipper. There are no abrupt jump cuts throughout, maintaining a consistent and smooth visual rhythm, accented by scattered twinkling starlight effects at the edges of the frame to enhance the lively atmosphere of the sales video.

[Environment]: Open-air street market during daytime, clear sunny weather with blue skies and white clouds, filled with colorful vendor tents and crowds of shoppers coming and going, rough gravel asphalt pavement, a vintage off-white pickup truck loaded with crocs parked in the background, full of everyday life charm.
[Tone & Pacing]: High-energy, enthusiastic sales style with a tight, fast pace, the host's consistently high-spirited energy drives the visual tension, overall rhythm is snappy and crisp, perfectly matching the dissemination tone of local Thai street promotion short videos.
[Camera]: Entirely shot from a down-to-earth handheld follow-shooting perspective, the camera moves naturally with the host's actions, with occasional slight shakes to restore the authentic market filming texture, no deliberate polished camera movements.
[Lighting]: Abundant daytime natural light pours down from the upper diagonal direction, bright and even illumination, no additional artificial fill light needed, naturally presents clear details of the market scene and the crocs, creating the lively atmosphere of a daytime open-air market.
[Character]: 30-35 year old Southeast Asian Thai ethnic male, healthy wheat-toned skin, distinct and relaxed facial features, no makeup, average well-proportioned build; wearing a grey-blue casual Polo shirt paired with blue long trousers and black casual leather shoes, passionate, bold and highly infectious temperament, large range of movements and high emotional excitement, fully showing the state of dedicated hard-selling.

prompt_en:

[Lighting]: Ample bright daytime natural light pours down from the upper side, casting a clear, soft moving shadow of the mascot on the asphalt road. The overall lighting of the frame is even and transparent, with bright and vivid colors.

The sock body forms the torso, paired with anthropomorphic arms, legs and feet in a well-proportioned, cute design. The full body is styled as a white football sock printed with the black brand logo 'FS FOOTBALL SOCKS', and the feet wear white non-slip sock sole shoes printed with the same logo. The camera follows forward at a constant speed, keeping the mascot always in the center of the frame.

[Camera]: Entirely shot from a first-person handheld perspective, framing the shot starting from the position of the hand holding the tank top, paired with slow pushing-in close-up shots and slightly pulling-out wide shots, no unnecessary large camera shakes, the footage stays stable and sharp to keep the clothing as the clear focal point.
[Lighting]: Even, bright top-down supermarket lighting, soft light with no harsh distinct shadows, fully illuminating the fabric details of the white tank top, accurately reproducing the clothing's true color and soft texture.
[Character]: Only the hand of a 20-30 year old East Asian man is visible, with clean, smooth, fine-textured skin, no face or full body appears on camera; movements are quick and natural, full of the sincere vibe of sharing a great find, the palm naturally supports the side of the white tank top, fingers gently pinch, grasp, knead and shake the fabric with soft motions, focusing on demonstrating the tank top's elasticity and softness.

- Upbeat TikTok-style background music with a lively, brisk tempo of around 120-130 BPM, moderately high volume, a pop rhythm driven by electronic synthesizers and drum beats, classified as a fast-paced promotional BGM with a simple, repetitive, catchy melody that creates the sense of urgency and excitement of a limited-time flash sale and great value offers, perfectly suited for promoting affordable discounted products.

prompt_en:
[Style]: A realistic factory-live product sales style, with bright, high-saturation colors in the frame. The toy racing cars have vivid, prominent colors, the characters are full of enthusiastic energy, and the scene is filled with the authentic appeal of Southeast Asian street-style live product sales.
[Environment]: A bright, spacious modern toy production workshop with a white industrial ceiling fitted with long rows of LED lights, casting even light across the entire space. Multiple assembly lines extend neatly, with workers in blue work uniforms and blue dust caps arranged on both sides, alongside stacked corrugated cardboard boxes filled with toy racing cars. The environment is clean and orderly.
[Tone & Pacing]: An authentic Southeast Asian short-video product sales style, with the host speaking in an enthusiastic, high-pitched tone full of eagerness to share. The overall pace is tight and lively, with visual information unfolding layer by layer, starting from a full panoramic view of the toy array on the production line, then naturally transitioning to close-ups that highlight the core selling points of the boxed products, holding the audience's full attention throughout.
[Camera]: The opening uses a fixed-position panoramic shot that fully captures the impressive scene of the crisscrossing assembly lines, the full view of toy racing cars, and the workers in the background. The camera then performs a smooth, natural push-in to focus on the host in the foreground. Midway through, the shot seamlessly switches to a medium close-up that carefully captures the details of the neatly arranged toy racing cars inside the storage box held by the host. The camera stays completely stable with no unnecessary shaking the entire time.
[Lighting]: Standard industrial LED shadowless lighting that covers the entire workshop, providing ample, even light with no harsh shadows. It clearly illuminates the bright paintwork on every row of toy racing cars on the assembly line, and also sharply renders the host's facial expressions and the printed labels on the storage box. The entire frame is bright and clear, with extremely high color accuracy.
[Character]: A 25-30 year old East Asian woman with a healthy wheat-colored complexion, a firm and energetic look, soft and relaxed facial features, curved eyes full of approachability, a natural no-makeup makeup look, and a fit, healthy build. She wears a bright blue work polo shirt printed with the white text 'MODEL' and a blue dust cap. Her temperament is warm, bright, down-to-earth and sincere, with a bright smile the entire time and neat, generous movements.

[Shots]

  - Scene Type: Promotional selling point highlight

Dense, brightly colored mini toy racing cars are arranged neatly on the green conveyor belt that runs the full length of the frame, moving slowly and steadily forward along the belt. A large white sign printed with Thai promotional text hangs high above the scene. In the foreground, the female host in a blue work uniform steadily holds up a large-capacity green-and-white toy storage box, wearing a bright smile, and naturally raises her hand to point toward the conveyor belt area as she explains. On both sides of the background, workers are focused on assembling toys with their heads down, and 5 product service icons are arranged in a row at the bottom of the frame.

The female host steadily holds the transparent storage box, which is filled with 30 toy racing cars of different styles and bright paint jobs, directly in front of the camera. She then extends her right hand to point at the toy racing cars inside the storage box, clearly showing the printed 'MODEL' brand logo and related pattern details on the front of the storage box. In the background, the workshop workers are still working orderly at their respective stations, and the assembly line is operating normally.
