title: เสื้อกั๊กผ้าลูกไม้เข้ารูปสำหรับผู้หญิงคุณภาพสูง เหมาะสำหรับฤดู — Handheld Demo (Thailand · Womenswear & Underwear)
creator: @newy2024
hook_line: Look at this lace camisole, it's so beautiful
pain_point: Can't find nice and comfortable summer lace camisole
prompt_en:
[Style]: A daily-life realistic short video for home goods sharing, with soft and warm color tones, natural and delicate texture presentation of skin and clothing, full of approachability and a sense of personal sharing.
[Environment]: A well-lit exquisite home makeup room, with a light brown wall with louver design visible in the background, a white dressing table with makeup brushes placed on it next to the wall, fresh green potted plants and minimalist white ceramic flower pots arranged in the corner. The overall environment is clean and tidy, with a warm and cozy atmosphere.
[Tone & Pacing]: Authentic Douyin UGC product sharing style, with a friendly, enthusiastic and infectious tone, brisk and natural pace. Every action is precisely aimed at showing the advantages of the clothing, and the camera switches smoothly and seamlessly.
[Camera]: Mainly uses a fixed front eye-level camera position, paired with a small forward push-in camera movement. The lens always focuses on the model's upper body and the displayed clothing, the picture is stable, clear and free of unnecessary shaking.
[Lighting]: Soft and even indoor diffused light pours down from the front, evenly illuminating the character's face and clothing, with no harsh shadows, perfectly highlighting the delicate texture of the white lace camisole and the model's bright, glowing skin.
[Character]: A 25-30 year old East Asian woman, with delicate, translucent skin with natural healthy glow, a soft oval face paired with dark brown natural long wavy hair, relaxed eyebrows and eyes, a sheer no-makeup makeup look, a well-proportioned and graceful figure. She wears a white sleeveless lace camisole with delicate lace trim paired with simple black bottoms, layered with multiple thin gold necklaces, with a sweet and friendly temperament, and a bright, healing smile throughout the whole process.

[Shots]
Shot 1:
  - Duration: 0.0sec - 2.5sec
  - Scene Type: Handheld product display
  - Scene: In the home makeup room scene, the model holds the transparent packaging bag containing the white lace camisole with both hands, showing a bright smile to the camera, then gently presents the packaging bag towards the camera before tucking it to her side, lifts one hand to gently stroke the same style lace camisole she is wearing on her chest, with the Thai subtitle 'เสื้อกล้ามผ้าลูกไม้' displayed at the bottom of the screen at the same time.
  - Subject: ดูนี่ เสื้อกลามผ้าลูกหมายตัวนี้คือน่าลักมาก
Shot 2:
  - Duration: 2.5sec - 5.5sec
  - Scene Type: Product material display
  - Scene: The model moves her hand from her chest to the side of the garment, pinches the side fabric of the white lace camisole with her fingers, gently pulls it outward then releases it, showing the soft, skin-friendly texture and natural draping state of the fabric, still maintaining a friendly smile on her face.
  - Subject: ผ้าดีไม่ร้อน ใส่เดียวๆ หรือใส่ข้างในก็ละมุล
Shot 3:
  - Duration: 5.5sec - 8.5sec
  - Scene Type: Full size adaptability effect
  - Scene: The camera moves forward slightly, the model gently raises her left hand to make a pinching emphasis gesture, then uses both hands to pinch the two side edges of the camisole hem, gently pulls the garment to both sides, intuitively demonstrating the excellent elasticity and loose, inclusive fit of the clothing.
  - Subject: ต่อใจไม่ถึง 50 บาทใส่ได้ถึง 2XL กดสั่งในความ
Shot 4:
  - Duration: 8.5sec - 10.0sec
  - Scene Type: Order process guidance
  - Scene: The model releases her hands that were pulling the hem of the garment, lifts her right hand then extends her index finger to point at the lower part of the screen, keeps a sweet smile to the camera, making a guiding gesture to lead users to place an order.
  - Subject: เธอตาคาลิน่ะ
[Background Sound]:
- Very upbeat TikTok-style background music, with a brisk and lively rhythm, moderately high volume, and electronic pop elements. The melody is catchy and rhythmic, perfect for short product promotion videos targeting young female audiences, creating an atmosphere of 'great value items + easy product recommendation'. The song style is similar to 'sweet and cool girl style', ideal for quickly grabbing attention and driving purchase conversions.
[Transition / Editing]:
- Uses natural action-matching editing, relying on the model's body movements to complete smooth transitions between different display shots, no harsh jump cuts, maintaining a consistent sharing rhythm throughout.

hook_line: Do you know the worst feeling? Mexican waitresses, eat rice, double shifts... standing all day, I use compression socks
pain_point: Long-term standing causes leg strain and pain
prompt_en:
[Style]: Urban realistic comic art style, with sharp character lines and bold, saturated colors. Semi-transparent visual effects are applied to the legs to display blood vessels, bones, and changes in physical state, combining exaggerated visual expressiveness with relatable real-life pain points.
[Environment]: The entire story takes place around a long-established American-style restaurant in Dallas, covering the restaurant's daytime dining area, back-of-house prep counter, staff locker room, and the protagonist's bedroom and living room at home. The lighting transitions gradually from the restaurant's bright fluorescent lights, to the warm yellow floor lamps at home, to natural dusk sunset light.
[Tone & Pacing]: The overall rhythm starts slow then picks up. The opening uses a dragging, heavy walking pace to build the sense of pain from long-term leg strain. The middle section advances the story's turning point at a gentle pace. In the later part, the rhythm becomes gradually brisk as the character's physical state recovers, finally landing on a warm, healing sharing tone with layered, progressive emotions.
[Camera]: Primarily uses the protagonist's first-person experiential perspective, with a large number of close-up shots of the character's legs to directly showcase the semi-transparent leg effect details, paired with a small number of wide shots to establish the scene environment. The camera moves slowly following the protagonist's staggering steps, and the camera movement becomes smooth and natural in the later part as the protagonist's condition improves.
[Lighting]: The opening restaurant scene uses cool-toned fluorescent top light to highlight the tiring, oppressive work atmosphere. The home scene uses warm yellow diffused soft light to create a sense of exhausted, weary domestic life. After the story's turning point, the light gradually becomes bright and soft, and the final dusk scene uses side backlight to outline the character's silhouette, enhancing the warm, healing atmosphere.
[Character]: 41-year-old Latina female protagonist Mariana, initially with flushed, tired-looking face, dull skin, high ponytail, wearing the restaurant's yellow shirt, red apron, and black work shoes, weighed down by exhaustion and life's pressures. 61-year-old East Asian elderly woman Shang, with silver hair in a neat bun, wearing a black uniform, calm and composed. 8-year-old Latina little girl, with fair pink skin, wearing a white top and blue suspender skirt, innocent and lively.

She staggers over to the restaurant front desk, while two Asian female servers in white shirts and black aprons walk past her easily, showing no signs of fatigue. Then Mariana laboriously lowers herself to sit on the sofa by the table, raises her hand with difficulty to pull on her white compression socks, her face full of pain. title: 26 Women's Elegant Solid Color Shoulder Bag — Lifestyle Scene (United States · Luggage & Bags)

[Environment]: Urban street and indoor casual office scenes in daytime: the outdoor area is a pedestrian street paved with gray floor tiles, with small white round tables and chairs on the side, small green plants in dark gray textured flower pots, and street-facing shops with light gray stone exterior walls in the background; the indoor area is a warm-toned cafe space furnished with log round tables, black leather seats, large floor-standing green plants, with daily commuter items such as laptops and books scattered on the tabletop, and natural light pouring in through large glass windows

title: Please Purchase A Size Up. Men's Solid Casual Polo Shirt & Dra — OOTD Showcase (United States · Menswear & Underwear)
creator: @zimomo179
hook_line: Show different color polo and shorts sets, highlight fabric elasticity and fit
prompt_en:
[Style]: A realistic e-commerce outfit showcase style with clean, crisp visuals that highlight the garment's cut, fabric stretch, and wearable details, delivering a fresh, premium visual presentation.
[Environment]: A modern minimalist home bedroom scene filled with ample natural daylight. The space features a neatly arranged upholstered bed, a simple white nightstand, wall art, and metallic decorative accents, with clean, uncluttered light grey matte floor tiles and no stray objects in the bright environment.
[Tone & Pacing]: The overall pace is snappy and dynamic, perfectly synced to the beats of the background music. All movements are sharp and unhurried, with every garment demonstration action precisely aligned to the music's drum hits, creating a sharp, confident showcase atmosphere.
[Camera]: The entire sequence is shot using a fixed-position medium full shot, with the camera height level with the character's chest. The frame fully captures the full-body look from the character's head to ankles, remaining completely stable with no unnecessary camera shake throughout.
[Lighting]: Even, soft frontal diffused indoor lighting is used. The bright, ample light eliminates harsh shadows, clearly revealing the fabric texture of the clothing while evenly illuminating the entire character, resulting in a clean, crisp, high-quality visual.
[Character]: A 28-35 year old Caucasian man with a healthy tanned, toned complexion, sharp clear tattoo lines on his neck, arms, and calves, and strong, defined facial features. He wears no makeup, has a muscular build with prominent muscle definition, and sequentially wears different colorways of the diamond-textured short-sleeve Polo shirt paired with the matching drawstring casual sportswear set. He has a calm, capable, powerful demeanor, moves fluidly to showcase clothing details, and maintains a cool, steady expression.

[Shots]
Shot 1:
  - Duration: 0.0sec - 1.0sec
  - Scene Type: Outfit styling demonstration
  - Scene: A muscular man standing in the bedroom, wearing a black diamond-textured short-sleeve Polo shirt and matching casual shorts. He grips both sides of the T-shirt hem with each hand, gently pulls outward then releases to demonstrate the excellent fabric stretch and the loose, non-restrictive comfortable cut of the top. He then smoothly presses both hands to his abdomen to smooth out wrinkles on the shirt, standing tall and looking steadily toward the camera.
Shot 2:
  - Duration: 1.0sec - 2.0sec
  - Scene Type: Product material demonstration
  - Scene: The man lifts the black Polo shirt on his body upward to reveal the elastic waistband of his shorts at his waist, then naturally lowers the hem back into place, fully demonstrating that the length of the top perfectly covers the waistband, clearly showing the coordinated proportion of the top and bottom of the set.
Shot 3:
  - Duration: 2.0sec - 4.0sec
  - Scene Type: Product material demonstration
  - Scene: The man holds the hem of the black Polo shirt firmly in his left hand, then pulls the side fabric of the shorts backward with his right hand, stretching it wide before releasing it quickly to intuitively showcase the outstanding stretch properties of the shorts fabric. The movement is sharp and powerful, perfectly timed to the drum beats of the background music.
Shot 4:
  - Duration: 4.0sec - 5.0sec
  - Scene Type: Show multiple style options (fashion category)
  - Scene: The scene switches seamlessly, and the man's tracksuit is simultaneously changed to the matching white version. He grips both sides of the white Polo shirt hem, pulls gently outward then releases to demonstrate that the white set also features excellent fabric stretch and a loose, comfortable cut, while he maintains an upright standing posture.
Shot 5:
  - Duration: 5.0sec - 6.0sec
  - Scene Type: Outfit styling demonstration
  - Scene: The scene switches seamlessly once more, the man is wearing the matching khaki tracksuit. He stands in a relaxed wide stance with his feet naturally apart, slips both hands into the side pockets of the shorts, and slightly shifts his body weight to showcase the practical pocket design of the shorts and the casual, laid-back wearing effect of the full outfit.
[Background Sound]:
- Highly rhythmic hip-hop/rap background music with heavy bass, dense drum beats, and a classic street style. The fast, energetic track features vocal rap verses with lyrics referencing street imagery such as 'homies' and 'prayers in the streetlight' to amplify the urban trend atmosphere. The volume is moderately high, perfectly suited for a streetwear product promotion scenario.
[Transition / Editing]:
- Seamless same-scene fast outfit change transition effects are used. The character's position and posture remain completely unchanged, only the color of the tracksuit on his body is swapped simultaneously. The transitions are perfectly timed to the strong beats of the background music, creating smooth, natural visual continuity with a tight, snappy rhythm.

[Environment]: 现代简约风居家卧室场景，日间充足的自然光铺满空间，摆放整齐的软包大床、白色简约床头柜、墙面装饰画及金属质感摆件，浅灰色哑光地砖干净整洁，环境明亮无杂物。
[Tone & Pacing]: 整体节奏明快有力，卡点契合背景音乐的节拍点，动作利落不拖沓，每一处服装展示动作都精准对应音乐鼓点，整体呈现出干练自信的展示氛围。
[Camera]: 全程采用固定机位的中全景镜头进行拍摄，镜头高度与人物胸部齐平，画面完整框住从人物头部到脚踝的全身造型，全程保持稳定无多余晃动。

title: HAPPYCODE Electric Cat Teaser Toy — Real Review (United States · Pet Supplies)
creator: @happycode_
hook_line: The cat shows no interest in old toys and looks listless
pain_point: Cats are bored and listless, uninterested in old toys
prompt_en:
[Style]: A hybrid of 2D anime animation and realistic live-action product promotion style. The opening segment adopts the healing Japanese anime texture with soft highlights and bright colors, then transitions to a down-to-earth real-life home pet footage style, with authentic, vivid frames full of everyday life atmosphere.
[Environment]: The opening scene is a bright anime-style living room at home, with a beige fabric sofa paired with a large window covered by white sheer curtains, sunlight streaming through the glass window creating soft Tyndall light effects, and various regular cat toys scattered on the floor. The scene then switches to a real-life pet living space, with wood-grain patterned flooring and marble-patterned ground, furnished with a yellow lazy sofa, a smart litter box, a green pet bed, and a glass partition pasted with retro floral wallpaper. The whole space is warmly arranged, full of the cozy living atmosphere of a pet-friendly home.
[Tone & Pacing]: The overall rhythm balances relaxation and energy. The opening animation segment uses a slow narrative pace to lay out the cat's boring daily state, resonating with pet owners. The second half of the footage, which demonstrates the toy's usage effects, speeds up the pace with highly dynamic, energetic frames, highlighting the cat's excited state while playing and amplifying the product's appeal.
[Camera]: The opening animation uses a fixed camera position plus slow push-in shots to accurately capture the cat's listless, lazy state. The live-action segment flexibly switches between multiple camera positions: a first-person handheld perspective to show the toy's details, paired with close-up shots to capture the cats' lively, playful expressions, and dynamic follow shots to track the cats' jumping and pouncing movements toward the toy, restoring the authentic interactive scene between pets and the product.
[Lighting]: The animation segment uses warm natural light pouring in from the side window, creating a lazy, relaxed afternoon home atmosphere. The live-action segment uses bright, even indoor overhead lighting plus supplementary soft fill light, clearly presenting the texture of the cats' fur and the vivid colors of the toys, without harsh heavy shadows, making the frames bright, clear and well-lit.
[Character]: No human characters appear on screen. The featured animals are an animated Siamese cat, a real-life Siamese cat, and a real-life tabby shorthair cat, all in a relaxed state, showing the complete change of expression from listless and bored to lively and excited.

[Shots]
Shot 1:
  - Duration: 0.0sec - 2.0sec
  - Scene Type: Highlight the pain point
  - Scene: In the anime frame, a Siamese cat sits upright in the exact center of the beige fabric sofa with its back to the camera, facing the large window half-covered by white sheer curtains. Blurry green foliage is visible outside the window, and sunlight forms distinct visible light rays in the air, creating an overall quiet and lazy atmosphere.
  - Subject: Thank you.
Shot 2:
  - Duration: 2.0sec - 5.0sec
  - Scene Type: Highlight the pain point
  - Scene: The frame switches to the corner of the wooden floor on the other side of the room. The Siamese cat lies prone on the ground scattered with mouse-shaped plush toys, yarn balls and other toys, its eyelids half drooped, looking weary and completely uninterested in playing.
  - Subject: Thank you.
Shot 3:
  - Duration: 5.0sec - 7.5sec
  - Scene Type: Highlight the pain point

  - Subject: Music
Shot 4:
  - Duration: 7.5sec - 9.5sec
  - Scene Type: Highlight the pain point
  - Scene: The camera cuts back to the beige fabric sofa. The Siamese cat curls up on the sofa cushion and sleeps with its eyes closed, while a pile of idle toys bought by the owner and casually discarded are scattered on the ground.
Shot 5:
  - Duration: 9.5sec - 12.0sec
  - Scene Type: Highlight the pain point

  - Duration: 12.0sec - 15.0sec
  - Scene Type: Highlight the pain point

  - Scene Type: Highlight the pain point
  - Scene: The Siamese cat stands on the bright wooden floor, swats the pink mouse plush toy in front of it with its paw, stops the movement after only a few seconds, droops its ears, turns around and walks away without looking back, leaving the toy alone on the ground.
Shot 8:
  - Duration: 23.0sec - 25.5sec
  - Scene Type: Emotional connection
  - Scene: A blonde woman sits on a retro sofa with diamond lattice texture, reaches out and gently strokes the top of the Siamese cat's head. The cat squints comfortably and enjoys the petting.

Shot 9:

  - Scene Type: Highlight the pain point
  - Scene: The frame quickly flashes through a variety of regular cat toys: a large gray yarn ball is ignored by the cat, a colorful feather wand is stared at listlessly by the cat lying on the ground, and the cat shows no interest in playing the whole time.
  - Subject: Thank you.
Shot 10:
  - Duration: 31.0sec - 39.0sec
  - Scene Type: Highlight the pain point
  - Scene: The Siamese cat pauses for a moment facing the camera with its big eyes wide open, then opens its mouth and lets out a big yawn, turns around and walks away without looking back, leaving a pile of old, tired toys scattered all over the ground behind it.
  - Subject: Thank you.

  - Subject: Bye.
Shot 12:
  - Duration: 51.0sec - 53.0sec
  - Scene Type: Raise the problem

[Transition / Editing]:
- The opening animation segment uses fade-in and fade-out transitions to create a soothing narrative atmosphere. A wipe transition is used when switching from the animation to the real-life product display, achieving a natural style transition. The subsequent live-action segments of cats playing use fast jump-cut editing, paired with beat-matched effects aligned to the music's drum beats, enhancing the frame dynamism and boosting the visual appeal of the product promotion video.

prompt_en:
[Style]: A realistic short healing pet video with soft, delicate image quality, focusing on the daily interactions between cats and a cat scratcher. The overall style is warm, cute, and full of the relaxed vibe of home life.
[Environment]: A well-lit residential entryway hallway during the daytime, with light natural wood solid wood flooring covering the entire ground, and smooth, pure white walls on both sides. Next to the gray entry door at the far end of the hallway are pet supplies including a pet food bag, a colorful striped cat teaser wand, and a small pink ball. A white storage cabinet with drawers stands against the wall, and two identical small hemp chairs with wooden frames are placed side by side in the center of the hallway, creating a neat and cozy setup.
[Tone & Pacing]: The overall atmosphere is relaxed, healing, laid-back and soothing. The rhythm starts with the lively, playful interaction of the cats stepping and scratching at the beginning, then gradually transitions to the slow-paced state of the two cats resting snuggled together in the second half. The camera movement is smooth and steady, with no abrupt cuts, perfectly matching the calm daily state of the cats.
[Camera]: The entire video uses a fixed camera position paired with slow panning movements. It sequentially uses a wide shot to show the full hallway scene, a medium shot to capture the overall movements of the cats, and close-up macro shots to focus on the fine details of cat paws scratching the scratcher and the cats' adorable facial expressions. The camera remains consistently stable to preserve the authentic feel of the home environment.
[Lighting]: Illumination comes from even, soft natural indoor light, which is bright but not harsh, casting a warm gentle glow over the wooden floor and the cats' fluffy fur. There are no harsh shadows, the entire frame is bright and clear, building a comfortable, healing home atmosphere.
[Character]: No human characters appear on screen; the main subjects are two adorable pet cats.

[Shots]

The pet toys and food bag on the entryway floor in the background are clearly visible. The camera stays fixed and stationary, fully presenting the initial scene of the two cats sitting on the chairs together.

The camera slowly pulls backward to bring both cats and the surrounding environment completely into the frame.

prompt_en:
[Style]: UGC-style realistic product sharing aesthetic popular on Douyin and Xiaohongshu, with clean and bright visuals, natural and lively performer demeanor, and an overall relaxed, comforting vibe of everyday home life
[Environment]: Everyday home bedroom setting. Walls are light beige with a pale green trim along the ceiling. Storage cabinets, stacked express delivery boxes and scattered small daily items are visible in the background corners. The desk is decorated with cute plush dolls and small cartoon-shaped ornaments. The overall atmosphere is warm, casual and full of authentic daily life feel
[Tone & Pacing]: Authentic Vietnamese local short video product recommendation style, with a brisk and smooth rhythm, progressive narrative that starts from relatable real-life pain points and gradually demonstrates product features. The overall pace fits the viewing habits of short video users, feeling relaxed and highly engaging
[Camera]: Primarily first-person selfie perspective, switching halfway to a macro close-up shot of the desktop. Camera movement is steady and natural: the selfie phase frames the performer from the upper body up, while the close-up phase focuses precisely on product details
[Lighting]: Soft, even indoor natural light with no harsh contrast between light and shadow. Light spreads evenly across the performer and product surfaces, clearly presenting product textures and the performer's natural skin condition, making the entire frame bright and refreshing
[Character]: 20-25 year old East Asian woman with natural long straight black hair, delicate translucent skin with a natural pinkish glow, soft rounded face shape, relaxed eyebrows and eyes, sheer no-makeup makeup look, slim petite figure, wearing an off-white Henley-neck short-sleeve T-shirt with subtle fine dark patterns. She has a sweet approachable next-door vibe, moves gently and naturally, keeps a soft smile the whole time, and appears relaxed and cheerful

[Shots]
Shot 1:
  - Duration: 0.0sec - 1.5sec
  - Scene Type: Highlight the pain point
  - Scene: The girl stands in the frame from a selfie perspective in her home bedroom, holding the pink helmet silicone lining up to the top of her head with both hands, then gently takes the lining down from her head. Vietnamese netizen comment subtitles appear at the top of the frame
  - Subject: Thảo mua miếng thứ ba rồi đấy, đi học toàn bị chúng nó trộm thôi.
Shot 2:
  - Duration: 1.5sec - 5.5sec
  - Scene Type: Highlight the pain point
  - Scene: The girl puts on the light blue helmet with cartoon bear ear details, skillfully adjusts the red buckle at the chin with both hands to secure the helmet, then raises her hand to tuck stray hairs by her face, unbuckles the buckle to take the helmet off her head, lets her hair fall naturally, and gives the camera a sweet smile. A second netizen comment subtitle updates at the top of the frame
  - Subject: Tao làm rơi mũ ở trường. Mũ không mất, nhưng mất miếng lót. Ha ha!
Shot 3:
  - Duration: 5.5sec - 7.5sec
  - Scene Type: Raise the question
  - Scene: The girl holds the removed helmet in front of her, shows the pre-installed pink silicone lining inside the helmet to the camera, looks at the lens with a soft smile. Corresponding introduction subtitles appear at the top of the frame
  - Subject: Hãy subscribe cho kênh Ghiền Mì Gõ Để không bỏ lỡ những video hấp dẫn
Shot 4:
  - Duration: 7.5sec - 18.0sec
  - Scene Type: Demonstrate product material
  - Scene: The camera switches to a top-down close-up shot of the desktop. A pair of hands picks up the pink star-shaped silicone lining, flips it 360 degrees to show its overall shape, soft rubber material and the small raised silicone dots on its surface, then gently rubs the lining against the back of one hand to demonstrate its texture. Small cartoon ornaments and plush dolls are placed on the background desktop, and corresponding introduction subtitles are displayed synchronously at the top of the frame throughout the shot
  - Subject: Vừa không bết tóc, vừa không bị xẹp mà còn mắt ra đầu thì anh cũng lấy. Em này là miếng lót mũ bảo hiểm silicon nhó. Có các gai silicon để massage ra đầu chứ không hề đau đâu, nó chỉ có một cái đau đẹp.
Shot 5:
  - Duration: 18.0sec - 22.0sec
  - Scene Type: Show ease of use
  - Scene: The camera cuts back to the girl's selfie perspective. She smoothly fits the pink silicone lining into the inner side of the helmet, presses and adjusts it with her hand to make it fully adhere to the inner wall of the helmet, then flips the helmet to show the camera the firm, properly installed effect of the lining. Corresponding fit introduction subtitles appear at the top of the frame
  - Subject: Nó chỉ hơi đau khi đi qua đoạn đường sóc thôi, rẻm là chân ái những ngàn đồ.
Shot 6:
  - Duration: 22.0sec - 27.5sec
  - Scene Type: Demonstrate product effectiveness
  - Scene: The girl puts on the cartoon helmet with the lining installed again, adjusts the chin buckle to secure the helmet, then raises her hand to take the helmet off her head, revealing her long straight black hair that remains fluffy. She reaches out to gently brush the stray hairs on her forehead to show that her hair is not flattened or deformed, keeping a soft smile the whole time. Corresponding experience introduction subtitles are displayed synchronously at the top of the frame
  - Subject: Cảm ơn các bạn đã theo dõi. Các bạn hãy đăng ký kênh để ủng hộ kênh của mình nhé.
Shot 7:
  - Duration: 27.5sec - 34.0sec
  - Scene Type: Blogger's personal test experience
  - Scene: The girl playfully taps her own cheek towards the camera, then extends one finger to point at the pink silicone lining inside the helmet, emphasizing the product details. She keeps a sweet smile the whole time, looks directly at the camera to finish the final product recommendation closing segment. Playful summary subtitles appear synchronously at the top of the frame
  - Subject: Hãy subscribe cho kênh Ghiền Mì Gõ Để không bỏ lỡ những video hấp dẫn. Cái lót mũ còn không giữ được thì sao giữ được n-i-hà-các. Vợ ơi!
[Background Sound]:
- No background music at all. Only clear, colloquial Vietnamese voiceover is retained throughout the entire video, with no additional soundtrack or background sound effects that would interfere with speech clarity
[Transition / Editing]:
- Natural and smooth scene-switching editing, transitioning seamlessly from the performer's selfie shot to the desktop product close-up, then cutting back to the selfie to demonstrate usage effects. No abrupt jumps throughout, maintaining narrative continuity and the natural casual rhythm of authentic home-style product recommendations

prompt_en:
[Style]: A Chinese folk custom animated narrative style combined with partial live-action footage, featuring strong color atmosphere in the frames, a warm tone with a hint of caution, ultimately focusing on popularizing traditional filial piety and ancestor worship culture alongside product promotion.
[Environment]: The scenes transition sequentially from a grave-side worship site in a cornfield, a Chinese-style bedroom, a post station in the underworld, the traditional Chinese hall of an elderly Taoist priest, an ancestor worship supplies store, and finally to a live-action display area for books on ancestor worship culture. The entire setting is filled with traditional Chinese folk custom elements, and the lighting gradually shifts from the dim, underworld-style color palette to the warm, bright tones of the real world.
[Tone & Pacing]: The narrative rhythm starts slow and builds to a faster pace. The early part lays out the story with faint sadness and suspense, the middle section sees emotions gradually tense up, and the ending returns to warmth and relief, concluding with a calm popular science introduction to ancestor worship culture. The rhythm is well-balanced to suit the viewing pace of short-form videos.
[Camera]: Dynamic camera movement that follows the characters' actions, starting with wide establishing shots to show the full scene, gradually switching to medium shots to display character interactions, and finally using a macro lens for close-up details of the inner pages of the ancestor worship book. All camera movements are smooth and natural throughout.
[Lighting]: Underworld scenes use cool blue lighting to create a gloomy, oppressive atmosphere. Real-world mortal scenes use warm soft yellow light to set a warm, affectionate mood. Worship scenes are paired with the flickering warm glow of candle flames to enhance the immersive atmosphere.
[Character]: Tu Lan, an East Asian woman aged 25-30, has smooth, firm skin, soft and delicate facial features, light everyday makeup, wears a simple red short-sleeved top and a gray midi skirt, and has a well-proportioned, slender figure. The mother's spirit, around 70 years old, has wrinkled, scarred skin, a haggard face with tear-reddened eyes, wears tattered red linen clothing, and looks wronged and helpless. The elderly Taoist priest, around 75 years old, has age spots on his skin, a white beard and long eyebrows, a kind expression, wears a red top with a yellow vest, has a lean figure, and moves steadily.
